news_mentions.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba continues to dominate, no matter who's at QB: 'This guy is a wizard'
news_mentions.body_text: glendale ariz jaxon smith njigba often found himself in 34 the zone 34 last season but it had been nearly five years since he ascended to the level he showcased sunday afternoon including playoffs the star wideout racked up ten 100 yard games in 2025 during the seattle seahawks 39 romp to their second super bowl title twice the reigning nfl offensive player of the year snagged a pair of touchdown passes in a game but never thrice like he did when breaking into the national spotlight as a sophomore at ohio state in the thrilling 2022 rose bowl smith njigba set an fbs bowl record with 347 receiving yards and three touchdown receptions he didn 39 t quite match that distance with his 155 receiving yards on sunday but he scored three touchdowns for the first time since his college days as the seahawks improved to 2 0 with a 31 7 win against the arizona cardinals 34 it 39 s been a minute 34 said a reflective smith njigba 34 it 39 s awesome being in that zone putting points up for our team whatever it takes to win i 39 m willing to do whatever it takes any time you get opportunities you got to execute and put points on the board 34 not only did smith njigba become the first seahawks player since dk metcalf with three receiving touchdowns in a game he also made life significantly easier for backup quarterback drew lock who started in place of sam darnold seattle 39 s starting quarterback is out with a glute injury though coach mike macdonald said postgame that darnold 39 s timetable for returning has shifted quite drastically for the better darnold could start as soon as sept 27 against the washington commanders it was lock 39 s show on sunday however with smith njigba in a leading role on seattle 39 s second offensive play of the game lock dropped back and heaved a deep pass down the right sideline for smith njigba who was five yards behind the last line of arizona 39 s defense when he caught the ball smith njigba deked cardinals cornerback will johnson with a devastating head fake then slipped behind safety budda baker for a career long 82 yard touchdown reception 34 that 39 s my hooping skills right there 34 smith njigba said of his head fake lock wasn 39 t expecting smith njigba to be so open nor for him to run his route in such a manner 34 but that 39 s the beauty of playing with him 34 lock said 34 he 39 s going to find ways to get open it might not be the most conventional but that 39 s what makes him a ballplayer and that 39 s what makes him one of the best receivers the offensive player of the year last year 34 smith njigba 39 s next two touchdowns overshadowed a somewhat sloppy first half for the seahawks in which seattle and arizona each scored seven points he put seattle up for good on the opening drive of the second half when he ran a slant to perfection sneaking behind cardinals cornerback max melton to corral a seed from lock for a seven yard touchdown the 24 year old put the game out of reach early in the fourth quarter when lock threaded a pass through three cardinals defenders on third and 6 from arizona 39 s 12 yard line it wasn 39 t until aj barner plunged into the end zone from one yard out with 1 11 remaining in the game that a seahawks player not named smith njigba found the end zone for seattle this season smith njigba had the seahawks 39 lone touchdown in their season opening 13 10 win against the new england patriots as much as the seahawks long for the return of darnold who has missed all but five offensive snaps this season smith njigba is well on his way to another banner year regardless his 277 receiving yards lead the league while his four receiving touchdowns are tied with detroit lions standout amon ra st brown smith njigba has proven that seattle 39 s offense isn 39 t about who is throwing the passes or what scheme first year offensive coordinator brian fleury runs the game plan is quite simple get the ball to smith njigba and let the all pro figure out the rest 34 when he catches the ball we 39 re just like 39 man this guy is a wizard 39 34 defensive lineman leonard williams said 34 it 39 s nice to have big playmakers on offense 34 it doesn 39 t hurt to have a stingy defense either seattle allowed a game tying touchdown pass from jacoby brissett to trey mcbride to start the second quarter but otherwise stifled the cardinals arizona finished the game with only 151 yards of total offense including just 44 yards after halftime including last year 39 s playoff run the seahawks have won a franchise record 12 consecutive games thanks in large part to their defensive dominance the members of the unit that refers to itself as the dark side didn 39 t give that accomplishment much thought in the immediate aftermath of sunday 39 s shellacking 34 i think that 39 s what 39 s so beautiful about this team 34 williams said 34 i don 39 t think anyone 39 s thinking about that i think we 39 re so honed in on just being who we are 34 two games into their title defense the seahawks have demonstrated they are a well oiled machine capable of running it back and contending for what would be the franchise 39 s third super bowl title certainly seattle would benefit from darnold running the offense again but lock was more than adequate in his absence completing 19 of 26 attempts for 235 yards and those three touchdown passes to smith njigba 34 we 39 re on record about how we feel about him 34 macdonald said of lock 34 so he just backed that up today but it 39 s a 12 as 1 thing everybody having each other 39 s back 34 perhaps smith njigba though is a bit more irreplaceable than the rest of the seahawks the franchise made it abundantly clear how it feels about smith njigba when it made him the highest paid wide receiver in the nfl on an annual basis with a four year 168 8 million deal in march the seahawks dished the dough out for smith njigba because few nfl wide receivers if any can carry an offense quite like he can sunday 39 s performance was the latest in a line of many dominant ones for smith njigba who hauled in touchdown receptions from lock with ease just like that new year 39 s day in 2022 when he burst onto the scene 34 drew he is a special talent and sees the field very well and can make any throw 34 smith njigba said 34 i know he 39 s looking for me and i just want to be there for him 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job done stroud played solidly avoiding big mistakes and peppered the middle of the field however the lack of a rushing attack put the offense in bad spots the retooled offensive line looked a lot like last year opening few holes on the ground and not giving stroud much time the texans offense missed nico collins badly with none of the young wide receivers stepping up tight end dalton schultz 12 receptions for 140 yards generated 103 yards more than any other texans pass catcher on sunday houston missed several opportunities to make it a game with an early flubbed field goal attempt a stuffed fourth down and a missed 58 yard field goal all coming in the first three quarters the texans got into the red zone four times however they scored zero tds and accounted for just three points on those drives that won t get it done burrow hooks up with chase for two tds in road win there weren t gaudy numbers but joe burrow and ja marr chase showed why they are a premier duo burrow came out insistent on getting chase involved early the wr paid him off with a ridiculous twisting toe tap 32 yard td in the second quarter the duo hooked up again on a scramble drill to put up cincy by two scores in the third quarter the offensive line was an issue on sunday burrow was sacked five times and the texans generated 10 qb hits orlando brown five qb pressures two sacks dalton risner six qb pressures sack and dylan fairchild five qb pressures sack all struggled the good news is that when the bengals put up fewer than 300 yards in years past they usually took an l in 2026 they re 2 0 while the offense irons things out next gen stats insight for bengals texans via nfl pro the bengals generated 27 pressures on 62 dropbacks 43 5 the most pressures generated in a single game by the bengals since al golden took over as the bengals defensive coordinator last season five bengals recorded four or more pressures in week 2 including jonathan allen seven boye mafe seven cedric johnson six cashius howell five and dexter lawrence four allen recorded his most pressures in a game in the last four seasons while mafe tied his most pressures generated in a game in his career nfl research the bengals did not allow a single touchdown in week 2 at the texans their first game allowing no touchdowns since week 3 2022 at the jets cincinnati broke a franchise long and nfl long streak of 65 consecutive games allowing at least one touchdown the bills now own the longest active streak in the nfl having allowed at least one touchdown in 47 consecutive games back to top kevin patra s takeaways patriots splash big plays to run away from pittsburgh drake maye didn t author a particularly pretty game but the quarterback threw a trove of big plays to move the ball against an experienced steelers defense maye connected on passes of 29 29 30 and 63 yards the pats also generated big runs starting with treveyon henderson s 39 yard td sprint and rhamondre stevenson added a 24 yarder early in the second half the pats had several miscues that kept the game closer than it could have been stevenson fumbled in plus territory on the opening drive and maye later threw an interception in scoring range coming off a disappointing week 1 maye didn t fully bounce back missing several plays he made a year ago and he wasn t comfortable in the pocket behind an offensive line that struggled especially as injuries struck however the splash plays highlighted by a 63 yarder to romeo doubs after maye escaped the pocket were a welcomed sight after last week in week 1 the qb didn t have a pass play of 20 plus yards on sunday he generated four the offense still has strides to make but it s much easier after a win that avoids an 0 2 start pats d gets in on the big plays it wasn t just the offense that sprayed big plays on the foxborough turf the new england defensive line dominated steelers blockers blasting aaron rodgers repeatedly the pats biggest plays came when they destroyed the 42 year old qb with the steelers in field goal range on third and 7 christian elliss walloped rodgers for a sack and forced fumble the ball bounced around for an eventual loss of 36 yards forcing a punt then early in the fourth quarter christian barmore hit rodgers forcing another fumble that elijah ponder scooped up for a touchdown effectively putting the game away for good measure rookie gabe jacas grabbed a flubbed catch for an interception that ensured the steelers wouldn t find pay dirt on sunday the pats allowed just 235 yards and 2 of 12 on third downs ugly day for steelers offense every aspect was bad for pittsburgh s offense the o line got walloped troy fautanu had a forgettable afternoon and guard spencer anderson was destroyed allowing seven qb pressures and a sack per next gen stats aaron rodgers was never comfortable struggled to maneuver muddy pockets and looked every bit of 42 on sunday before sitting for the final drive he completed 23 of 39 attempts for 187 yards threw an int and took four sacks the passing attack couldn t get out of its own way with drops and off the mark passes being the most memorable plays dk metcalf continued his atrocious start to the season catching four passes on nine targets for 27 yards with several miscues christian gonzalez usually locks up wr1s but right now metcalf is barely playing like a wr3 the run game was absent from start to finish putting the offense in bad down and distance situations mike mccarthy has a lot to figure out after two uninspiring offensive performances to open the season next gen stats insight for patriots steelers via nfl pro the patriots defense blitzed the steelers on 18 total dropbacks their most in a game since week 10 of 2024 when sending extra pass rushers they held the steelers to 43 passing yards 2 7 yards per attempt and a 22 2 success rate while also recording eight pressures two sacks and one interception nfl research the steelers scored just three points against the patriots tied for the second fewest by any team in which aaron rodgers was the starting quarterback rodgers finished with 187 passing yards no touchdowns and one interception his fifth straight start with one passing touchdown or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways packers avoid first 0 2 start in 20 years with gutty effort it wasn t pretty but green bay is in the win column in 2026 jordan love threw for just 145 yards the packers offense converted one of nine third downs and picked up at least one first down on only four of 12 drives and green bay committed 14 accepted penalties but a win is a win down 17 7 in the fourth quarter love and co strung together one of their better drives of the afternoon picking up four first downs with help from a field flipping azareye 39 h thomas defensive pass interference call and finding the end zone to pull within three a quick stop and skyy moore punt return later and green bay was in position to tie the game with a field goal after another three down stop in overtime with two consecutive sacks shared by four packers defenders green bay rode backup backs kaleb johnson and chris brooks into gang green territory where after another awful jets penalty and matthew golden first down trey smack smacked home the game winning field goal sunday s turnaround came in stark contrast to how the packers finished their season opener against minnesota when they blew a two score lead and lost by three scores green bay fans will be happy to sheath their knives for lafleur ahead of the home opener on thursday night as the pack have avoided starting 0 2 for the first time since 2006 jets collapse down stretch blow chance to start 2 0 on a gray afternoon in the meadowlands new york was in position to ride out an ugly win over the visiting packers through three quarters the jets had made fewer mistakes avoided nasty injuries and adjusted well to what green bay was throwing at them then fortunes turned up 14 7 new york benefitted from a marshawn lloyd fumble at the packers 18 yard line but the jets went three and out and neglected to go for it on fourth and 1 from the 9 setting up a field goal later tied 17 17 after two green bay scoring drives with the ball at the 50 yard line under two minutes to the jets decided to try a fourth and 1 dive the risk didn t pay off as braelon allen was stuffed at the line the packers didn t make anything of the turnover on downs but took their momentum into overtime where geno smith was sacked on back to back plays and new york punted the ball and game back to the pack for the second straight year the jets have outplayed their opponents in their home opener aaron rodgers steelers in 2025 only to fall just short in the end after such a positive start the loss felt like a familiar finish for aaron glenn s group and serves as a missed opportunity for new york to start 2 0 for the first time in 11 years sloppy outing for both sides matt lafleur and aaron glenn will use this game film as teaching tape teaching their players what not to do lest they play a more disciplined opponent in ensuing weeks the packers and jets combined for 27 accepted penalties for 289 yards an ugly affair all around green bay and new york kept each other in the game with ill timed fouls for the packers that s 26 penalties in two games only three teams have incurred more accepted fouls in the first two games of a campaign the weather might not have contributed to the poor discipline but it surely had an effect on the poor hands in this one the teams combined for eight fumbles five by green bay three by new york though only one was lost the jets special teams which had been key in their week 1 victory was super shaky with isaiah williams muffing two punts and new york surrendering a 63 yard skyy moore punt return leading to the packers game tying field goal drive next gen stats insight for jets packers via nfl pro packers pass rusher lukas van ness generated a career high nine pressures against the jets recording five of them in under 2 5 seconds tied for the third most by a packers defender since 2020 nfl research the jets blew a 17 7 fourth quarter lead in their week 2 overtime loss to the packers it was their first time blowing a double digit fourth quarter lead since week 9 of 2020 vs the patriots they had won 14 straight games in which they held a double digit fourth quarter lead entering week 2 back to top nick shook s takeaways browns pull off the improbable cleveland began sunday s contest exhibiting many of the same discouraging signs that doomed them in week 1 operational errors and penalties general disorganization and an inability to convert in key offensive situations unlike last week the browns defense showed up and kept the game within reach opening the door for deshaun watson and the rest of cleveland s offense to find a rhythm in the second half watson leaned on the youngsters around him connecting with rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston to keep drives moving using harold fannin as a safety valve and even converting a couple of third downs with his legs it was far from pretty but cleveland s offense pieced together two touchdown drives in the second half including a 12 play 68 yard march that ate up 6 07 and ended with blake whiteheart sneaking across the field for a wide open connection with watson for a 17 yard go ahead touchdown the browns had plenty to overcome sunday including poor offensive line play early self inflicted errors and a two hour weather delay and managed to outlast the buccaneers with a defensive stand amid a driving rain it s only one win but it will be a joyous flight back home to cleveland mayfield looks very uncomfortable in this offense after eight quarters of evidence it s pretty clear that baker mayfield hasn t found a comfortable place in offensive coordinator zac robinson s scheme tampa bay s approach was peculiar at times sunday producing sequences that saw repeated screens and swing passes to running backs while avoiding attempting to stretch the field much until late in the contest mayfield looks skittish in the pocket regardless of situation hesitating to fire and often trying to buy more time to survey as initial concepts fail to produce clear passing opportunities or he fails to spot them when they do come open it s only two weeks but it s fair to say the buccaneers offense looks a lot like the 2025 falcons also directed by robinson lacking consistent identity and intent while being operated by a quarterback who doesn t appear to be relaxed or confident that s not a good sign for a team aiming to climb back to the top of the nfc south qb change delayed for a week entering sunday s game many browns fans were eager to watch primarily because they believed it would be the last time they d have to suffer through an ugly deshaun watson led performance before coach todd monken decided to bench watson for shedeur sanders well they ll have to enjoy cleveland s win with a bit of bitterness because watson performed well enough to justify starting again next week he was far from perfect his performance is best described as fine but watson played an integral role in cleveland managing to mount a comeback confidently firing toward kc concepcion denzel boston and even isaiah bond for one key completion along the sideline and on must have downs in the fourth quarter watson kept the chains moving there s certainly no guarantee his success was anything more than a one week aberration but he looked much more like a quarterback capable of playing in the nfl this week than he did in week 1 when monken breaks down watson s performance to reporters this week his positive remarks will be much more believable next gen stats insight for browns buccaneers via nfl pro deshaun watson completed 24 of 30 pass attempts for 238 yards and two touchdowns averaging 0 25 epa per dropback his most as a brown and most since week 12 of the 2020 season nfl research denzel boston joined bobby mitchell and andre davis as the only browns with a receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games boston s first two receiving touchdowns went for 46 yards and 55 yards respectively he is the fourth player in nfl history to have a 45 plus yard receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games joining sammy white 1976 mac haik 1968 and bob hayes 1965 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways hurts comes in clutch after tough outing it wasn t the best day at the office for jalen hurts but when met with a deadline needing to lead a game winning drive with 1 56 remaining the super bowl lix most valuable player delivered hurts who threw a bad interception in the end zone during his first possession and another pick during the drive immediately preceding his last led philly on a nine play 65 yard drive to take the lead and the win from the titans he did so by becoming laser focused on devonta smith throwing to the eagles no 1 wide receiver on four of eight passes including a pretty 19 yard gain on third and 6 to set up philadelphia at the goal line on the next play he hit darius cooper for the wideout s first career touchdown to propel the eagles to a surprisingly difficult win he wasn t nearly perfect sunday going 26 of 37 for 264 yards two touchdowns and the two picks but he was clutch as ever when called upon to leave titans fans with some achy breaky hearts titans defense finally runs out of gas tennessee couldn t end drives quickly in the first half against philly allowing the eagles to dominate the time of possession with three drives that all took 11 or more plays and over 6 minutes 30 seconds although the titans did allow touchdowns on the second and third drives they made a massive early stop setting themselves up to take a 7 0 lead after amani hooker intercepted jalen hurts and returned it 92 yards to philadelphia s 10 yard line robert saleh s crew buckled down after halftime finally gaining some momentum with a pair of three and outs in the third quarter to no one s surprise jeffery simmons led the way making life difficult for hurts racking up seven pressures jacob martin had six and jermaine johnson had four as hurts seemed to regularly be running for his life and forced into poor or difficult throws it was simmons wrapping his arms around hurts as the qb threw his second pick of the day which eventually set the titans up for a go ahead joey slye field goal with just under two minutes remaining unfortunately a gassed tennessee defense that was on the field for over 13 minutes more than its offense couldn t hold up against philly s last second heroics after that eagles winning by skin of their teeth philadelphia found itself shorthanded right off the bat against the titans saquon barkley suffered a stinger on his first carry of the game after being stuffed at the line of scrimmage and having multiple big bodies land on him tight end dallas goedert then injured his knee on the second play of the second quarter barkley came back for the second half but only handled three more carries as he was clearly affected perhaps those setbacks disrupted philly s game plan but the offense fell into a deep sleep in the second half before miraculously waking up for some last drive magic that left philly s defense to keep it close enough for a win and vic fangio s crew luckily abided the eagles will certainly want some plays back especially after a few woeful missed tackles while allowing tennessee to go 84 yards to take the lead toward the end of the fourth quarter but the eagles ultimately held the titans to a field goal late just as they stumbled last week but recovered to stop a commanders two point conversion toward game s end to preserve a win it s been a high wire act thus far as the eagles try to find their groove but 2 0 is 2 0 next gen stats insight for eagles titans via nfl pro devonta smith caught six of eight targets outside the numbers for 77 yards and a touchdown including two sideline catches for 24 yards more than he had all of last season nfl research jalen hurts led his eighth fourth quarter comeback since 2023 tied for second most in the league back to top nick shook s takeaways waddle explodes a quiet debut muted some of the excitement surrounding jaylen waddle denver s prized offseason acquisition but that was merely a prelude to a loud introduction at mile high on sunday waddle went off in the broncos comeback win catching a 49 yard strike from bo nix early in the second quarter to set up denver s offense at jacksonville s 1 yard line and although denver settled for a field goal on that drive waddle was only getting started he logged six more catches on the day with four gaining double digit yardage and almost all of them making a key difference in denver s offensive awakening for one afternoon the broncos were able to realize the dream they d carried with them for years spending their sunday watching a deep threat thrive with a quarterback capable of finding him it s crucial to denver s offensive arc in 2026 one that can t rely too heavily on nix s playmaking or its stable of running backs the broncos will be at their best when waddle is a central figure and they saw firsthand how he can change their outlook on sunday jacksonville finally falters it s been quite some time since the jaguars fell apart in a regular season game sunday s performance wasn t quite a disintegration but it was a disappointing finish for an offense that could do no wrong in week 1 and suddenly couldn t find a method of success to counter denver s comeback after a strong first half that saw trevor lawrence pepper denver s defense with pinpoint passes lawrence regressed to the quarterback who too frequently attempts highly questionable passes and pays the price for it his interception swung momentum in the broncos favor and gave denver permission to hunt him for the rest of the day and the jaguars failed to adjust it all starts up front for jacksonville which struggled with denver s increased defensive aggression in news_mentions.headline: Two truths and a lie: Ben Johnson is the new Bill Walsh, while John Harbaugh has revived the Giants
news_mentions.description: Is Ben Johnson this generation's Bill Walsh? Are the Giants BACK under John Harbaugh? Which surprise team feels like a mirage? With early-season takes flying all over the NFL world, Bucky Brooks reveals two truths and a lie.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he explores three emerging viewpoints as we head into the 2026 campaign s second sunday the nfl world is still teeming with takes from week 1 that s what happens when a football starved public gets its first real meal since winter initial impressions breed strong opinions ultimately some prove prescient others preposterous with that in mind i d like to evaluate the legitimacy of a few nascent narratives prior to this season s second full helping of pigskin what s real and what s fake which early observations do i stand behind stand against here are two truths and a lie truth ben johnson is this generation s bill walsh no disrespect to kyle shanahan and sean mcvay s wizardry but ben johnson is the guru who will define the 2020s as a legendary play caller the second year head coach of the chicago bears has awakened a hibernating offense transforming it into a juggernaut that has defensive coordinators shaking in their boots as they prepare to face the monsters of the midway johnson s bears bludgeon opponents with a mix of power and pizzazz fielding an exotic smash mouth offense with an mvp caliber quarterback a pair of potential 1 000 yard rushers and a talented collection of pass catchers the savvy schemer can call any play he wants with supreme confidence in the team s talent tactics and execution moreover johnson knows his rock solid offensive line will impose its will on foes leaving them battered and bruised after a 60 minute war in the trenches given the overwhelming physicality and toughness this unit displays whenever it takes the field chicago is establishing itself as an offensive bully that pushes around adversaries chicago finished 2025 ranked ninth in points and sixth in total offense but johnson boldly stated in august that he wants the bears to set an nfl scoring record in 2026 then they hit the road for the season opener and dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers flexing their muscles against a completely overwhelmed defense the bears enjoyed a rare 250 250 game eclipsing the yardage figure in passing 261 and rushing 291 d andre swift led the way on the ground with 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries while kyle monangai reached the century mark on just 10 totes including a 61 yard touchdown meanwhile caleb williams completed 72 4 percent of his passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns adding 65 yards and two more scores with his legs the crazy part is that kalif raymond not rome odunze or luther burden led the receiving corps in targets nine catches eight and yards 84 shoot tight end colston loveland who took the league by storm in the second half of his rookie season didn t even have a catch and yet chicago nearly scored 60 points in 60 minutes the video game like exhibition demonstrated johnson s brilliance as a play caller further proving his deft ability to juggle a collection of weapons that s something he showcased as detroit s offensive coordinator from 2022 through 24 when the lions fielded three straight top five units in points and yards now he s doing the same thing in the windy city pulling all the right levers with a potent pack of playmakers bill walsh transformed the game with his west coast offense and a star studded lineup that featured joe montana jerry rice and roger craig among others the hall of fame coach made a pass heavy approach the norm these days johnson has balance back in vogue chicago ranked third in rushing and 10th in passing last season in 2026 the bears could finish in the top five in both categories with a well rounded approach creative scheming and a deep bag of tricks johnson is setting the standard for modern offense i can t wait to see what his bears do this sunday against the vikings brian flores blitz happy defense is challenging to most though johnson boasts a 5 1 record when calling plays against the ballyhooed coordinator truth the giants are back with john harbaugh the new york giants have enjoyed their greatest successes with hard nosed disciplinarians leading the charge bill parcells and tom coughlin each guided the franchise to two super bowl titles with both head men using old school blueprints that prioritized discipline toughness and attention to detail over flashy schemes and star power that throwback approach is back in the building with john harbaugh in charge the soon to be 64 year old compiled a 180 113 record with the baltimore ravens winning a lombardi trophy and six afc north titles while appearing in the playoffs 12 times in 18 seasons the grizzled leader built a culture of hard work physicality and toughness in baltimore holding his players accountable for meeting the standard on every snap now he s doing the same thing in nyc in a dazzling debut on sunday night football harbaugh guided his team to a 28 20 upset of the eternally hyped dallas cowboys suddenly the football world is buzzing about the upstart g men being dark horse contenders in the nfc the 2026 giants are built like the proud organization s four super bowl winning squads from 1986 1990 2007 and 2011 the first three of those teams in particular relied heavily on dominant defense a potent running game and a quarterback who makes plays in the clutch sound familiar this year s d still has some questions in the back end but the salty front seven is vintage big blue new york has a collection of pass rushers brian burns kayvon thibodeaux abdul carter chauncey golston and arvell reese who can jump into the old nascar packages that terrorized opponents in previous nyg title runs moreover free agent addition tremaine edmunds gives this team a reliable nerve center with the middle linebacker directing traffic to keep everyone on the same page the unit showed championship caliber communication and attention to detail last sunday night while playing with the physicality that s always been a hallmark of the franchise s great defenses offensively the giants have embraced a slow down style forcing opponents to adjust to a deliberate run oriented game plan that chews up the clock and reduces total possessions while qb jaxson dart will get chances to push the ball downfield to malik nabers and isaiah likely these giants want to control games with a lower risk approach that leans heavily on cam skattebo and the rushing attack to string together first downs the ground and pound strategy is part of the team s plan to set the tempo and push opponents out of their comfort zone particularly when going against high powered offenses that want to play shootouts against the cowboys the giants comfortably won time of possession 36 40 to 23 20 and went 9 for 11 on third down new york ran 16 more offensive plays than dallas 68 to 52 which helps explain why cowboys qb dak prescott lost his patience and threw an uncharacteristic interception setting up a giants score right before halftime admittedly it s only been one game maintaining perspective is key and the giants immediately face another stiff test in prime time visiting los angeles this week to play the rams on monday night football still i m confident that the culture and blueprint harbaugh is establishing will have big blue back in the championship hunt sooner than many anticipate lie the nfc west actually has four good teams the excitement following the cardinals week 1 upset of the chargers has led some observers to offer hot takes on the bird gang s immediate prospects in 2026 the optimism springing from the desert is a far cry from the doom and gloom that hovered over the franchise for most of the offseason while i hate to be the bearer of bad news to a fan base reveling in its week 1 win the cardinals are destined to finish as cellar dwellers and miss the playoffs for a fifth straight season the fanfare over mike lafleur s impressive debut is understandable but it will eventually subside as teams settle in and arizona s film circulates around the league astute observers will quickly scan last week s game and see the chargers beat themselves with a series of blunders and miscues typically seen at your local high school on a friday night the bolts lost the turnover battle minus two had a punt blocked and were stopped on downs three times the errors allowed the cardinals to dominate time of possession 37 31 to 22 29 and run 21 more plays although the cardinals deserve credit for finding a winning formula victories will be very hard to come by in a brutally tough schedule looking at the rosters and depth charts throughout the nfc west it is hard to find a position group where the cardinals have an edge in personnel yes arizona has a few blue chip players see te trey mcbride s budda baker and rookie rb jeremiyah love but the superior depth and talent on the seahawks rams and 49ers will require lafleur and co to out scheme everyone and in case you haven t noticed those three teams are pretty damn well coached in a league where jimmys and joes matter more than x s and o s the talent discrepancy between the cardinals and the nfc s true contenders ultimately will lead to a string of losses that leaves arizona behind the competition this sunday the cards host the reigning super bowl champions sam darnold remains sidelined for the seahawks but as we saw in seattle s 13 10 win over new england mike macdonald s team is plenty capable of winning games with defense though lafleur certainly can continue to build this team s competitive culture the first time head coach faces long odds when it comes to orchestrating a true rags to riches turnaround in 2026

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

news_mentions.headline: AFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bengals, Browns, Ravens, Steelers
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top
