news_mentions.headline: Marcus Mariota to start at QB in Commanders' Week 3 game as Jayden Daniels seeks opinions on elbow
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels will be sidelined for one week at the very least after his latest elbow injury. Marcus Mariota will start at quarterback in the Washington Commanders' Week 3 game.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels will be sidelined for one week at the very least after his latest elbow injury marcus mariota will start at quarterback in the washington commanders week 3 game against the seattle seahawks head coach dan quinn confirmed on monday daniels underwent imaging monday after suffering a dislocated left elbow in sunday s loss in dallas and will consult with specialists in the coming days quinn told reporters the third year qb does not yet have a timeline for return the commanders coach added daniels suffered the injury on the final play of the first half of washington s 37 20 defeat he stumbled after taking a snap under center and braced himself with his left arm before falling to the turf in obvious pain as his pass attempt fell incomplete medical staff quickly attended to daniels on the field at at t stadium and he was eventually carted to the locker room the commanders ruled daniels out after halftime this is daniels second elbow injury in two years the former offensive rookie of the year dislocated the same elbow last season in a week 9 game against seattle and missed the following three weeks he aggravated the injury upon his return as to whether washington will change its approach to handling daniels injured elbow this time around quinn said monday the team will defer to the specialists quinn added that the team has not yet discussed adding another quarterback to the room behind mariota and seventh round rookie athan kaliakmanis mariota was 11 of 16 passing for 111 yards and a touchdown in relief of daniels in 11 games played last season eight starts the former no 2 pick now 32 years old completed 61 2 of his passes for 1 695 yards 10 tds and seven picks washington 0 2 hosts the seahawks 2 0 in its home opener next sunday at 1 p m et the commanders then travel to london to play the indianapolis colts in week 4 whether daniels will be on that trip remains to be seen washington s bye comes in week 7

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Falcons' Michael Penix Jr. could start Week 3; Tua Tagovailoa not expected to be moved
news_mentions.description: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. is nearing a return from his knee injury ahead of Atlanta's Week 3 game against the Packers. Penix may make his first 2026 start on Thursday night, roughly 10 months since suffering his latest ACL injury.
news_mentions.body_text: michael penix s return is nigh after another week of fully participating in practice but being ruled out the falcons quarterback could finally make his first 2026 start in atlanta s week 3 game against the green bay packers on thursday night nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported sunday per sources penix s potential season debut comes just over 10 months since he suffered his latest acl injury the third year qb was a full participant in practice this week yet again but ceded first team reps to cooper rush on friday the 32 year old journeyman will get his second straight start sunday against the carolina panthers meanwhile tua tagovailoa could also return thursday night from his oblique injury tagovailoa was in line to start week 1 against pittsburgh before suffering the injury during practice tagovailoa is expected to practice this week and might be active against green bay serving as penix s backup per rapoport and schefter despite rumors to the contrary the ex dolphins quarterback is not expected to be moved either via release or trade rapoport and schefter added tagovailoa signed in atlanta this offseason for the veteran minimum after his release from miami who took him in the first round of the 2020 nfl draft if neither penix himself a 2024 first round selection nor tagovailoa can return by thursday s week 3 game their next opportunity to play is 11 days later the falcons open week 3 on thursday but close week 4 with a monday night game against the rival new orleans saints on oct 5 atlanta 0 1 has been in a quarterback quandary all offseason tagovailoa and penix were expected to battle for the week 1 qb1 role but the former was hampered by an early camp back injury and the latter was cleared to practice in full only late in the summer now with penix and tagovailoa returning to near full health the falcons can finally round into form as autumn begins

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job done stroud played solidly avoiding big mistakes and peppered the middle of the field however the lack of a rushing attack put the offense in bad spots the retooled offensive line looked a lot like last year opening few holes on the ground and not giving stroud much time the texans offense missed nico collins badly with none of the young wide receivers stepping up tight end dalton schultz 12 receptions for 140 yards generated 103 yards more than any other texans pass catcher on sunday houston missed several opportunities to make it a game with an early flubbed field goal attempt a stuffed fourth down and a missed 58 yard field goal all coming in the first three quarters the texans got into the red zone four times however they scored zero tds and accounted for just three points on those drives that won t get it done burrow hooks up with chase for two tds in road win there weren t gaudy numbers but joe burrow and ja marr chase showed why they are a premier duo burrow came out insistent on getting chase involved early the wr paid him off with a ridiculous twisting toe tap 32 yard td in the second quarter the duo hooked up again on a scramble drill to put up cincy by two scores in the third quarter the offensive line was an issue on sunday burrow was sacked five times and the texans generated 10 qb hits orlando brown five qb pressures two sacks dalton risner six qb pressures sack and dylan fairchild five qb pressures sack all struggled the good news is that when the bengals put up fewer than 300 yards in years past they usually took an l in 2026 they re 2 0 while the offense irons things out next gen stats insight for bengals texans via nfl pro the bengals generated 27 pressures on 62 dropbacks 43 5 the most pressures generated in a single game by the bengals since al golden took over as the bengals defensive coordinator last season five bengals recorded four or more pressures in week 2 including jonathan allen seven boye mafe seven cedric johnson six cashius howell five and dexter lawrence four allen recorded his most pressures in a game in the last four seasons while mafe tied his most pressures generated in a game in his career nfl research the bengals did not allow a single touchdown in week 2 at the texans their first game allowing no touchdowns since week 3 2022 at the jets cincinnati broke a franchise long and nfl long streak of 65 consecutive games allowing at least one touchdown the bills now own the longest active streak in the nfl having allowed at least one touchdown in 47 consecutive games back to top kevin patra s takeaways patriots splash big plays to run away from pittsburgh drake maye didn t author a particularly pretty game but the quarterback threw a trove of big plays to move the ball against an experienced steelers defense maye connected on passes of 29 29 30 and 63 yards the pats also generated big runs starting with treveyon henderson s 39 yard td sprint and rhamondre stevenson added a 24 yarder early in the second half the pats had several miscues that kept the game closer than it could have been stevenson fumbled in plus territory on the opening drive and maye later threw an interception in scoring range coming off a disappointing week 1 maye didn t fully bounce back missing several plays he made a year ago and he wasn t comfortable in the pocket behind an offensive line that struggled especially as injuries struck however the splash plays highlighted by a 63 yarder to romeo doubs after maye escaped the pocket were a welcomed sight after last week in week 1 the qb didn t have a pass play of 20 plus yards on sunday he generated four the offense still has strides to make but it s much easier after a win that avoids an 0 2 start pats d gets in on the big plays it wasn t just the offense that sprayed big plays on the foxborough turf the new england defensive line dominated steelers blockers blasting aaron rodgers repeatedly the pats biggest plays came when they destroyed the 42 year old qb with the steelers in field goal range on third and 7 christian elliss walloped rodgers for a sack and forced fumble the ball bounced around for an eventual loss of 36 yards forcing a punt then early in the fourth quarter christian barmore hit rodgers forcing another fumble that elijah ponder scooped up for a touchdown effectively putting the game away for good measure rookie gabe jacas grabbed a flubbed catch for an interception that ensured the steelers wouldn t find pay dirt on sunday the pats allowed just 235 yards and 2 of 12 on third downs ugly day for steelers offense every aspect was bad for pittsburgh s offense the o line got walloped troy fautanu had a forgettable afternoon and guard spencer anderson was destroyed allowing seven qb pressures and a sack per next gen stats aaron rodgers was never comfortable struggled to maneuver muddy pockets and looked every bit of 42 on sunday before sitting for the final drive he completed 23 of 39 attempts for 187 yards threw an int and took four sacks the passing attack couldn t get out of its own way with drops and off the mark passes being the most memorable plays dk metcalf continued his atrocious start to the season catching four passes on nine targets for 27 yards with several miscues christian gonzalez usually locks up wr1s but right now metcalf is barely playing like a wr3 the run game was absent from start to finish putting the offense in bad down and distance situations mike mccarthy has a lot to figure out after two uninspiring offensive performances to open the season next gen stats insight for patriots steelers via nfl pro the patriots defense blitzed the steelers on 18 total dropbacks their most in a game since week 10 of 2024 when sending extra pass rushers they held the steelers to 43 passing yards 2 7 yards per attempt and a 22 2 success rate while also recording eight pressures two sacks and one interception nfl research the steelers scored just three points against the patriots tied for the second fewest by any team in which aaron rodgers was the starting quarterback rodgers finished with 187 passing yards no touchdowns and one interception his fifth straight start with one passing touchdown or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways packers avoid first 0 2 start in 20 years with gutty effort it wasn t pretty but green bay is in the win column in 2026 jordan love threw for just 145 yards the packers offense converted one of nine third downs and picked up at least one first down on only four of 12 drives and green bay committed 14 accepted penalties but a win is a win down 17 7 in the fourth quarter love and co strung together one of their better drives of the afternoon picking up four first downs with help from a field flipping azareye 39 h thomas defensive pass interference call and finding the end zone to pull within three a quick stop and skyy moore punt return later and green bay was in position to tie the game with a field goal after another three down stop in overtime with two consecutive sacks shared by four packers defenders green bay rode backup backs kaleb johnson and chris brooks into gang green territory where after another awful jets penalty and matthew golden first down trey smack smacked home the game winning field goal sunday s turnaround came in stark contrast to how the packers finished their season opener against minnesota when they blew a two score lead and lost by three scores green bay fans will be happy to sheath their knives for lafleur ahead of the home opener on thursday night as the pack have avoided starting 0 2 for the first time since 2006 jets collapse down stretch blow chance to start 2 0 on a gray afternoon in the meadowlands new york was in position to ride out an ugly win over the visiting packers through three quarters the jets had made fewer mistakes avoided nasty injuries and adjusted well to what green bay was throwing at them then fortunes turned up 14 7 new york benefitted from a marshawn lloyd fumble at the packers 18 yard line but the jets went three and out and neglected to go for it on fourth and 1 from the 9 setting up a field goal later tied 17 17 after two green bay scoring drives with the ball at the 50 yard line under two minutes to the jets decided to try a fourth and 1 dive the risk didn t pay off as braelon allen was stuffed at the line the packers didn t make anything of the turnover on downs but took their momentum into overtime where geno smith was sacked on back to back plays and new york punted the ball and game back to the pack for the second straight year the jets have outplayed their opponents in their home opener aaron rodgers steelers in 2025 only to fall just short in the end after such a positive start the loss felt like a familiar finish for aaron glenn s group and serves as a missed opportunity for new york to start 2 0 for the first time in 11 years sloppy outing for both sides matt lafleur and aaron glenn will use this game film as teaching tape teaching their players what not to do lest they play a more disciplined opponent in ensuing weeks the packers and jets combined for 27 accepted penalties for 289 yards an ugly affair all around green bay and new york kept each other in the game with ill timed fouls for the packers that s 26 penalties in two games only three teams have incurred more accepted fouls in the first two games of a campaign the weather might not have contributed to the poor discipline but it surely had an effect on the poor hands in this one the teams combined for eight fumbles five by green bay three by new york though only one was lost the jets special teams which had been key in their week 1 victory was super shaky with isaiah williams muffing two punts and new york surrendering a 63 yard skyy moore punt return leading to the packers game tying field goal drive next gen stats insight for jets packers via nfl pro packers pass rusher lukas van ness generated a career high nine pressures against the jets recording five of them in under 2 5 seconds tied for the third most by a packers defender since 2020 nfl research the jets blew a 17 7 fourth quarter lead in their week 2 overtime loss to the packers it was their first time blowing a double digit fourth quarter lead since week 9 of 2020 vs the patriots they had won 14 straight games in which they held a double digit fourth quarter lead entering week 2 back to top nick shook s takeaways browns pull off the improbable cleveland began sunday s contest exhibiting many of the same discouraging signs that doomed them in week 1 operational errors and penalties general disorganization and an inability to convert in key offensive situations unlike last week the browns defense showed up and kept the game within reach opening the door for deshaun watson and the rest of cleveland s offense to find a rhythm in the second half watson leaned on the youngsters around him connecting with rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston to keep drives moving using harold fannin as a safety valve and even converting a couple of third downs with his legs it was far from pretty but cleveland s offense pieced together two touchdown drives in the second half including a 12 play 68 yard march that ate up 6 07 and ended with blake whiteheart sneaking across the field for a wide open connection with watson for a 17 yard go ahead touchdown the browns had plenty to overcome sunday including poor offensive line play early self inflicted errors and a two hour weather delay and managed to outlast the buccaneers with a defensive stand amid a driving rain it s only one win but it will be a joyous flight back home to cleveland mayfield looks very uncomfortable in this offense after eight quarters of evidence it s pretty clear that baker mayfield hasn t found a comfortable place in offensive coordinator zac robinson s scheme tampa bay s approach was peculiar at times sunday producing sequences that saw repeated screens and swing passes to running backs while avoiding attempting to stretch the field much until late in the contest mayfield looks skittish in the pocket regardless of situation hesitating to fire and often trying to buy more time to survey as initial concepts fail to produce clear passing opportunities or he fails to spot them when they do come open it s only two weeks but it s fair to say the buccaneers offense looks a lot like the 2025 falcons also directed by robinson lacking consistent identity and intent while being operated by a quarterback who doesn t appear to be relaxed or confident that s not a good sign for a team aiming to climb back to the top of the nfc south qb change delayed for a week entering sunday s game many browns fans were eager to watch primarily because they believed it would be the last time they d have to suffer through an ugly deshaun watson led performance before coach todd monken decided to bench watson for shedeur sanders well they ll have to enjoy cleveland s win with a bit of bitterness because watson performed well enough to justify starting again next week he was far from perfect his performance is best described as fine but watson played an integral role in cleveland managing to mount a comeback confidently firing toward kc concepcion denzel boston and even isaiah bond for one key completion along the sideline and on must have downs in the fourth quarter watson kept the chains moving there s certainly no guarantee his success was anything more than a one week aberration but he looked much more like a quarterback capable of playing in the nfl this week than he did in week 1 when monken breaks down watson s performance to reporters this week his positive remarks will be much more believable next gen stats insight for browns buccaneers via nfl pro deshaun watson completed 24 of 30 pass attempts for 238 yards and two touchdowns averaging 0 25 epa per dropback his most as a brown and most since week 12 of the 2020 season nfl research denzel boston joined bobby mitchell and andre davis as the only browns with a receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games boston s first two receiving touchdowns went for 46 yards and 55 yards respectively he is the fourth player in nfl history to have a 45 plus yard receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games joining sammy white 1976 mac haik 1968 and bob hayes 1965 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways hurts comes in clutch after tough outing it wasn t the best day at the office for jalen hurts but when met with a deadline needing to lead a game winning drive with 1 56 remaining the super bowl lix most valuable player delivered hurts who threw a bad interception in the end zone during his first possession and another pick during the drive immediately preceding his last led philly on a nine play 65 yard drive to take the lead and the win from the titans he did so by becoming laser focused on devonta smith throwing to the eagles no 1 wide receiver on four of eight passes including a pretty 19 yard gain on third and 6 to set up philadelphia at the goal line on the next play he hit darius cooper for the wideout s first career touchdown to propel the eagles to a surprisingly difficult win he wasn t nearly perfect sunday going 26 of 37 for 264 yards two touchdowns and the two picks but he was clutch as ever when called upon to leave titans fans with some achy breaky hearts titans defense finally runs out of gas tennessee couldn t end drives quickly in the first half against philly allowing the eagles to dominate the time of possession with three drives that all took 11 or more plays and over 6 minutes 30 seconds although the titans did allow touchdowns on the second and third drives they made a massive early stop setting themselves up to take a 7 0 lead after amani hooker intercepted jalen hurts and returned it 92 yards to philadelphia s 10 yard line robert saleh s crew buckled down after halftime finally gaining some momentum with a pair of three and outs in the third quarter to no one s surprise jeffery simmons led the way making life difficult for hurts racking up seven pressures jacob martin had six and jermaine johnson had four as hurts seemed to regularly be running for his life and forced into poor or difficult throws it was simmons wrapping his arms around hurts as the qb threw his second pick of the day which eventually set the titans up for a go ahead joey slye field goal with just under two minutes remaining unfortunately a gassed tennessee defense that was on the field for over 13 minutes more than its offense couldn t hold up against philly s last second heroics after that eagles winning by skin of their teeth philadelphia found itself shorthanded right off the bat against the titans saquon barkley suffered a stinger on his first carry of the game after being stuffed at the line of scrimmage and having multiple big bodies land on him tight end dallas goedert then injured his knee on the second play of the second quarter barkley came back for the second half but only handled three more carries as he was clearly affected perhaps those setbacks disrupted philly s game plan but the offense fell into a deep sleep in the second half before miraculously waking up for some last drive magic that left philly s defense to keep it close enough for a win and vic fangio s crew luckily abided the eagles will certainly want some plays back especially after a few woeful missed tackles while allowing tennessee to go 84 yards to take the lead toward the end of the fourth quarter but the eagles ultimately held the titans to a field goal late just as they stumbled last week but recovered to stop a commanders two point conversion toward game s end to preserve a win it s been a high wire act thus far as the eagles try to find their groove but 2 0 is 2 0 next gen stats insight for eagles titans via nfl pro devonta smith caught six of eight targets outside the numbers for 77 yards and a touchdown including two sideline catches for 24 yards more than he had all of last season nfl research jalen hurts led his eighth fourth quarter comeback since 2023 tied for second most in the league back to top nick shook s takeaways waddle explodes a quiet debut muted some of the excitement surrounding jaylen waddle denver s prized offseason acquisition but that was merely a prelude to a loud introduction at mile high on sunday waddle went off in the broncos comeback win catching a 49 yard strike from bo nix early in the second quarter to set up denver s offense at jacksonville s 1 yard line and although denver settled for a field goal on that drive waddle was only getting started he logged six more catches on the day with four gaining double digit yardage and almost all of them making a key difference in denver s offensive awakening for one afternoon the broncos were able to realize the dream they d carried with them for years spending their sunday watching a deep threat thrive with a quarterback capable of finding him it s crucial to denver s offensive arc in 2026 one that can t rely too heavily on nix s playmaking or its stable of running backs the broncos will be at their best when waddle is a central figure and they saw firsthand how he can change their outlook on sunday jacksonville finally falters it s been quite some time since the jaguars fell apart in a regular season game sunday s performance wasn t quite a disintegration but it was a disappointing finish for an offense that could do no wrong in week 1 and suddenly couldn t find a method of success to counter denver s comeback after a strong first half that saw trevor lawrence pepper denver s defense with pinpoint passes lawrence regressed to the quarterback who too frequently attempts highly questionable passes and pays the price for it his interception swung momentum in the broncos favor and gave denver permission to hunt him for the rest of the day and the jaguars failed to adjust it all starts up front for jacksonville which struggled with denver s increased defensive aggression in the second half and surrendered a qb pressure rate of 45 2 hampering a passing attack that has been among the best in the nfl since the midpoint of the 2025 season fortunately it happened in week 2 against a top tier defense providing the jaguars with tape to correct they just need to ensure it doesn t become a weekly occurrence broncos bounce back save for one drive the broncos looked horribly overmatched in week 1 their offensive operation wasn t great in the first half sunday either with cbs cameras repeatedly showing a demonstrably frustrated davis webb shouting angrily on the sideline after their latest failure all of that changed though when cornerback riley moss slid in front of a lawrence pass in the fourth quarter and intercepted it breathing new life into the broncos and their anxious fans nix and co capitalized covering 64 yards in 10 plays and finishing with a well designed play action pass to fullback nate adkins for a touchdown to tie it at 13 defensively the broncos regained their identity after the moss interception shutting down a jaguars offense that moved freely between the 20s earlier in the contest and nearly intercepting lawrence a second time the following drive a five play 56 yard march that ended in a jonah coleman rushing score from 3 yards out almost seemed inevitable in one half the broncos returned to form and nix finally found some consistency along the way next gen stats insight for jaguars broncos via nfl pro bo nix completed five of six passes outside the tackle box for 110 yards one touchdown and a perfect passer rating 158 3 plus a completion percentage over expected of 26 nfl research bo nix recorded his fifth career win when trailing by double digits at any point which ties lamar jackson for the second most such wins since nix entered the league in 2024 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways cousins gets it going for raiders kirk cousins opened the 2026 season dealing when he threw three touchdowns in last week s win over the dolphins the critique was his ineffectiveness on deep and intermediate passes 10 plus air yards he rectified that against the chargers throwing all three of his tds on deep and intermediate targets going 8 of 12 for 181 yards on such attempts one of those incompletions was an interception but it was only due to tre tucker slipping on the route cousins who will fool no one into thinking he s a mobile threat at this point stood tall on multiple throws under duress and he ably exposed los angeles defense despite las vegas failing to piece together a running game ashton jeanty averaged only 2 3 yards per carry on 21 attempts it wasn t all cousins of course tucker gave the chargers secondary fits for his second career 100 yard receiving game and cody white elevated placeholder for fernando mendoza or not cousins is leading las vegas to victories mcdaniel s offense is m i a the chargers fired offensive greg roman after scoring a combined 15 points in their last two playoff games and replaced him with mike mcdaniel who was expected to elevate los angeles offense to a new echelon as he did for several years coaching the dolphins that has not nearly been the result thus far the chargers have been held to 14 points in each of their opening losses the operation was sloppy across the board on sunday against las vegas much of the blame will rightfully be laid at justin herbert s feet he fumbled the ball three times half of the team s six times coughing it up although the chargers only lost one of those he wasn t able to find a rhythm early which caused l a to turn to omarion hampton to get something going 15 carries for 70 yards in the first half but when hampton slowed during the final two quarters with 24 yards on another eight carries the chargers really quieted down herbert finished 15 of 27 for 192 yards one touchdown two interceptions and a 59 5 passer rating there was ugliness everywhere though herbert s first pick happened because david njoku dropped the ball and right tackle joe alt committed four penalties trailing by three and facing a third and 1 toward the end of the third quarter the chargers self sabotaged when jake slaughter accidentally snapped the ball into tre harris legs as the receiver went in motion simply nothing went smoothly for the new look chargers offense chargers must take hard look at themselves it is not an overreaction to say the chargers are in deep deep trouble they have looked that bad and their upcoming schedule is that brutal los angeles offense as mentioned is in a state of disarray and the defense has made far too many mistakes in the first two weeks against offenses that are not considered world beaters now winless heading into week 3 the chargers are set to face a murderers row of opponents they play the bills seahawks broncos chiefs rams texans and ravens over the next seven games with a bye in week 7 there are no easy games in the nfl but jim harbaugh and co opened the season with a pair of matchups they were expected to dominate now it s difficult to find their first win if they don t rapidly improve their quality of play next gen stats insight for raiders chargers via touchdown you get a touchdown christian mccaffrey and purdy got the party started with a pair of td runs in the first half before the scoreboard blew wide open in the third quarter with george kittle kyle juszczyk and mccaffrey finding the end zone purdy who was replaced by mac jones midway through the fourth quarter finished his banner day 20 of 22 passing for 287 yards two touchdowns with no interceptions while leading the team in rushing with 30 yards and another score on three carries milestone day for mccaffrey kittle on a day that was all about kyle shanahan s offense it was no shock marked his 600th career reception the 11th tight end in league history to accomplish that feat fins find offensive improvement the miami offense took unquestioned steps forward from last week s opener at least early in the contest the unit s three first half drives all resulted in field goal tries with riley patterson converting twice the dolphins outgained the 49ers in the first half 165 yards to 125 and held the ball for nearly nine more minutes than the home team for as well as malik willis and de 39 von achane played the difference going into the locker room came in the red zone where miami straight possessions before a garbage time 77 yard touchdown connection between willis and ryan miller there s still a lot to clean up that ll likely be a common theme for this young team throughout really quieted down herbert finished 15 of 27 for 192 yards one touchdown two interceptions and a 59 5 passer rating there was ugliness everywhere though herbert s first pick happened because david accidentally snapped the ball into tre harris legs as the receiver went in motion simply nothing went smoothly for the new look chargers offense chargers must take hard look at themselves it is not an overreaction to say the chargers are in deep deep trouble they have looked that bad and their upcoming schedule is that brutal los angeles offense as mentioned is in a state of disarray and the defense has made far too many mistakes in the first two weeks against offenses that are not considered world beaters now winless heading into week 3 the chargers are set to face a murderers row of opponents they play the bills seahawks broncos chiefs rams texans and ravens over the next seven games with a bye in week 7 there are no easy games in the nfl but jim harbaugh and co opened the season with a pair of matchups they were expected to dominate now it s difficult to find their first win if they don t rapidly improve their quality of play next gen stats insight for raiders chargers via second most of his career along with two touchdowns lock completed all eight of his play action attempts for 71 yards his most play action completions as a seahawk nfl research the seahawks set a franchise record with their 12th straight win including playoffs dating back to week 12 2025 seattle also extended its win streak against the cardinals to 10 games the longest active win streak by any nfl team vs one opponent back to top dan parr s takeaways cowboys offense bounces back after a week 1 performance against the giants that left plenty to be desired dallas dropped 37 points on washington and scored on seven of eight possessions to secure its first victory of the season it was the form many folks were expecting to see from the jump for a unit that ranked second in total yards last season dak prescott went 26 of 31 84 with 279 yards and four tds he set the franchise record for career td passes 249 with his final scoring toss of the day a 24 yard bomb to ceedee lamb who finished with eight catches for 153 yards and two tds the cowboys still need to get the ground game going ranking near the bottom of the league with 135 rushing yards in their first two games but sunday s showing gives them something to build with a trip to brazil to face the ravens up next daniels woes won t go away we re once again being robbed of witnessing one of the most electric playmakers in the game after an injury plagued 2025 season jayden daniels left sunday s game with a dislocated left elbow he suffered on the last play of the first half he dislocated the same elbow last season and missed three games before returning only to aggravate the injury in his first game back last season washington went 3 7 without daniels in 2025 averaging 23 points per game in those contests the commanders still had life once backup marcus mariota entered the game at qb on sunday but they managed to score just 10 points with him at the helm which weren t nearly enough against dak and co it s not going to get any easier next week with the reigning champion seahawks and their suffocating defense visiting washington cowboys defense still has work to do while holding a team to 20 points is respectable washington posted 203 yards in the second quarter alone prior to jayden daniels injury on the final play of the half the commanders clearly had figured out how to attack dallas with daniels ability to create with his legs playing a leading role the new look secondary took a hit too with cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot leaving the game due to injury first year defensive coordinator christian parker now has a week to come up with a better plan for keeping a dual threat quarterback in check two time mvp lamar jackson awaits dallas in week 3 afl nfl merger in 1970 back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways efficiency name of 49ers game five drives five touchdowns san francisco s offense was something to behold sunday against a young dolphins defense finding the paint on five consecutive drives to build a 35 6 lead after three quarters brock purdy never seemed stressed channeling his best oprah winfrey impression you get a touchdown you get a touchdown christian mccaffrey and purdy got the party started with a pair of td runs in the first half before the scoreboard blew wide open in the third quarter with george kittle kyle juszczyk and mccaffrey finding the end zone purdy who was replaced by mac jones midway through the fourth quarter finished his banner day 20 of 22 passing for 287 yards two touchdowns with no interceptions while leading the team in rushing with 30 yards and another score on three carries milestone day for mccaffrey kittle on a day that was all about kyle shanahan s offense it was no shock that the heartbeat of the supporting cast shined brightest christian mccaffrey had just 67 scrimmage yards but made the most of his touches near the goal line his pair of rushing scores put him in elite company as he became the third player in nfl history to record 50 plus scrimmage tds with multiple teams joining hall of famers marshall faulk rams 85 colts 51 and randy moss vikings 92 patriots 50 but perhaps the most exciting aspect of san francisco s offensive frenzy was george kittle s return to prominence after missing six games in 2025 with an achilles injury and a modest week 1 outing in australia the seven time pro bowler led the team with 80 receiving yards and his first touchdown a 12 yard reception on a busted coverage since the injury kittle s third catch of the day also marked his 600th career reception the 11th tight end in league history to accomplish that feat fins find offensive improvement the miami offense took unquestioned steps forward from last week s opener at least early in the contest the unit s three first half drives all resulted in field goal tries with riley patterson converting twice the dolphins outgained the 49ers in the first half 165 yards to 125 and held the ball for nearly nine more minutes than the home team for as well as malik willis and de 39 von achane played the difference going into the locker room came in the red zone where miami struggled to convert with a pair of drives stalling at the san francisco 10 and 5 yard lines unfortunately the story changed in the second half miami failed to amass more than 15 yards on four straight possessions before a garbage time 77 yard touchdown connection between willis and ryan miller there s still a lot to clean up that ll likely be a common theme for this young team throughout the season but there were definite positives early in this contest that willis and co can build on in addition miami s improvement on third down its 47 conversion rate up from 20 in week 1 was another step in the right direction next gen stats insight for dolphins 49ers via nfl pro brock purdy completed all 10 of his downfield pass attempts 10 air yards against the dolphins for 211 yards and a touchdown it was the most completions without an incompletion by a qb on downfield passes since week 5 2021 carson wentz vs baltimore nfl research brock purdy recorded a 149 1 passer rating 287 passing yards two passing touchdowns in the 49ers week 2 win over miami this was his eighth career start with a 140 passer rating tying joe montana for second in 49ers history including playoffs behind only steve young 13 only lamar jackson has more such games 12 than purdy since the latter entered the league in 2022 back to top grant gordon s takeaways visions of chiefs of old shine with a prime time audience looking on for the second week in a row kicker harrison butker booted a 40 yard game winner in overtime to send the chiefs to a 2 0 start it s quite the difference from the 0 2 genesis of last year s disastrous 6 11 showing it wasn t the prettiest win but it was a glimpse of what used to be with patrick mahomes producing a glistening line of 32 of 47 passing for 382 yards three touchdowns and a 114 0 rating the first of those three touchdowns went to travis kelce who turned in nine receptions for 101 yards it was the first time mahomes topped 300 passing yards and kelce had 100 plus receiving in the same game since week 7 2023 fresh face kenneth walker added 117 yards on the ground though he didn t run as wild as he did in his debut against the broncos for that matter neither did the chiefs instead they eked this one out which might be the best of signs for k c to come having gone 11 0 in one score games in 2024 the chiefs were an nfl worst 1 9 in such games last season now mahomes and co are 1 0 in nail biters and perfect through two weeks it s a long road but this is a good beginning banged up colts lose ot heartbreaker there s been no team in the nfl that s waited longer for a win than the colts unfortunately for indianapolis it waited excruciatingly longer for its ninth straight loss with an injury to alec pierce exposing the colts offensive depth even more sauce gardner and charvarius ward also dealt with injuries that hamstrung the defense it made the colts ability to hang around sunday all the more impressive but the struggles and losses are piling up jonathan taylor was a stud at times 24 carries for 92 yards two touchdowns but corralled for large swaths in others josh downs came up pretty big seven receptions for 72 yards tyler warren was relatively quiet aside from the first td of the game and daniel jones simply couldn t rely on laquon treadwell or keenan allen in more than four quarters of football indy totaled 329 yards of offense while its defense gave up north of 520 fortune isn t smiling on shane steichen s team right now it will need to in a hurry treadwell s topsy turvy play emblematic with ample time left in the fourth quarter nbc s cris collinsworth proclaimed a pivotal upcoming down as the play of the game it wasn t there were about 17 more plays of the game thereafter perhaps the most symbolic of the craziness of the evening was 2016 first round pick turned journeyman laquon treadwell s 48 yard reception in overtime with the colts trailing 30 27 daniel jones and co took over and the qb heaved a long ball to treadwell treadwell bobbled the ball before collecting it fell to the ground sprang up and had possession punched out by nohl williams and recovered by the chiefs game over nope replay showed that l 39 jarius sneed s hand had glanced treadwell s side after the receiver had established final control so there was no fumble now it was the chiefs with their backs against the wall they held though and after indy tied it up on a spencer shrader field goal k c marched down for the game winner the colts held the lead three times in the first half but trailed throughout the second after patrick mahomes navigated an 80 yard go ahead drive to begin the third quarter it looked like the chiefs would pull away at 27 20 but it wasn t to be despite mahomes and co outgaining jones squad 523 329 this one went down to the final play the chiefs emerging as 2 0 looking like their old selves meanwhile the colts will keep scratching their helmets wondering what else can go wrong before they get back in the win column next gen stats insight for colts chiefs via nfl pro creed humphrey did not allow a pressure across 51 pass blocking snaps against the colts his second consecutive game without a pressure allowed nfl research the colts extended their nfl long losing streak to nine games the streak began in week 12 2025 when indianapolis lost to kansas city in overtime back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: Philadelphia Eagles training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Jeremy Bergman provides a refresher on the Philadelphia Eagles' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the philadelphia eagles offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location novacare complex philadelphia fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cincinnati bengals 7 30 p m et on thursday aug 7 week 2 vs cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 at new york jets 7 30 p m et on friday aug 22 2025 schedule note the eagles are the only team currently scheduled to play on five or more days of the week during the 2025 regular season sunday monday thursday friday saturday the chargers are set to play on four different days with the possibility of a fifth if their week 17 game currently tbd takes place on saturday nfl research what you need to know 1 there aren t many holes on the eagles roster entering the 2025 season that s what you d expect from the reigning super bowl champions with one of the youngest nuclei in football but there are a number of questions to be answered on the defensive side of the ball after a slew of departures out are josh sweat oren burks darius slay and chauncey gardner johnson four super bowl starters plus milton williams and the retired brandon graham that s 4 070 combined defensive snaps regular season and postseason and a lot of experience for which to compensate even for roster building whiz howie roseman and defensive guru vic fangio philly has backfilled well with its own talent plus a few notable additions in first rounder jihaad campbell pass rushers josh uche and azeez ojulari and cornerback adoree 39 jackson but how and how quickly the new look unit gels will be the focus of camp 2 what does saquon barkley s sequel look like after his historic 2 000 yard debut season with the eagles the madden nfl 26 cover athlete has reached the pinnacle of his sport with not much left to conquer the super bowl champ s renegotiated 20 6m aav deal is now the most expensive ever for a running back philly returns the same offense this season priming barkley for another opportunity to gash defenses behind arguably the league s top offensive line the eagles will likely lighten the star rb s load in training camp and preseason potentially save for an aug 13 joint practice with cleveland but if he shows the same burst and ability after an offseason of celebration could we be looking at our first two time 2k rusher 3 the eagles boast great continuity on the offensive roster but they ll have a new play caller and coordinator in 2025 kevin patullo was promoted to offensive coordinator after kellen moore left to be the saints head coach essentially minutes after their super bowl victory patullo will be philly s fourth offensive coordinator in as many years under nick sirianni shane steichen left for indy after the 2022 campaign and brian johnson was bounced after 23 the annual turnover at oc is historic sirianni is the first head coach to have four different ocs excluding interims in a four season span for one team since the merger and yet the eagles offense remains remarkably proficient year to year will that change with patullo s elevation he s been around the team since 2021 through the highs and lows of two super bowl berths and one embarrassing collapse our first glimpse at philly s identity under patullo will come in camp this summer

news_mentions.description: Which players should you scoop up to give your fantasy team a boost heading into Week 3? Matt Okada spotlights the top waiver-wire targets at each position, including Broncos RB Jonah Coleman and Panthers QB Bryce Young.
news_mentions.body_text: two sundays of fantasy football in the books time for the week 3 waiver wire some of the names listed below might end up winning leagues at the very least several of them could be difference makers in the immediate future do not take the waiver wire for granted this is where the rubber meets the road in our imaginary game i ll be here every week from now until fantasy championships hope to have you along for the full ride let s win some hardware notes players must be rostered in less than 60 of espn leagues to be eligible for the column all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted top 15 overall waiver wire targets and here are my top waiver wire targets by position quarterbacks running backs washington commanders rb rachaad white is rostered in 65 percent of leagues above the 60 threshold of eligibility for this file but he was exceptional on sunday both on the ground and as a receiver and should be scooped up if available wide receivers san francisco 49ers wr deebo samuel is already rostered in 68 of leagues above the 60 threshold of eligibility for this file but he might be worth adding in the other 32 with de zhaun stribling out for multiple months tight ends defenses
