pressures sack and dylan fairchild five qb pressures sack all struggled the good news is that when the bengals put up fewer than 300 yards in years past they usually took an l in 2026 they re 2 0 while the offense irons things out next gen stats insight for bengals texans via nfl pro the bengals generated 27 pressures on 62 dropbacks 43 5 the most pressures generated in a single game by the bengals since al golden took over as the bengals defensive coordinator last season five bengals recorded four or more pressures in week 2 including jonathan allen seven boye mafe seven cedric johnson six cashius howell five and dexter lawrence four allen recorded his most pressures in a game in the last four seasons while mafe tied his most pressures generated in a game in his career nfl research the bengals did not allow a single touchdown in week 2 at the texans their first game allowing no touchdowns since week 3 2022 at the jets cincinnati broke a franchise long and nfl long streak of 65 consecutive games allowing at least one touchdown the bills now own the longest active streak in the nfl having allowed at least one touchdown in 47 consecutive games back to top kevin patra s takeaways patriots splash big plays to run away from pittsburgh drake maye didn t author a particularly pretty game but the quarterback threw a trove of big plays to move the ball against an experienced steelers defense maye connected on passes of 29 29 30 and 63 yards the pats also generated big runs starting with treveyon henderson s 39 yard td sprint and rhamondre stevenson added a 24 yarder early in the second half the pats had several miscues that kept the game closer than it could have been stevenson fumbled in plus territory on the opening drive and maye later threw an interception in scoring range coming off a disappointing week 1 maye didn t fully bounce back missing several plays he made a year ago and he wasn t comfortable in the pocket behind an offensive line that struggled especially as injuries struck however the splash plays highlighted by a 63 yarder to romeo doubs after maye escaped the pocket were a welcomed sight after last week in week 1 the qb didn t have a pass play of 20 plus yards on sunday he generated four the offense still has strides to make but it s much easier after a win that avoids an 0 2 start pats d gets in on the big plays it wasn t just the offense that sprayed big plays on the foxborough turf the new england defensive line dominated steelers blockers blasting aaron rodgers repeatedly the pats biggest plays came when they destroyed the 42 year old qb with the steelers in field goal range on third and 7 christian elliss walloped rodgers for a sack and forced fumble the ball bounced around for an eventual loss of 36 yards forcing a punt then early in the fourth quarter christian barmore hit rodgers forcing another fumble that elijah ponder scooped up for a touchdown effectively putting the game away for good measure rookie gabe jacas grabbed a flubbed catch for an interception that ensured the steelers wouldn t find pay dirt on sunday the pats allowed just 235 yards and 2 of 12 on third downs ugly day for steelers offense every aspect was bad for pittsburgh s offense the o line got walloped troy fautanu had a forgettable afternoon and guard spencer anderson was destroyed allowing seven qb pressures and a sack per next gen stats aaron rodgers was never comfortable struggled to maneuver muddy pockets and looked every bit of 42 on sunday before sitting for the final drive he completed 23 of 39 attempts for 187 yards threw an int and took four sacks the passing attack couldn t get out of its own way with drops and off the mark passes being the most memorable plays dk metcalf continued his atrocious start to the season catching four passes on nine targets for 27 yards with several miscues christian gonzalez usually locks up wr1s but right now metcalf is barely playing like a wr3 the run game was absent from start to finish putting the offense in bad down and distance situations mike mccarthy has a lot to figure out after two uninspiring offensive performances to open the season next gen stats insight for patriots steelers via nfl pro the patriots defense blitzed the steelers on 18 total dropbacks their most in a game since week 10 of 2024 when sending extra pass rushers they held the steelers to 43 passing yards 2 7 yards per attempt and a 22 2 success rate while also recording eight pressures two sacks and one interception nfl research the steelers scored just three points against the patriots tied for the second fewest by any team in which aaron rodgers was the starting quarterback rodgers finished with 187 passing yards no touchdowns and one interception his fifth straight start with one passing touchdown or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways packers avoid first 0 2 start in 20 years with gutty effort it wasn t pretty but green bay is in the win column in 2026 jordan love threw for just 145 yards the packers offense converted one of nine third downs and picked up at least one first down on only four of 12 drives and green bay committed 14 accepted penalties but a win is a win down 17 7 in the fourth quarter love and co strung together one of their better drives of the afternoon picking up four first downs with help from a field flipping azareye 39 h thomas defensive pass interference call and finding the end zone to pull within three a quick stop and skyy moore punt return later and green bay was in position to tie the game with a field goal after another three down stop in overtime with two consecutive sacks shared by four packers defenders green bay rode backup backs kaleb johnson and chris brooks into gang green territory where after another awful jets penalty and matthew golden first down trey smack smacked home the game winning field goal sunday s turnaround came in stark contrast to how the packers finished their season opener against minnesota when they blew a two score lead and lost by three scores green bay fans will be happy to sheath their knives for lafleur ahead of the home opener on thursday night as the pack have avoided starting 0 2 for the first time since 2006 jets collapse down stretch blow chance to start 2 0 on a gray afternoon in the meadowlands new york was in position to ride out an ugly win over the visiting packers through three quarters the jets had made fewer mistakes avoided nasty injuries and adjusted well to what green bay was throwing at them then fortunes turned up 14 7 new york benefitted from a marshawn lloyd fumble at the packers 18 yard line but the jets went three and out and neglected to go for it on fourth and 1 from the 9 setting up a field goal later tied 17 17 after two green bay scoring drives with the ball at the 50 yard line under two minutes to the jets decided to try a fourth and 1 dive the risk didn t pay off as braelon allen was stuffed at the line the packers didn t make anything of the turnover on downs but took their momentum into overtime where geno smith was sacked on back to back plays and new york punted the ball and game back to the pack for the second straight year the jets have outplayed their opponents in their home opener aaron rodgers steelers in 2025 only to fall just short in the end after such a positive start the loss felt like a familiar finish for aaron glenn s group and serves as a missed opportunity for new york to start 2 0 for the first time in 11 years sloppy outing for both sides matt lafleur and aaron glenn will use this game film as teaching tape teaching their players what not to do lest they play a more disciplined opponent in ensuing weeks the packers and jets combined for 27 accepted penalties for 289 yards an ugly affair all around green bay and new york kept each other in the game with ill timed fouls for the packers that s 26 penalties in two games only three teams have incurred more accepted fouls in the first two games of a campaign the weather might not have contributed to the poor discipline but it surely had an effect on the poor hands in this one the teams combined for eight fumbles five by green bay three by new york though only one was lost the jets special teams which had been key in their week 1 victory was super shaky with isaiah williams muffing two punts and new york surrendering a 63 yard skyy moore punt return leading to the packers game tying field goal drive next gen stats insight for jets packers via nfl pro packers pass rusher lukas van ness generated a career high nine pressures against the jets recording five of them in under 2 5 seconds tied for the third most by a packers defender since 2020 nfl research the jets blew a 17 7 fourth quarter lead in their week 2 overtime loss to the packers it was their first time blowing a double digit fourth quarter lead since week 9 of 2020 vs the patriots they had won 14 straight games in which they held a double digit fourth quarter lead entering week 2 back to top nick shook s takeaways browns pull off the improbable cleveland began sunday s contest exhibiting many of the same discouraging signs that doomed them in week 1 operational errors and penalties general disorganization and an inability to convert in key offensive situations unlike last week the browns defense showed up and kept the game within reach opening the door for deshaun watson and the rest of cleveland s offense to find a rhythm in the second half watson leaned on the youngsters around him connecting with rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston to keep drives moving using harold fannin as a safety valve and even converting a couple of third downs with his legs it was far from pretty but cleveland s offense pieced together two touchdown drives in the second half including a 12 play 68 yard march that ate up 6 07 and ended with blake whiteheart sneaking across the field for a wide open connection with watson for a 17 yard go ahead touchdown the browns had plenty to overcome sunday including poor offensive line play early self inflicted errors and a two hour weather delay and managed to outlast the buccaneers with a defensive stand amid a driving rain it s only one win but it will be a joyous flight back home to cleveland mayfield looks very uncomfortable in this offense after eight quarters of evidence it s pretty clear that baker mayfield hasn t found a comfortable place in offensive coordinator zac robinson s scheme tampa bay s approach was peculiar at times sunday producing sequences that saw repeated screens and swing passes to running backs while avoiding attempting to stretch the field much until late in the contest mayfield looks skittish in the pocket regardless of situation hesitating to fire and often trying to buy more time to survey as initial concepts fail to produce clear passing opportunities or he fails to spot them when they do come open it s only two weeks but it s fair to say the buccaneers offense looks a lot like the 2025 falcons also directed by robinson lacking consistent identity and intent while being operated by a quarterback who doesn t appear to be relaxed or confident that s not a good sign for a team aiming to climb back to the top of the nfc south qb change delayed for a week entering sunday s game many browns fans were eager to watch primarily because they believed it would be the last time they d have to suffer through an ugly deshaun watson led performance before coach todd monken decided to bench watson for shedeur sanders well they ll have to enjoy cleveland s win with a bit of bitterness because watson performed well enough to justify starting again next week he was far from perfect his performance is best described as fine but watson played an integral role in cleveland managing to mount a comeback confidently firing toward kc concepcion denzel boston and even isaiah bond for one key completion along the sideline and on must have downs in the fourth quarter watson kept the chains moving there s certainly no guarantee his success was anything more than a one week aberration but he looked much more like a quarterback capable of playing in the nfl this week than he did in week 1 when monken breaks down watson s performance to reporters this week his positive remarks will be much more believable next gen stats insight for browns buccaneers via nfl pro deshaun watson completed 24 of 30 pass attempts for 238 yards and two touchdowns averaging 0 25 epa per dropback his most as a brown and most since week 12 of the 2020 season nfl research denzel boston joined bobby mitchell and andre davis as the only browns with a receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games boston s first two receiving touchdowns went for 46 yards and 55 yards respectively he is the fourth player in nfl history to have a 45 plus yard receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games joining sammy white 1976 mac haik 1968 and bob hayes 1965 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways hurts comes in clutch after tough outing it wasn t the best day at the office for jalen hurts but when met with a deadline needing to lead a game winning drive with 1 56 remaining the super bowl lix most valuable player delivered hurts who threw a bad interception in the end zone during his first possession and another pick during the drive immediately preceding his last led philly on a nine play 65 yard drive to take the lead and the win from the titans he did so by becoming laser focused on devonta smith throwing to the eagles no 1 wide receiver on four of eight passes including a pretty 19 yard gain on third and 6 to set up philadelphia at the goal line on the next play he hit darius cooper for the wideout s first career touchdown to propel the eagles to a surprisingly difficult win he wasn t nearly perfect sunday going 26 of 37 for 264 yards two touchdowns and the two picks but he was clutch as ever when called upon to leave titans fans with some achy breaky hearts titans defense finally runs out of gas tennessee couldn t end drives quickly in the first half against philly allowing the eagles to dominate the time of possession with three drives that all took 11 or more plays and over 6 minutes 30 seconds although the titans did allow touchdowns on the second and third drives they made a massive early stop setting themselves up to take a 7 0 lead after amani hooker intercepted jalen hurts and returned it 92 yards to philadelphia s 10 yard line robert saleh s crew buckled down after halftime finally gaining some momentum with a pair of three and outs in the third quarter to no one s surprise jeffery simmons led the way making life difficult for hurts racking up seven pressures jacob martin had six and jermaine johnson had four as hurts seemed to regularly be running for his life and forced into poor or difficult throws it was simmons wrapping his arms around hurts as the qb threw his second pick of the day which eventually set the titans up for a go ahead joey slye field goal with just under two minutes remaining unfortunately a gassed tennessee defense that was on the field for over 13 minutes more than its offense couldn t hold up against philly s last second heroics after that eagles winning by skin of their teeth philadelphia found itself shorthanded right off the bat against the titans saquon barkley suffered a stinger on his first carry of the game after being stuffed at the line of scrimmage and having multiple big bodies land on him tight end dallas goedert then injured his knee on the second play of the second quarter barkley came back for the second half but only handled three more carries as he was clearly affected perhaps those setbacks disrupted philly s game plan but the offense fell into a deep sleep in the second half before miraculously waking up for some last drive magic that left philly s defense to keep it close enough for a win and vic fangio s crew luckily abided the eagles will certainly want some plays back especially after a few woeful missed tackles while allowing tennessee to go 84 yards to take the lead toward the end of the fourth quarter but the eagles ultimately held the titans to a field goal late just as they stumbled last week but recovered to stop a commanders two point conversion toward game s end to preserve a win it s been a high wire act thus far as the eagles try to find their groove but 2 0 is 2 0 next gen stats insight for eagles titans news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: Giants-Rams on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Los Angeles' 28-6 win
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams cruised to their first win of the season in prime time against the New York Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: home sweet home for rams basking in the comfortable confines of sofi stadium the rams returned home from a wayward australian adventure and returned to the form so many thought would be seen matthew stafford looked like the mvp from a season ago davante adams looked like the game tilting wide receiver he was for years and the los angeles defense with aaron donald at the center of it all was sterling as the giants sputtered with jaxson dart lost to a knee injury the rams overcame a couple turnovers and won handily more than a week removed from falling flat in their opener in the outback against the 49ers the rams handled their business and were impressive stafford rebounding from a zero touchdown week 1 proved that was an aberration with 327 passing yards and four touchdown passes that he did so without an injured puka nacua was all the more impressive adams was simply wonderful in the no 1 wr role hauling in a pair of touchdowns and nearly 200 yards while the two headed running game of kyren williams and blake corum also got the job done 164 combined rushing yards in a game that felt like a blowout despite the rams leading by only two scores throughout most of the night l a racked up 481 yards it wasn t perfect there were turnovers and too many missed opportunities but the rams got right on monday happy to be home feeling looking and playing like themselves monday nightmare for giants seven snaps into the game jaxson dart was savagely sandwiched by the rams pass rush and left grasping his left knee that was it for dart on monday before he was ruled out though dart was joined as being questionable to return by wide receiver malik nabers fortunately nabers returned to play after dinging up his shoulder dart never got back in and andrew thomas groin and brian burns ankle were injured late in the game it was a nightmare of an evening for the giants it was reported dart tried to return to action and general manager joe schoen said he d be ok eschewing long term concerns for the time being meanwhile the giants offense was a struggle bus with jameis winston at the helm the running game went nowhere either cam skattebo was the team s leading rusher with just 36 yards on 12 carries and was curiously replaced by najee harris for two runs inside the 10 yard line late in the first half the biggest takeaway in this one is that the giants offense is absolutely lost without dart and considering his injury history that puts new york in a precarious spot donald makes long awaited return it had been 981 days since aaron donald last played a game a wild card playoff loss against the detroit lions he made a much ado return monday highlighted by stopping najee harris on a third down tackle for loss in the second quarter donald contributed three tackles perhaps more importantly as head coach sean mcvay said after halftime he was energizing the rams defense and los angeles was outstanding jaxson dart and jameis winston were constantly harassed each facing 58 plus pressure rates and new york s running game went nowhere held to 52 yards once upon a time before myles garrett was acquired via trade and donald unretired the rams trading with the chiefs for trent mcduffie was their big offseason splash mcduffie was excellent recording his first interception with his new team and piling up four pass breakups allowing no catches on five targets this was a banner homecoming for donald and a suffocating performance from the d davante s still got it puka nacua was inactive with a hip injury and the rams lack of receiving depth was exposed fortunately davante adams let everyone know he s still got plenty left in the tank piling up eight receptions on 10 targets for 195 yards and two touchdowns the catches and yards were tops for his time with the rams but underscored that the 33 year old can still take over a game if need be and l a needed him second year tight end terrance ferguson shrugged off some bad drops and finished with six catches for 54 yards and a td but his contributions largely came after the game had long been settled beyond that nobody else had more than two catches adams was a force even with stafford dialed in him when adams hauled in an 11 yard fade for six in the third quarter it wasn t just vintage adams but it looked like a called shot an inevitable six points that everyone could see coming and simply couldn t be stopped big blues on both sides on the scoreboard it looked like the giants defense was keeping them in the game more so it was a matthew stafford interception and a kyren williams lost fumble on consecutive offensive plays in the second quarter that did the trick sure the nyg d played its part in those but rams mistakes let the giants hang around in the first half new york mustered just two qb pressures of stafford but somehow only trailed 14 3 with jaxson dart injuring his knee the giants collectively seemed to take a punch to the gut all their wind gone as the game felt like a one sided affair no matter how close the score was l a totaled 481 net yards on 60 plays 8 01 yards per play stafford was pressured on just 15 2 of his dropbacks by game s end a week after a sunday night win over the rival cowboys made the giants the talk of the town they re leaving the west coast battered bruised and beaten in lopsided fashion they ll need to mend up and shore up some issues on both sides of the ball next gen stats insight for giants rams via nfl pro giants rookie right guard francis mauigoa held aaron donald to zero qb pressures on 11 matchups donald had one total qb pressure three tackles and a run stuff on 32 snaps in his first game since the 2023 season nfl research davante adams 11 yard touchdown catch was the 95th of his career including playoffs of 20 yards or fewer which tied antonio gates for second all time only jerry rice 112 has more

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered MCL sprain in loss to Rams
news_mentions.description: Quarterback Jaxson Dart, who was knocked out of Monday's 28-6 loss to the Rams with a left knee injury, is believed to have suffered an MCL sprain, NFL Network Insiders Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo reported.
news_mentions.body_text: the giants must contend with an injury to their star quarterback but there s a small sigh of relief for now quarterback jaxson dart who was knocked out of monday s 28 6 loss to the rams with a left knee injury is believed to have suffered an mcl sprain nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo reported rapoport and garafolo added that dart s x rays were negative and he will have an mri on tuesday we ll know more tomorrow that s in the neighborhood of it head coach john harbaugh said when asked about the report of dart s sprained mcl we ll get an mri tomorrow and have a really good feel for it give you more information then dart sustained his injury on a third and 8 on the team s first drive as he dropped back and tossed a deep pass under pressure he was sandwiched between byron young and josaiah stewart upon letting the ball fly with the force of stewart s body pushing dart s knee inward the second year qb grasped at his knee following the incompletion and was seen to by new york s training staff before walking to the sideline under his own power entering the blue tent and later heading to the locker room for further evaluation he s going to be ok general manager joe schoen told espn s laura rutledge during halftime espn later reported during the broadcast that dart actually tried to re enter the game before the team overruled him supporting the notion the qb s injury shouldn t threaten his season at the time of dart s departure he was 3 of 5 for 20 yards jameis winston entered the game in relief of dart and was unable to find any momentum with a suddenly very overmatched giants team the veteran threw for 111 yards and an interception with a 37 3 passer rating on 11 of 27 passing without a passing game to speak of new york found it equally tough going on the ground cam skattebo managed only 36 yards on 12 totes as the team s leading ball carrier we didn t execute harbaugh said of the offense we didn t complete passes we didn t run the ball well we didn t make play down the field we had opportunities and we just didn t do it the giants were ultimately outgained 182 yards to 481 against the rams further highlighting dart s importance to new york now sitting at 1 1 all eyes for big blue will be on dart s prognosis as the team gathers more information

news_mentions.headline: Rams QB Matthew Stafford moves into sixth all time in touchdown passes
news_mentions.description: Matthew Stafford’s Hall of Fame résumé continues to build and build. Stafford’s latest accomplishment came on Monday when the Los Angeles Rams quarterback threw three touchdowns to move into sixth place all time in NFL history.
news_mentions.body_text: matthew stafford s resume for hall of fame enshrinement continues to build and build stafford s latest accomplishment came monday when the los angeles rams quarterback threw four touchdowns in a 28 6 win over the new york giants with the third score moving him into sixth place all time in nfl history davante adams caught stafford s 426th career touchdown pass an 11 yarder in the third quarter to propel stafford past philip rivers 425 he had 427 by the end of the evening it s a humbling feeling stafford told espn s lisa salters after the game aside from being a historic night for stafford it was also a massive rebound performance after he went without a touchdown toss in the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers stafford who led the nfl with 46 touchdown passes last season didn t go a game without a td throw in 2025 now he s bounced back from his atypical showing in fine fashion the 38 year old very much resides in rarefied air the reigning ap nfl mvp has fewer touchdowns than only tom brady first 649 touchdown passes drew brees second 571 peyton manning third 539 aaron rodgers fourth 528 and brett favre fifth 508 i have so much respect for the people that played this game before me and am such a big fan of those guys stafford told salters so just to be in that same breath as those guys is a cool feeling for me stafford s first two td passes monday were to adams and kyren williams with the 10 yarder to williams standing as his 143rd with the rams that put him into second all time in rams history moving him ahead of jim everett 142 stafford in six years with the rams now trails only roman gabriel 154 for most td passes in club chronicle he added his fourth touchdown throw of the game and 145th overall for l a late to tight end terrance ferguson if stafford is to catch favre and or become just the sixth nfl player to reach 500 td passes that would mean playing beyond the 2026 campaign for now however stafford has climbed another rung up the all time ladder continuing to defy father time and pen an argument for a spot in canton in the process

news_mentions.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba continues to dominate, no matter who's at QB: 'This guy is a wizard'
news_mentions.body_text: glendale ariz jaxon smith njigba often found himself in 34 the zone 34 last season but it had been nearly five years since he ascended to the level he showcased sunday afternoon including playoffs the star wideout racked up ten 100 yard games in 2025 during the seattle seahawks 39 romp to their second super bowl title twice the reigning nfl offensive player of the year snagged a pair of touchdown passes in a game but never thrice like he did when breaking into the national spotlight as a sophomore at ohio state in the thrilling 2022 rose bowl smith njigba set an fbs bowl record with 347 receiving yards and three touchdown receptions he didn 39 t quite match that distance with his 155 receiving yards on sunday but he scored three touchdowns for the first time since his college days as the seahawks improved to 2 0 with a 31 7 win against the arizona cardinals 34 it 39 s been a minute 34 said a reflective smith njigba 34 it 39 s awesome being in that zone putting points up for our team whatever it takes to win i 39 m willing to do whatever it takes any time you get opportunities you got to execute and put points on the board 34 not only did smith njigba become the first seahawks player since dk metcalf with three receiving touchdowns in a game he also made life significantly easier for backup quarterback drew lock who started in place of sam darnold seattle 39 s starting quarterback is out with a glute injury though coach mike macdonald said postgame that darnold 39 s timetable for returning has shifted quite drastically for the better darnold could start as soon as sept 27 against the washington commanders it was lock 39 s show on sunday however with smith njigba in a leading role on seattle 39 s second offensive play of the game lock dropped back and heaved a deep pass down the right sideline for smith njigba who was five yards behind the last line of arizona 39 s defense when he caught the ball smith njigba deked cardinals cornerback will johnson with a devastating head fake then slipped behind safety budda baker for a career long 82 yard touchdown reception 34 that 39 s my hooping skills right there 34 smith njigba said of his head fake lock wasn 39 t expecting smith njigba to be so open nor for him to run his route in such a manner 34 but that 39 s the beauty of playing with him 34 lock said 34 he 39 s going to find ways to get open it might not be the most conventional but that 39 s what makes him a ballplayer and that 39 s what makes him one of the best receivers the offensive player of the year last year 34 smith njigba 39 s next two touchdowns overshadowed a somewhat sloppy first half for the seahawks in which seattle and arizona each scored seven points he put seattle up for good on the opening drive of the second half when he ran a slant to perfection sneaking behind cardinals cornerback max melton to corral a seed from lock for a seven yard touchdown the 24 year old put the game out of reach early in the fourth quarter when lock threaded a pass through three cardinals defenders on third and 6 from arizona 39 s 12 yard line it wasn 39 t until aj barner plunged into the end zone from one yard out with 1 11 remaining in the game that a seahawks player not named smith njigba found the end zone for seattle this season smith njigba had the seahawks 39 lone touchdown in their season opening 13 10 win against the new england patriots as much as the seahawks long for the return of darnold who has missed all but five offensive snaps this season smith njigba is well on his way to another banner year regardless his 277 receiving yards lead the league while his four receiving touchdowns are tied with detroit lions standout amon ra st brown smith njigba has proven that seattle 39 s offense isn 39 t about who is throwing the passes or what scheme first year offensive coordinator brian fleury runs the game plan is quite simple get the ball to smith njigba and let the all pro figure out the rest 34 when he catches the ball we 39 re just like 39 man this guy is a wizard 39 34 defensive lineman leonard williams said 34 it 39 s nice to have big playmakers on offense 34 it doesn 39 t hurt to have a stingy defense either seattle allowed a game tying touchdown pass from jacoby brissett to trey mcbride to start the second quarter but otherwise stifled the cardinals arizona finished the game with only 151 yards of total offense including just 44 yards after halftime including last year 39 s playoff run the seahawks have won a franchise record 12 consecutive games thanks in large part to their defensive dominance the members of the unit that refers to itself as the dark side didn 39 t give that accomplishment much thought in the immediate aftermath of sunday 39 s shellacking 34 i think that 39 s what 39 s so beautiful about this team 34 williams said 34 i don 39 t think anyone 39 s thinking about that i think we 39 re so honed in on just being who we are 34 two games into their title defense the seahawks have demonstrated they are a well oiled machine capable of running it back and contending for what would be the franchise 39 s third super bowl title certainly seattle would benefit from darnold running the offense again but lock was more than adequate in his absence completing 19 of 26 attempts for 235 yards and those three touchdown passes to smith njigba 34 we 39 re on record about how we feel about him 34 macdonald said of lock 34 so he just backed that up today but it 39 s a 12 as 1 thing everybody having each other 39 s back 34 perhaps smith njigba though is a bit more irreplaceable than the rest of the seahawks the franchise made it abundantly clear how it feels about smith njigba when it made him the highest paid wide receiver in the nfl on an annual basis with a four year 168 8 million deal in march the seahawks dished the dough out for smith njigba because few nfl wide receivers if any can carry an offense quite like he can sunday 39 s performance was the latest in a line of many dominant ones for smith njigba who hauled in touchdown receptions from lock with ease just like that new year 39 s day in 2022 when he burst onto the scene 34 drew he is a special talent and sees the field very well and can make any throw 34 smith njigba said 34 i know he 39 s looking for me and i just want to be there for him 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: Marcus Mariota to start at QB in Commanders' Week 3 game as Jayden Daniels seeks opinions on elbow
news_mentions.description: Jayden Daniels will be sidelined for one week at the very least after his latest elbow injury. Marcus Mariota will start at quarterback in the Washington Commanders' Week 3 game.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels will be sidelined for one week at the very least after his latest elbow injury marcus mariota will start at quarterback in the washington commanders week 3 game against the seattle seahawks head coach dan quinn confirmed on monday daniels underwent imaging monday after suffering a dislocated left elbow in sunday s loss in dallas and will consult with specialists in the coming days quinn told reporters the third year qb does not yet have a timeline for return the commanders coach added daniels suffered the injury on the final play of the first half of washington s 37 20 defeat he stumbled after taking a snap under center and braced himself with his left arm before falling to the turf in obvious pain as his pass attempt fell incomplete medical staff quickly attended to daniels on the field at at t stadium and he was eventually carted to the locker room the commanders ruled daniels out after halftime this is daniels second elbow injury in two years the former offensive rookie of the year dislocated the same elbow last season in a week 9 game against seattle and missed the following three weeks he aggravated the injury upon his return as to whether washington will change its approach to handling daniels injured elbow this time around quinn said monday the team will defer to the specialists quinn added that the team has not yet discussed adding another quarterback to the room behind mariota and seventh round rookie athan kaliakmanis mariota was 11 of 16 passing for 111 yards and a touchdown in relief of daniels in 11 games played last season eight starts the former no 2 pick now 32 years old completed 61 2 of his passes for 1 695 yards 10 tds and seven picks washington 0 2 hosts the seahawks 2 0 in its home opener next sunday at 1 p m et the commanders then travel to london to play the indianapolis colts in week 4 whether daniels will be on that trip remains to be seen washington s bye comes in week 7

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams considered 'week to week' after suffering hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Caleb Williams is viewed as "week to week" after injurying his hamstring during Sunday's loss to the Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears expect caleb williams to miss time but the quarterback avoided a major hamstring injury head coach ben johnson said monday on espn 1000 that the team believes williams will be week to week following an mri exam it sounds like it s gonna be a week to week deal for him johnson said i gotta still talk with our trainer here we ll do that here shortly and i ll have the lowdown from him but it sounds like it s week to week but will likely miss some time johnson later told reporters the bears received a somewhat encouraging report about williams injury adding that the qb may not practice this week williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after coming up lame on a scramble in the fourth quarter the qb was emotional while being carted off the field but was reportedly seen in the locker room later walking without aid and only a slight limp yeah potentially dodged a bullet johnson added on monday we ll see he s tough and he comes back from these types of things better than the average human so we ll see while potentially missing the qb for next monday night s week 3 game against the philadelphia eagles is a negative overall it could be much worse for williams tyson bagent will get the start if williams is unable to go given the fragility of hamstring injuries the bears could play it cautiously with williams an injury that returns with a tweak if not properly healed could linger all season with a soft tissue injury it will be interesting to see how willing williams is to scamper when he returns he has used his legs with aplomb to open the 2026 season

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL fantasy football waiver wire, Week 3: RB Jonah Coleman, QB Bryce Young among top targets
news_mentions.description: Which players should you scoop up to give your fantasy team a boost heading into Week 3? Matt Okada spotlights the top waiver-wire targets at each position, including Broncos RB Jonah Coleman and Panthers QB Bryce Young.
news_mentions.body_text: two sundays of fantasy football in the books time for the week 3 waiver wire some of the names listed below might end up winning leagues at the very least several of them could be difference makers in the immediate future do not take the waiver wire for granted this is where the rubber meets the road in our imaginary game i ll be here every week from now until fantasy championships hope to have you along for the full ride let s win some hardware notes players must be rostered in less than 60 of espn leagues to be eligible for the column all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted top 15 overall waiver wire targets and here are my top waiver wire targets by position quarterbacks running backs washington commanders rb rachaad white is rostered in 65 percent of leagues above the 60 threshold of eligibility for this file but he was exceptional on sunday both on the ground and as a receiver and should be scooped up if available wide receivers san francisco 49ers wr deebo samuel is already rostered in 68 of leagues above the 60 threshold of eligibility for this file but he might be worth adding in the other 32 with de zhaun stribling out for multiple months tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Colts WR Alec Pierce (heel) to miss several weeks, won't have surgery
news_mentions.description: Wide receiver Alec Pierce sustained a heel injury in the Colts' loss to the Chiefs on Sunday night. He is set to miss several weeks but won't have surgery.
news_mentions.body_text: indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce will miss several weeks due to aggravating a heel injury that he had surgically repaired nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday evening pierce injured in sunday night s loss to the kansas city chiefs is likely to be headed to injured reserve rapoport reported as pierce intends to rehab and forgo surgery surgery is still a possibility for pierce but if all goes well with recovery he should return midseason the big play maven has led the nfl in yards per reception in each of his last two seasons but injuries haven t allowed him to get off the ground in 2026 re signing with the colts on a four year 114 million contract in march pierce underwent surgery on his heel in the spring and missed offseason work and most of training camp prior to be activated off the physically unable to perform list in august in 2025 pierce posted 47 catches for 1 003 yards his first 1 000 yard season and six touchdowns it led to him signing a lucrative extension with indy but through two games he s mustered just five receptions for 72 yards it ll be some time before he can add to those numbers pierce s absence leaves the colts wr corps rather barren beyond josh downs with keenan allen and laquon treadwell as the top reserves former giants receiver darius slayton is set to join the squad espn reported
