news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) inactive for Monday's game vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: The Rams will be without another star on "Monday Night Football." Puka Nacua is officially inactive for Los Angeles' prime-time game against the Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams will be without another star on monday night football puka nacua is officially inactive for los angeles prime time game against the giants the wide receiver popped up on the injury report with what was labeled as a hip issue friday missing that practice and the team s saturday session before receiving a questionable designation head coach sean mcvay described nacua s injury as groin soreness telling reporters it was not associated with the psoas issue that caused the 25 year old to miss some time during the preseason regardless of where exactly nacua is hurting he s unable to partake in an important game for the rams as they look to avoid an 0 2 hole to start a season they entered with realistic super bowl aspirations although nacua was not his typically explosive self in los angeles season opener against the 49ers collecting five catches for 74 yards he was the only rams pass catcher to get anything going in the 27 7 loss his yardage total was nearly half of matthew stafford s 155 through the air and a sizable chunk of it came on a 41 yard connection before the game got out of hand his absence is a massive blow for stafford as the reigning most valuable player looks to get back on track especially considering wideout jordan whittington will also miss the contest due to a quad injury davante adams is likely in line for a ton of targets and will be supplemented by other receivers such as konata mumpfield xavier smith and tutu atwell the rams also roster a diverse tight end corps led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson and running backs kyren williams and blake corum are capable of contributing in the passing game too just a couple weeks into the season the rams are already juggling a couple injuries to big names along with nacua being unable to go monday los angeles will be without myles garrett for at least four games after the star pass rusher underwent knee surgery and was placed on injured reserve there remains an impressive array of stars in l a but mcvay s crew is certainly dealing with some difficulties in the early going they ll look to overcome them to move to 1 1 when they kick off against the giants 1 0 on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: TE Zach Ertz reuniting with Eagles, signing to Philadelphia's practice squad
news_mentions.description: Philadelphia is bringing back one of its best. The Eagles are signing tight end Zach Ertz to the practice squad, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia is bringing back one of its best the eagles are signing tight end zach ertz to the practice squad espn s adam schefter reported monday ertz who is coming off a torn acl suffered while playing for the commanders last season began his career as a 2013 second round draft pick by the eagles he racked up 579 receptions 6 267 yards and 38 touchdowns for philly over a stretch of eight plus seasons that included three pro bowl campaigns and a super bowl victory he was traded during the 2021 campaign to the cardinals for whom he played through 2023 and then spent a pair of seasons in washington he currently sits at 8 592 receiving yards and 57 tds on 825 career catches there had been rumblings that a reunion for ertz and the eagles might be on the table and recent injuries in the tight end room likely made the decision a little easier dallas goedert suffered a sprained mcl on sunday and will miss some time while rookie eli stowers is currently on injured reserve with a hamstring injury thus ertz is coming back to the practice squad healthy and with a very real chance to make an impact for the eagles he also has an opportunity to make some franchise history in a hurry as the 35 year old returns only 11 receptions shy of the eagles all time catch record currently held by harold carmichael 589 ertz is sure to hear the cheers from the philly faithful assuming he jumps to the active roster and sees the field and he ll receive yet another ovation should he end up stamping his name in the record books

news_mentions.headline: Falcons name Michael Penix Jr. starting quarterback for Week 3 game vs. Packers
news_mentions.description: Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons in their Week 3 game against the Green Bay Packers, the team announced.
news_mentions.body_text: after 10 long months michael penix is ready for live nfl action penix will start at quarterback for the atlanta falcons in their week 3 game against the green bay packers on thursday night the team announced on monday penix will be making his first start since suffering a season ending knee injury last november he was officially a full participant in monday s estimated practice report cooper rush started atlanta s first two games of the 2026 season both losses in place of the sidelined penix and tua tagovailoa who has been dealing with an oblique injury falcons coach kevin stefanski said earlier monday that he had no update on who his week 3 starter would be but had an idea where atlanta was going in the end the falcons are going back to their 2024 first round pick penix s road back to the field lasted a little longer than expected after tearing knee ligaments in november and undergoing surgery penix was not cleared to fully participate in practice until aug 22 tagovailoa who was signed in the offseason for the veteran minimum was named the week 1 starter over the still ramping penix but was sidelined due to an oblique injury suffered during practice that week in came rush who through two weeks has struggled to put in mildly the 32 year old journeyman completed 56 4 of his passes for 229 yards and a league high four interceptions in atlanta s first two games which it lost by a combined score of 54 16 rush was benched in the second half of sunday s blowout loss to carolina in favor of undrafted rookie jack strand who fared no better in penix atlanta hopes to have its first glimpse of a legitimate starting qb leading stefanski s offense in 2026 before suffering his season ending injury the southpaw was having a solid campaign in his first full year as starter completing 60 1 of his passes for 1 982 yards nine touchdowns and three picks he finished the year with a league best 1 1 int percentage the falcons could surely use penix s sturdy production to get off the mat on a short week at 0 2 atlanta will be traveling to face the packers in their home opener at a hostile lambeau field atlanta is no stranger to a left handed quarterback stunning the green bay faithful in prime time see mike vick in the 2002 wild card round we ll see if penix can deliver a similar performance on thursday night football

news_mentions.headline: Kyler Murray clears concussion protocol, will start for Vikings in Week 3 vs. Buccaneers
news_mentions.description: Kyler Murray has been cleared from the NFL's concussion protocol, putting him in place to start for the 2-0 Minnesota Vikings against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 3.
news_mentions.body_text: vikings quarterback kyler murray has been cleared from the nfl s concussion protocol putting him in place to start for 2 0 minnesota against the tampa bay buccaneers in week 3 head coach kevin o connell announced on monday murray practiced throughout last week in a limited capacity in the lead up to week 2 s game against the chicago bears but was ruled out on friday carson wentz started sunday s 9 3 win over the bears and went 11 of 20 for 143 yards on a rainy day at soldier field in his first season with the vikings after seven with the arizona cardinals murray s debut for minnesota was cut short when he suffered a concussion in the first quarter of his team s week 1 39 22 win over the green bay packers murray slid during the play but incurred a big hit from green bay s javon bullard and lukas van ness murray was replaced by wentz who would help lead the vikings to a comeback win prior to his exit murray was 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception the no 1 overall pick in the 2019 nfl draft murray will now battle opposite the bucs baker mayfield the top selection in the 2018 nfl draft at 4 05 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Jim Harbaugh 'not deterred' by Chargers' 0-2 start following double-digit loss to Raiders
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Chargers started 0-2 with losses to the Arizona Cardinals and Las Vegas Raiders.
news_mentions.body_text: the los angeles chargers look in trouble after sunday s 26 14 loss to the las vegas raiders which pushed the club to 0 2 to start the season despite the dismal start jim harbaugh remained positive i m not deterred harbaugh said via espn no one in that locker room is deterred the chargers were supposed to romp over two rebuilding teams to open the season instead they began the year with back to back upset losses at home it wasn t just bad it was 100 years in the making bad for l a according to opta stats the chargers are the second team in nfl history to lose back to back games by double digits with both coming at home against teams that had a sub 200 win percentage the previous season the other was the 1926 racine tornadoes oct 10 17 who played just one more game before folding everything looks disjointed for the chargers justin herbert doesn t look comfortable under new offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel the offensive line once again continues to struggle turnovers plague the unit the defense has been pushed around particularly up front hasn t done enough to disrupt the qb and the secondary has gotten picked apart there s no time for us to be patient with how we re playing herbert said it s not good enough so we have to be better in the second straight 26 14 loss herbert struggled to find consistency sunday he finished 15 for 27 for 192 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions omarion hampton s fourth quarter fumble sealed the team s loss for the rotten cherry on top pro bowl right tackle joe alt who struggled all game with penalties was called for a hold in the end zone giving the raiders a safety and the game s final two points we ll look at the tape we ll go back to work that s all i know how to do harbaugh said the first two games were important for the chargers to get off on a good foot because a menacing gauntlet lies ahead starting with week 3 against the buffalo bills l a faces 2025 playoff teams in five of its next seven games the other two squads patrick mahomes chiefs and lamar jackson s ravens either the chargers will devolve and wash out before thanksgiving or they ll barnstorm their difficult stretch and prove harbaugh correct defensive back derwin james took a fiery approach after sunday s disappointing loss we got to look each other in the eye man and just tell the truth and just get better james said because right now that s just looks trash i m angry but being angry don t fix anything the chargers have a lot to fix quickly

news_mentions.headline: Todd Monken fires back after win over Buccaneers: ‘Browns are the Browns, (expletive) that’
news_mentions.description: Cleveland Browns coach Todd Monken clapped back at former Pittsburgh Steelers coach Mike Tomlin after Sunday's win in Tampa Bay.
news_mentions.body_text: after todd monken won his first game as cleveland browns head coach he took the chance to shoot back at the naysayers including former steelers coach mike tomlin browns are gonna browns expletive that monken said at the end of his press conference following cleveland s 23 19 win over tampa bay on sunday the guys took that to heart the comment referred to tomlin now an nbc analyst who quoted former steelers receiver juju smith schuster s the browns is the browns line while discussing cleveland s week 1 loss to jacksonville last week on sunday the browns overcame a 10 point second half deficit to beat baker mayfield and the buccaneers the much maligned deshaun watson outplayed mayfield throwing for 238 yards and two touchdowns while avoiding negative plays watson hit tight end blake whiteheart for the go ahead 17 yard td with just under four minutes remaining after a two plus hour weather delay cleveland hung on for the win monken s message clearly resonated in the locker room monk said what he said watson said after the win that s how we all feel for his part tomlin didn t fret the clapback hey i m glad that i can still motivate although i m not coaching anymore tomlin said chuckling during nbc s sunday night football pregame show the browns win keeps watson in the starting saddle as cleveland returns to ohio for their first home game of the 2026 campaign during the preseason home fans booed watson heavily and he took exception we ll see how the starter is received after bringing the browns home with a 1 1 record

news_mentions.headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffers dislocated left elbow in loss to Cowboys
news_mentions.description: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the first half of Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels has been beset by another injury the washington commanders quarterback suffered a dislocated left elbow in sunday s 37 20 loss head coach dan quinn told reporters following the game quinn told reporters x rays did not show a fracture but daniels will travel back home with the team and undergo more imaging on monday once i know an update that we can move forward with then i ll give you that quinn said man are we bummed for him he was really playing his ass off we will rally so hard around marcus mariota until jayden s back that s what we talked about as a team daniels suffered the injury on the final play of the first half he stumbled after taking a snap under center and braced himself with his left arm before falling to the turf in obvious pain as his pass attempt fell incomplete medical staff quickly attended to daniels on the field at at t stadium and he was eventually carted to the locker room the commanders ruled daniels out after halftime i thought looking back on it at the 1 yard line we need touchdowns quinn said of the third and goal play call with three seconds remaining in the second quarter i don t regret that call obviously any time someone s injured you play the what if game i don t think this is one of those times for me i hate that it happened i wasn t hesitant about going into that spot we re going to be aggressive in this game against their offense so i don t regret that obviously the outcome sucks but it wasn t a what if or i wish i had done something differently daniels was 11 of 17 for 96 yards with a touchdown at the time of his injury he also had 69 yards rushing on seven attempts mariota started the second half for the commanders in place of daniels and as quinn mentioned will take over under center for as long as daniels is out daniels dislocated his left elbow last season during a game against the seahawks on nov 2 2025 and missed the following three weeks he would appear in just one other game that season a blowout loss to the vikings in which he aggravated the injury daniels electrified the nfl in 2024 leading washington to a surprise trip to the nfc championship game and winning offensive rookie of the year honors last year however was a slog for both daniels and the commanders daniels started seven games during his sophomore season and was sidelined multiple times suffering a knee sprain and a hamstring injury before the november elbow injury

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffers hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's loss to the Minnesota Vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter.
news_mentions.body_text: chicago bears quarterback caleb williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter williams went down while scrambling on first and goal with chicago trailing 6 3 the qb appeared to be in pain on the field grabbing at his right leg williams had to be helped off the field and was carted from the sideline to the locker room bears head coach ben johnson told reporters after the game that he did not have a sense on the severity of the injury we ll know more tomorrow johnson said johnson added he had spoken with williams prior to his postgame news conference and the third year pro was in good spirits i m actually happy it s nothing with the knee johnson told reporters that was my first inclination but the hamstring could be pretty damaging as well we ll see how bad it is tomorrow and we ll go from there chgo sports adam jahns reported that williams was seen in the locker room walking under his own power without the use of crutches one week after exploding for 59 points in a win over the panthers williams and the bears offense struggled against a stout vikings defense williams was 15 of 26 for 138 yards with an interception on a rainy day at soldier field at the time of the injury and chicago proceeded to have a potential game tying field goal blocked after the drive stalled with williams out of the game tyson bagent replaced williams under center for chicago and nearly led the bears to a comeback but bagent was sacked by dallas turner on fourth down in the red zone to end the game bagent would be in line to start if williams missed extended time bagent started four games during the 2023 season compiling a 2 2 record

news_mentions.headline: Former Giants GM Ernie Accorsi dies at age of 84
news_mentions.description: Longtime NFL executive Ernie Accorsi, who built the New York Giants core that won the Super Bowl twice after his retirement has died. He was 84.
news_mentions.body_text: new york longtime nfl executive ernie accorsi who built the new york giants core that won the super bowl twice after his retirement has died he was 84 the giants and accorsi s family announced sunday that he died saturday a cause of death and where accorsi was when he died were not provided accorsi was general manager of the giants from 1998 2006 and received championship rings from their title runs in the 07 and 11 seasons he also became the second gm enshrined in the franchise s ring of honor ernie helped shape the course of new york giants history through his vision leadership and unwavering belief in building a championship organization owner john mara said in a statement beyond his accomplishments as a football executive he was a trusted advisor and dear friend his legacy will forever be part of the giants and he will be greatly missed accorsi was in charge when new york hired tom coughlin as coach and traded for quarterback eli manning after the chargers took him with the first pick in the 2004 draft the giants made the playoffs four out of six seasons from 05 11 i call ernie every draft week for the last 12 years maybe longer than that and just thank him for making the trade and believing in me and bringing me to the new york giants manning said in a statement i know he was the believer in me and kind of the reason i got here i appreciated him so much for building such great teams and giving us the opportunity to win some championships here accorsi a native of hershey pennsylvania got a communications degree from wake forest served in the u s army and was a sportswriter before working in public relations at penn state and for the baltimore colts he spent time at the league office before rejoining the colts as assistant general manager ernie accorsi was one of the most respected football minds in nfl history and a dear friend whose wisdom and perspective i valued tremendously commissioner roger goodell said in a statement throughout his remarkable career he shaped championship caliber clubs and earned the admiration of everyone who worked with him accorsi was promoted to baltimore s gm in 1982 then served in that role with the cleveland browns from 1985 92 before going to the giants they won two nfc east titles during his tenure with them before breaking through with manning amani toomer antonio pierce and michael strahan ernie was very decisive very opinionated coughlin said in a statement his mind was as sharp as a tack he loved to laugh he was a great storyteller great storyteller he loved to have an audience and laugh and then everyone else would laugh with him accorsi s family said the giants were more than a team to him and expressed gratitude to the mara family for its loyalty and friendship copyright 2026 the associated press

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Falcons' Michael Penix Jr. could start Week 3; Tua Tagovailoa not expected to be moved
news_mentions.description: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. is nearing a return from his knee injury ahead of Atlanta's Week 3 game against the Packers. Penix may make his first 2026 start on Thursday night, roughly 10 months since suffering his latest ACL injury.
news_mentions.body_text: michael penix s return is nigh after another week of fully participating in practice but being ruled out the falcons quarterback could finally make his first 2026 start in atlanta s week 3 game against the green bay packers on thursday night nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported sunday per sources penix s potential season debut comes just over 10 months since he suffered his latest acl injury the third year qb was a full participant in practice this week yet again but ceded first team reps to cooper rush on friday the 32 year old journeyman will get his second straight start sunday against the carolina panthers meanwhile tua tagovailoa could also return thursday night from his oblique injury tagovailoa was in line to start week 1 against pittsburgh before suffering the injury during practice tagovailoa is expected to practice this week and might be active against green bay serving as penix s backup per rapoport and schefter despite rumors to the contrary the ex dolphins quarterback is not expected to be moved either via release or trade rapoport and schefter added tagovailoa signed in atlanta this offseason for the veteran minimum after his release from miami who took him in the first round of the 2020 nfl draft if neither penix himself a 2024 first round selection nor tagovailoa can return by thursday s week 3 game their next opportunity to play is 11 days later the falcons open week 3 on thursday but close week 4 with a monday night game against the rival new orleans saints on oct 5 atlanta 0 1 has been in a quarterback quandary all offseason tagovailoa and penix were expected to battle for the week 1 qb1 role but the former was hampered by an early camp back injury and the latter was cleared to practice in full only late in the summer now with penix and tagovailoa returning to near full health the falcons can finally round into form as autumn begins

news_mentions.headline: Giants vs. Rams: Three must-know storylines for Monday's Week 2 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down three must-know storylines in Monday night's game between the New York Giants and Los Angeles Rams.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams ended week 1 as the only nfc west team without a win and the giants seamlessly transitioned into the john harbaugh era by enforcing their will on the cowboys in the sunday night opener just as everyone expected los angeles stumble out of the starting blocks was the more surprising of the two results and it sets up a pivotal early season game between two nfc clubs while the rams look to get into the win column big blue has an opportunity to make a huge statement it would be one thing to open the season by taking down an opponent in a divisional matchup games which often end up being tossups but following that up by traveling cross country to defeat the preseason super bowl favorites would put the league on notice regarding new york s emergence as a surprise contender such a statement would require the giants to earn a win over l a for the first time in a decade the giants have churned through four different head coaches and dropped four consecutive results to the rams since the club s last head to head victory in 2016 but that means little to new york s new era of stars a jaxson dart led contingent that has quickly proven capable of taking the fight to opponents no matter the odds three must know storylines 1 stafford seeks rebound performance matthew stafford s first start of the 2026 season didn t only pale in comparison to his 25 most valuable player campaign it was a low point of his six year tenure with the rams los angeles scored seven points the fewest the team has mustered in stafford s 75 starts and his 61 2 passer rating was the second worst by a reigning mvp in week 1 history per nfl research davante adams managed just 26 receiving yards his second lowest output as a ram while puka nacua who is out with a hip injury was relatively quiet outside of his 41 yard catch to set up los angeles lone score the opening week of the nfl calendar is always home to weird results though while it s strange seeing last year s best offense rank 32nd in points after one game few people if any assume such a result is indicative of how the rest of the season will go the rams caught a bit of a break with giants cornerback paulson adebo going on injured reserve and cb deonte banks being inactive due to a calf injury but they ll still have their work cut out for them without nacua against a new york defense that looked dangerous behind the new off ball linebacking duo of tremaine edmunds and arvell reese and a speedy pass rushing group led by abdul carter and brian burns the giants minimized damage against dallas which finished second in total offense last year holding the cowboys to 244 yards will they make it a trend by doing the same to last season s top total offense or will stafford return to mvp form 2 can giants win through another game of keep away everything was working offensively for new york in john harbaugh s first game at the helm jaxson dart delivered perfect throws with regularity going 23 of 29 for 230 yards three touchdowns and a 134 2 passer rating he also looked more mature and settled running the ball taking a late hit out of bounds early but otherwise protecting himself while rushing for 54 yards cam skattebo and malik nabers both looked good coming off injury and new tight end isaiah likely led all pass catchers in the game with eight receptions for 78 yards and two tds most impressive of all was the giants ability to sustain long drives tiring out dallas defense and preventing dak prescott and co from making it a shootout four of new york s seven possessions hit double digit plays five drives went 60 plus yards in the second half new york fielded two drives of eight plus minutes and a third that took the clock from 5 21 to triple zeroes it didn t matter that dallas scored both times it touched the ball after halftime there was no way to stage a comeback with possessions so limited by new york s methodical marches that ll likely be the strategy again versus the rams and it ll be even more impressive if dart and co can pull it off facing a defense of l a s caliber 3 rams must stop sky from falling it s far too early for chicken little to sound the alarm but it s difficult to imagine a worse start to the season for sean mcvay s crew the rams could neither stop nor score on the 49ers while opening the campaign in australia then after returning to l a star acquisition myles garrett underwent knee surgery that will knock him out at least a month though there was no shortage of criticism after mcvay s plan to travel to melbourne 24 hours before game time failed to yield results the other explanation is potentially more concerning if the rams did feel 100 to play so soon after arriving that would mean they simply didn t measure up to a rival that is likely to challenge them for the division either way l a is now staring at an 0 1 record and a matchup against an upstart giants squad some panic could creep in among the fan base should the rams lose especially with difficult games on deck against the broncos eagles and bills

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys' Jerry Jones: Giants were 'better than we thought they were' in season opener
news_mentions.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones gave the Giants credit on Friday for playing better than he thought they could in the season opener, but he's confident Dallas will recover and improve moving forward.
news_mentions.body_text: dennis green delivered the famous they are who we thought they were line following his cardinals 2006 monday night loss to the bears twenty years later jerry jones came to the opposite realization while assessing his cowboys week 1 defeat to the giants they just did a good job all over jones said of the giants in a friday interview on 105 3 the fan i will tell you they were better than we thought they were i m anxious to see how new york continues to play but really a combination of things we didn t play as well as we should play and can play but they played better than i thought they could jones wasn t the only one surprised by the giants who spectacularly thwarted expectations while never trailing dallas on the way to a season opening victory jaxson dart threw for 230 yards and three touchdowns on 23 of 29 passing and joined battering ram cam skattebo in dolling out damage on the ground the duo combined for 135 rushing yards with skattebo punching one in for six big blue sidelined the cowboys vaunted offense for large swaths of the contest exposing a dallas defense that was expected to be much improved under new defensive coordinator christian parker following a transformative offseason the cowboys instead allowed the giants to win the possession battle by over 13 minutes and blew several coverages both on vital downs and to allow open pass catchers running free in the end zone though jones graciously gave new york its share of credit he also noted the learning process the cowboys have undergone thanks to considerable scheme and personnel changes it s a process dallas must accelerate ahead of sunday s matchup against the commanders of course jones said when asked if he also felt the cowboys opened the season worse than he thought they d be to say it that way i d rather say it more positively that we re not at the level we re not at the level that we thought we would be i can give you a lot of reasons logical reasons you re dealing with conceptually a new coaching staff dealing with a new to a lot of people out there defensive scheme and then you re dealing with people who are fresh in to that scheme it s a challenge to put it together and ready to go we didn t play well last week what i meant to say was new york had really more to do with it than i thought they would so that s a factor but washington could have a lot to do with it here sunday too so we ve got to be ready to step up the level of play there s no question the upcoming matchup with washington gives both teams two divisional games right out of the gate whichever team loses sunday will fall to both 0 2 overall and in the nfc east for all that went wrong to kick off the season jones believes his squad will show up vastly improved for a vital showdown at home the improvement certainly from where we played sunday that improvement is to be expected and will be there jones said i m just gonna say it it will be there i know how hard these guys are working i know their physical capabilities and i also know their motivation so you ll see improvement i ll go on the record as saying that

news_mentions.headline: David Montgomery not satisfied with three-TD Texans debut heading into Week 2: 'I'll improve'
news_mentions.description: Running back David Montgomery was not satisfied with his three-touchdown Houston Texans debut. He's hoping for better efficiency and a win in his Week 2 encore against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news_mentions.body_text: david montgomery found the end zone three times in his first game as a texan the most by any player in his debut in team history per nfl pro the running back was nonetheless disappointed with his outing both due to failing to come away with a victory and what he believes was personally a subpar performance it was cool but it didn t really feel that cool or that good when we don t come out with a win montgomery told andrew siciliano on friday s episode of the nfl report and i didn t perform or play as good as i wanted to i felt like i left a few things out there for my o line and for the rest of my guys on the team i ll improve first game it was cool but we didn t get the win montgomery was key to helping the texans keep up with the bills in an eventual 36 31 loss opening his td hat trick with a 1 yard plunge before later dashing through a huge hole for 18 yards to paydirt his third score came on a 7 yard catch montgomery s first td reception since his 2022 campaign with the bears all three scores changed the lead in houston s favor montgomery is correct in pointing out he left some opportunities on the field though his frequent trips to the end zone obscured an uncharacteristically inefficient performance as the 29 year old averaged only 3 0 yards per carry producing 60 yards on 20 attempts the meager yardage output is obviously a small sample size at this point but montgomery has strung together four straight seasons averaging 4 0 plus yards per carry so he knows he s capable of more he believes the texans are as well with hopes that will start to show on sunday in another potential playoff preview against the bengals just another game to me quite frankly montgomery said of facing his hometown cincinnati squad preparing the same way that i always prepare going against another great defense they made a lot of improvements this offseason it ll be exciting it ll be good to see where we are see if we can get on track to get our first w

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) questionable to play Monday vs. Giants after missing second straight practice
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is considered questionable to play Monday against the Giants due to a hip injury, head coach Sean McVay said.
news_mentions.body_text: there are some injury concerns over another rams star wide receiver puka nacua is questionable to play monday against the giants although nacua is officially listed on the injury report with a hip ailment head coach sean mcvay told reporters nacua is dealing with some groin soreness that is separate from the psoas issue that caused him to miss time during training camp nacua who was a surprise non participant in friday s practice also sat out saturday s session if the two time pro bowler ends up missing the contest or seeing diminished playing time due to his injury los angeles will have to dig deep to find production elsewhere in the passing game nacua was the only rams pass catcher who got going in any way during the team s season opening bludgeoning by the 49ers and even still he was relatively quiet outside of a 41 yard catch nacua hauled in five receptions for 74 yards in week 1 while no one else on the team went over 30 yards davante adams would likely shoulder a large burden of work as matthew stafford s go to guy should nacua end up sitting jordan whittington quad is doubtful to play which leaves konata mumpfield xavier smith cj daniels and tutu atwell available as well as a deep tight end group led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson it s not an ideal situation for the rams to be dealing with an ailing nacua at the start of a season that began with great expectations l a s early injury hurdles also extend to the defensive side with star acquisition myles garrett on injured reserve following knee surgery still there s plenty of stars to get the job done including defensive lineman aaron donald who plans to make his season debut against new york after ending a two year retirement to rejoin the rams at the end of august it remains to be seen if nacua suits up along with donald for the momentous occasion the rams kick off against the giants on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Rams' Aaron Donald plans to make season debut Monday vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams defensive lineman Aaron Donald is set to make his official return to the field. When asked about potentially playing Monday night against the New York Giants, Donald, who unretired on Aug. 30, told reporters, "That's the plan."
news_mentions.body_text: the rams won t have myles garrett for their home opener but they might welcome a franchise legend back to the field during his friday media availability defensive tackle aaron donald told reporters the plan is for him to play in los angeles monday night contest against the new york giants that s the plan donald said two practices today have another practice tomorrow and then we ll see but feeling good donald did not travel with the rams to their season opening loss in melbourne australia choosing to stay back in southern california to focus on his ramp up process prior to making his season debut with donald not in the picture and garrett dealing with a knee injury that eventually required surgery and placement on injured reserve the rams were clobbered by the san francisco 49ers 27 7 it was just one game of course and donald valued his preparation for returning to nfl game action an environment he hasn t seen since he retired after the 2023 season more than rushing himself back to the field after los angeles completed a blockbuster trade for garrett on june 1 donald spent the summer flirting with coming out of retirement to rejoin the rams he didn t officially do so until aug 30 though leaving him a limited window to prepare himself physically for the marathon that is an nfl season traveling to australia was likely never going to fit into those plans the extra week of practice however appears to have positioned donald to make his return in the same stadium he last called home i don t know i ain t really think about that donald said when asked what it will feel like to run out on the field at sofi stadium again because to me i know i ain t play in two years but being back around i feel like i was just here last year time flies by so fast and i kind of forget that i didn t play football in two years i kind of just feel like i m just back to my normal self and like i was playing last year even though i wasn t i m just going to take it all in enjoy it try to give the fans something to cheer for enjoy the game and try to come away with a win

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity washington and scored on seven of eight possessions to secure its first victory of the season it was the form many folks were expecting to see from the jump for a unit that ranked second in total yards last season dak prescott went 26 of 31 84 with 279 yards and four tds he set the franchise record for career td passes 249 with his final scoring toss of the day a 24 yard bomb to ceedee lamb who finished with eight catches for 153 yards and two tds the cowboys still need to get the ground game going ranking near the bottom of the league with 135 rushing yards in their first two games but sunday s showing gives them something to build with a trip to brazil to face the ravens up next daniels woes won t go away we re once again being robbed of witnessing one of the most electric playmakers in the game after an injury plagued 2025 season jayden daniels left sunday s game with a dislocated left elbow he suffered on the last play of the first half he dislocated the same elbow last season and missed three games before returning only to aggravate the injury in his first game back last season washington went 3 7 without daniels in 2025 averaging 23 points per game in those contests the commanders still had life once backup marcus mariota entered the game at qb on sunday but they managed to score just 10 points with him at the helm which weren t nearly enough against dak and co it s not going to get any easier next week with the reigning champion seahawks and their suffocating defense visiting washington cowboys defense still has work to do while holding a team to 20 points is respectable washington posted 203 yards in the second quarter alone prior to jayden daniels injury on the final play of the half the commanders clearly had figured out how to attack dallas with daniels ability to create with his legs playing a leading role the new look secondary took a hit too with cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot leaving the game due to injury first year defensive coordinator christian parker now has a week to come up with a better plan for keeping a dual threat quarterback in check two time mvp lamar jackson awaits dallas in week 3 next gen stats insight for commanders cowboys via nfl pro all four of dak prescott s touchdown passes traveled at least 10 yards downfield in the air tying a career high nfl research with sunday s victory at at t stadium dak prescott has won 20 consecutive home games against nfc east opponents he s now tied with tom brady 2007 2014 for the longest home winning streak in division games since the afl nfl merger in 1970 back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways efficiency name of 49ers game five drives five touchdowns san francisco s offense was something to behold sunday against a young dolphins defense finding the paint on five consecutive drives to build a 35 6 lead after three quarters brock purdy never seemed stressed channeling his best oprah winfrey impression you get a touchdown you get a touchdown christian mccaffrey and purdy got the party started with a pair of td runs in the first half before the scoreboard blew wide open in the third quarter with george kittle kyle juszczyk and mccaffrey finding the end zone purdy who was replaced by mac jones midway through the fourth quarter finished his banner day 20 of 22 passing for 287 yards two touchdowns with no interceptions while leading the team in rushing with 30 yards and another score on three carries milestone day for mccaffrey kittle on a day that was all about kyle shanahan s offense it was no shock that the heartbeat of the supporting cast shined brightest christian mccaffrey had just 67 scrimmage yards but made the most of his touches near the goal line his pair of rushing scores put him in elite company as he became the third player in nfl history to record 50 plus scrimmage tds with multiple teams joining hall of famers marshall faulk rams 85 colts 51 and randy moss vikings 92 patriots 50 but perhaps the most exciting aspect of san francisco s offensive frenzy was george kittle s return to prominence after missing six games in 2025 with an achilles injury and a modest week 1 outing in australia the seven time pro bowler led the team with 80 receiving yards and his first touchdown a 12 yard reception on a busted coverage since the injury kittle s third catch of the day also marked his 600th career reception the 11th tight end in league history to accomplish that feat fins find offensive improvement the miami offense took unquestioned steps forward from last week s opener at least early in the contest the unit s three first half drives all resulted in field goal tries with riley patterson converting twice the dolphins outgained the 49ers in the first half 165 yards to 125 and held the ball for nearly nine more minutes than the home team for as well as malik willis and de 39 von achane played the difference going into the locker room came in the red zone where miami struggled to convert with a pair of drives stalling at the san francisco 10 and 5 yard lines unfortunately the story changed in the second half miami failed to amass more than 15 yards on four straight possessions before a garbage time 77 yard touchdown connection between willis and ryan miller there s still a lot to clean up that ll likely be a common theme for this young team throughout the season but there were definite positives early in this contest that willis and co can build on in addition miami s improvement on third down its 47 conversion rate up from 20 in week 1 was another step in the right direction next gen stats insight for dolphins 49ers via nfl pro brock purdy completed all 10 of his downfield pass attempts 10 air yards against the dolphins for 211 yards and a touchdown it was the most completions without an incompletion by a qb on downfield passes since week 5 2021 carson wentz vs baltimore nfl research brock purdy recorded a 149 1 passer rating 287 passing yards two passing touchdowns in the 49ers week 2 win over miami this was his eighth career start with a 140 passer rating tying joe montana for second in 49ers history including playoffs behind only steve young 13 only lamar jackson has more such games 12 than purdy since the latter entered the league in 2022 back to top grant gordon s takeaways visions of chiefs of old shine with a prime time audience looking on for the second week in a row kicker harrison butker booted a 40 yard game winner in overtime to send the chiefs to a 2 0 start it s quite the difference from the 0 2 genesis of last year s disastrous 6 11 showing it wasn t the prettiest win but it was a glimpse of what used to be with patrick mahomes producing a glistening line of 32 of 47 passing for 382 yards three touchdowns and a 114 0 rating the first of those three touchdowns went to travis kelce who turned in nine receptions for 101 yards it was the first time mahomes topped 300 passing yards and kelce had 100 plus receiving in the same game since week 7 2023 fresh face kenneth walker added 117 yards on the ground though he didn t run as wild as he did in his debut against the broncos for that matter neither did the chiefs instead they eked this one out which might be the best of signs for k c to come having gone 11 0 in one score games in 2024 the chiefs were an nfl worst 1 9 in such games last season now mahomes and co are 1 0 in nail biters and perfect through two weeks it s a long road but this is a good beginning banged up colts lose ot heartbreaker there s been no team in the nfl that s waited longer for a win than the colts unfortunately for indianapolis it waited excruciatingly longer for its ninth straight loss with an injury to alec pierce exposing the colts offensive depth even more sauce gardner and charvarius ward also dealt with injuries that hamstrung the defense it made the colts ability to hang around sunday all the more impressive but the struggles and losses are piling up jonathan taylor was a stud at times 24 carries for 92 yards two touchdowns but corralled for large swaths in others josh downs came up pretty big seven receptions for 72 yards tyler warren was relatively quiet aside from the first td of the game and daniel jones simply couldn t rely on laquon treadwell or keenan allen in more than four quarters of football indy totaled 329 yards of offense while its defense gave up north of 520 fortune isn t smiling on shane steichen s team right now it will need to in a hurry treadwell s topsy turvy play emblematic with ample time left in the fourth quarter nbc s cris collinsworth proclaimed a pivotal upcoming down as the play of the game it wasn t there were about 17 more plays of the game thereafter perhaps the most symbolic of the craziness of the evening was 2016 first round pick turned journeyman laquon treadwell s 48 yard reception in overtime with the colts trailing 30 27 daniel jones and co took over and the qb heaved a long ball to treadwell treadwell bobbled the ball before collecting it fell to the ground sprang up and had possession punched out by nohl williams and recovered by the chiefs game over nope replay showed that l 39 jarius sneed s hand had glanced treadwell s side after the receiver had established final control so there was no fumble now it was the chiefs with their backs against the wall they held though and after indy tied it up on a spencer shrader field goal k c marched down for the game winner the colts held the lead three times in the first half but trailed throughout the second after patrick mahomes navigated an 80 yard go ahead drive to begin the third quarter it looked like the chiefs would pull away at 27 20 but it wasn t to be despite mahomes and co outgaining jones squad 523 329 this one went down to the final play the chiefs emerging as 2 0 looking like their old selves meanwhile the colts will keep scratching their helmets wondering what else can go wrong before they get back in the win column next gen stats insight for colts chiefs via nfl pro creed humphrey did not allow a pressure across 51 pass blocking snaps against the colts his second consecutive game without a pressure allowed nfl research the colts extended their nfl long losing streak to nine games the streak began in week 12 2025 when indianapolis lost to kansas city in overtime back to top

news_mentions.headline: Two truths and a lie: Ben Johnson is the new Bill Walsh, while John Harbaugh has revived the Giants
news_mentions.description: Is Ben Johnson this generation's Bill Walsh? Are the Giants BACK under John Harbaugh? Which surprise team feels like a mirage? With early-season takes flying all over the NFL world, Bucky Brooks reveals two truths and a lie.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he explores three emerging viewpoints as we head into the 2026 campaign s second sunday the nfl world is still teeming with takes from week 1 that s what happens when a football starved public gets its first real meal since winter initial impressions breed strong opinions ultimately some prove prescient others preposterous with that in mind i d like to evaluate the legitimacy of a few nascent narratives prior to this season s second full helping of pigskin what s real and what s fake which early observations do i stand behind stand against here are two truths and a lie truth ben johnson is this generation s bill walsh no disrespect to kyle shanahan and sean mcvay s wizardry but ben johnson is the guru who will define the 2020s as a legendary play caller the second year head coach of the chicago bears has awakened a hibernating offense transforming it into a juggernaut that has defensive coordinators shaking in their boots as they prepare to face the monsters of the midway johnson s bears bludgeon opponents with a mix of power and pizzazz fielding an exotic smash mouth offense with an mvp caliber quarterback a pair of potential 1 000 yard rushers and a talented collection of pass catchers the savvy schemer can call any play he wants with supreme confidence in the team s talent tactics and execution moreover johnson knows his rock solid offensive line will impose its will on foes leaving them battered and bruised after a 60 minute war in the trenches given the overwhelming physicality and toughness this unit displays whenever it takes the field chicago is establishing itself as an offensive bully that pushes around adversaries chicago finished 2025 ranked ninth in points and sixth in total offense but johnson boldly stated in august that he wants the bears to set an nfl scoring record in 2026 then they hit the road for the season opener and dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers flexing their muscles against a completely overwhelmed defense the bears enjoyed a rare 250 250 game eclipsing the yardage figure in passing 261 and rushing 291 d andre swift led the way on the ground with 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries while kyle monangai reached the century mark on just 10 totes including a 61 yard touchdown meanwhile caleb williams completed 72 4 percent of his passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns adding 65 yards and two more scores with his legs the crazy part is that kalif raymond not rome odunze or luther burden led the receiving corps in targets nine catches eight and yards 84 shoot tight end colston loveland who took the league by storm in the second half of his rookie season didn t even have a catch and yet chicago nearly scored 60 points in 60 minutes the video game like exhibition demonstrated johnson s brilliance as a play caller further proving his deft ability to juggle a collection of weapons that s something he showcased as detroit s offensive coordinator from 2022 through 24 when the lions fielded three straight top five units in points and yards now he s doing the same thing in the windy city pulling all the right levers with a potent pack of playmakers bill walsh transformed the game with his west coast offense and a star studded lineup that featured joe montana jerry rice and roger craig among others the hall of fame coach made a pass heavy approach the norm these days johnson has balance back in vogue chicago ranked third in rushing and 10th in passing last season in 2026 the bears could finish in the top five in both categories with a well rounded approach creative scheming and a deep bag of tricks johnson is setting the standard for modern offense i can t wait to see what his bears do this sunday against the vikings brian flores blitz happy defense is challenging to most though johnson boasts a 5 1 record when calling plays against the ballyhooed coordinator truth the giants are back with john harbaugh the new york giants have enjoyed their greatest successes with hard nosed disciplinarians leading the charge bill parcells and tom coughlin each guided the franchise to two super bowl titles with both head men using old school blueprints that prioritized discipline toughness and attention to detail over flashy schemes and star power that throwback approach is back in the building with john harbaugh in charge the soon to be 64 year old compiled a 180 113 record with the baltimore ravens winning a lombardi trophy and six afc north titles while appearing in the playoffs 12 times in 18 seasons the grizzled leader built a culture of hard work physicality and toughness in baltimore holding his players accountable for meeting the standard on every snap now he s doing the same thing in nyc in a dazzling debut on sunday night football harbaugh guided his team to a 28 20 upset of the eternally hyped dallas cowboys suddenly the football world is buzzing about the upstart g men being dark horse contenders in the nfc the 2026 giants are built like the proud organization s four super bowl winning squads from 1986 1990 2007 and 2011 the first three of those teams in particular relied heavily on dominant defense a potent running game and a quarterback who makes plays in the clutch sound familiar this year s d still has some questions in the back end but the salty front seven is vintage big blue new york has a collection of pass rushers brian burns kayvon thibodeaux abdul carter chauncey golston and arvell reese who can jump into the old nascar packages that terrorized opponents in previous nyg title runs moreover free agent addition tremaine edmunds gives this team a reliable nerve center with the middle linebacker directing traffic to keep everyone on the same page the unit showed championship caliber communication and attention to detail last sunday night while playing with the physicality that s always been a hallmark of the franchise s great defenses offensively the giants have embraced a slow down style forcing opponents to adjust to a deliberate run oriented game plan that chews up the clock and reduces total possessions while qb jaxson dart will get chances to push the ball downfield to malik nabers and isaiah likely these giants want to control games with a lower risk approach that leans heavily on cam skattebo and the rushing attack to string together first downs the ground and pound strategy is part of the team s plan to set the tempo and push opponents out of their comfort zone particularly when going against high powered offenses that want to play shootouts against the cowboys the giants comfortably won time of possession 36 40 to 23 20 and went 9 for 11 on third down new york ran 16 more offensive plays than dallas 68 to 52 which helps explain why cowboys qb dak prescott lost his patience and threw an uncharacteristic interception setting up a giants score right before halftime admittedly it s only been one game maintaining perspective is key and the giants immediately face another stiff test in prime time visiting los angeles this week to play the rams on monday night football still i m confident that the culture and blueprint harbaugh is establishing will have big blue back in the championship hunt sooner than many anticipate lie the nfc west actually has four good teams the excitement following the cardinals week 1 upset of the chargers has led some observers to offer hot takes on the bird gang s immediate prospects in 2026 the optimism springing from the desert is a far cry from the doom and gloom that hovered over the franchise for most of the offseason while i hate to be the bearer of bad news to a fan base reveling in its week 1 win the cardinals are destined to finish as cellar dwellers and miss the playoffs for a fifth straight season the fanfare over mike lafleur s impressive debut is understandable but it will eventually subside as teams settle in and arizona s film circulates around the league astute observers will quickly scan last week s game and see the chargers beat themselves with a series of blunders and miscues typically seen at your local high school on a friday night the bolts lost the turnover battle minus two had a punt blocked and were stopped on downs three times the errors allowed the cardinals to dominate time of possession 37 31 to 22 29 and run 21 more plays although the cardinals deserve credit for finding a winning formula victories will be very hard to come by in a brutally tough schedule looking at the rosters and depth charts throughout the nfc west it is hard to find a position group where the cardinals have an edge in personnel yes arizona has a few blue chip players see te trey mcbride s budda baker and rookie rb jeremiyah love but the superior depth and talent on the seahawks rams and 49ers will require lafleur and co to out scheme everyone and in case you haven t noticed those three teams are pretty damn well coached in a league where jimmys and joes matter more than x s and o s the talent discrepancy between the cardinals and the nfc s true contenders ultimately will lead to a string of losses that leaves arizona behind the competition this sunday the cards host the reigning super bowl champions sam darnold remains sidelined for the seahawks but as we saw in seattle s 13 10 win over new england mike macdonald s team is plenty capable of winning games with defense though lafleur certainly can continue to build this team s competitive culture the first time head coach faces long odds when it comes to orchestrating a true rags to riches turnaround in 2026

news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 1 sunday atlanta falcons defensive lineman da 39 shawn hand knee was ruled out in the first half of sunday s loss to the steelers offensive lineman chris lindstrom concussion was also ruled out baltimore ravens wide receiver zay flowers hamstring was ruled out of sunday s win over the colts flowers had five catches for 150 yards and one touchdown before exiting nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday morning that flowers injury is not considered serious but the wr will undergo garafolot reported chicago bears cornerback tyrique stevenson shoulder exited sunday s win over the panthers and did not return cleveland browns running back dylan sampson ankle was ruled out in the s win over the saints and did not return houston texans linebacker jake hummel abdomen was ruled out of sunday s loss to the bills jacksonville jaguars defensive end bj green elbow exited sunday s win s loss to the cardinals new york jets safety minkah fitzpatrick groin did not return to sunday s win over the titans wide receiver omar cooper ankle was ruled out cooper s x rays were negative but he ruled out after suffering a concussion in the first half of sunday s win over the packers tampa bay buccaneers cornerback jacob parrish back was ruled out of sunday s loss to the bengals washington commanders tight end chigoziem okonkwo hamstring linebacker frankie luvu groin and safety tyler owens ankle did not return to sunday s loss to the eagles

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk
