news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the carolina panthers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location bank of america stadium charlotte north carolina fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cleveland browns 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 8 week 2 at houston texans 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et nfl network on thursday aug 21 2025 schedule note the panthers are one of just seven teams that do not have a thursday game on their schedule their monday night matchup with san francisco in week 12 is currently slated to be their only prime time game of the 2025 regular season nfl research what you need to know 1 bryce young s growth in the last half of 2024 was the silver lining of yet another lost season in carolina and furthering his development will be a primary focus over training camp the panthers helped that cause in april with the first round selection of tetairoa mcmillan who possesses the typical traits of a true no 1 wide receiver and offers young a rangy target as the quarterback enters year 3 establishing chemistry with mcmillan is crucial for an immediate impact and having veteran adam thielen around figures to aid that process xavier legette s development entering his second season is also essential to forming a dynamic group weapons for young to utilize hunter renfrow s comeback attempt in carolina is another subplot to keep an eye on over the summer as the panthers aim to build around their franchise quarterback 2 derrick brown s return in 2025 won t be only thing to anticipate for the panthers defense defensive linemen tershawn wharton and bobby brown are key free agent additions joining carolina s star defender and the initial gelling of this reimagined defensive front is worth monitoring the panthers lacked any push without brown who suffered a season ending knee injury in week 1 and their run stopping troubles spiraled into last season s 32nd ranked defense a turnaround up front could do wonders for a unit with a talented secondary headed by jaycee horn and mike jackson the panthers also added pass rusher patrick jones and safety tre 39 von moehrig via free agency rookies nic scourton and lathan ransom are also in the mix for playing time 3 kickoff and punt returns might bring some added excitement along carolina s preseason both primary roles are up for grabs this summer and a pair of rookies wr jimmy horn and running back trevor etienne are expected to compete for both jobs the pairing is small in size but brings plenty of speed and shiftiness to a club that has produced just one touchdown return since 2018 the panthers oncoming work on special teams doesn t stop with figuring out the returners either with new kickers matthew wright and ryan fitzgerald battling for the starting role and new punter sam martin holding for longtime long snapper j j jansen

news_mentions.headline: David Montgomery not satisfied with three-TD Texans debut heading into Week 2: 'I'll improve'
news_mentions.description: Running back David Montgomery was not satisfied with his three-touchdown Houston Texans debut. He's hoping for better efficiency and a win in his Week 2 encore against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news_mentions.body_text: david montgomery found the end zone three times in his first game as a texan the most by any player in his debut in team history per nfl pro the running back was nonetheless disappointed with his outing both due to failing to come away with a victory and what he believes was personally a subpar performance it was cool but it didn t really feel that cool or that good when we don t come out with a win montgomery told andrew siciliano on friday s episode of the nfl report and i didn t perform or play as good as i wanted to i felt like i left a few things out there for my o line and for the rest of my guys on the team i ll improve first game it was cool but we didn t get the win montgomery was key to helping the texans keep up with the bills in an eventual 36 31 loss opening his td hat trick with a 1 yard plunge before later dashing through a huge hole for 18 yards to paydirt his third score came on a 7 yard catch montgomery s first td reception since his 2022 campaign with the bears all three scores changed the lead in houston s favor montgomery is correct in pointing out he left some opportunities on the field though his frequent trips to the end zone obscured an uncharacteristically inefficient performance as the 29 year old averaged only 3 0 yards per carry producing 60 yards on 20 attempts the meager yardage output is obviously a small sample size at this point but montgomery has strung together four straight seasons averaging 4 0 plus yards per carry so he knows he s capable of more he believes the texans are as well with hopes that will start to show on sunday in another potential playoff preview against the bengals just another game to me quite frankly montgomery said of facing his hometown cincinnati squad preparing the same way that i always prepare going against another great defense they made a lot of improvements this offseason it ll be exciting it ll be good to see where we are see if we can get on track to get our first w

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job done stroud played solidly avoiding big mistakes and peppered the middle of the field however the lack of a rushing attack put the offense in bad spots the retooled offensive line looked a lot like last year opening few holes on the ground and not giving stroud much time the texans offense missed nico collins badly with none of the young wide receivers stepping up tight end dalton schultz 12 receptions for 140 yards generated 103 yards more than any other texans pass catcher on sunday houston missed several opportunities to make it a game with an early flubbed field goal attempt a stuffed fourth down and a missed 58 yard field goal all coming in the first three quarters the texans got into the red zone four times however they scored zero tds and accounted for just three points on those drives that won t get it done burrow hooks up with chase for two tds in road win there weren t gaudy numbers but joe burrow and ja marr chase showed why they are a premier duo burrow came out insistent on getting chase involved early the wr paid him off with a ridiculous twisting toe tap 32 yard td in the second quarter the duo hooked up again on a scramble drill to put up cincy by two scores in the third quarter the offensive line was an issue on sunday burrow was sacked five times and the texans generated 10 qb hits orlando brown five qb pressures two sacks dalton risner six qb pressures sack and dylan fairchild five qb pressures sack all struggled the good news is that when the bengals put up fewer than 300 yards in years past they usually took an l in 2026 they re 2 0 while the offense irons things out next gen stats insight for bengals texans via nfl pro the bengals generated 27 pressures on 62 dropbacks 43 5 the most pressures generated in a single game by the bengals since al golden took over as the bengals defensive coordinator last season five bengals recorded four or more pressures in week 2 including jonathan allen seven boye mafe seven cedric johnson six cashius howell five and dexter lawrence four allen recorded his most pressures in a game in the last four seasons while mafe tied his most pressures generated in a game in his career nfl research the bengals did not allow a single touchdown in week 2 at the texans their first game allowing no touchdowns since week 3 2022 at the jets cincinnati broke a franchise long and nfl long streak of 65 consecutive games allowing at least one touchdown the bills now own the longest active streak in the nfl having allowed at least one touchdown in 47 consecutive games back to top kevin patra s takeaways patriots splash big plays to run away from pittsburgh drake maye didn t author a particularly pretty game but the quarterback threw a trove of big plays to move the ball against an experienced steelers defense maye connected on passes of 29 29 30 and 63 yards the pats also generated big runs starting with treveyon henderson s 39 yard td sprint and rhamondre stevenson added a 24 yarder early in the second half the pats had several miscues that kept the game closer than it could have been stevenson fumbled in plus territory on the opening drive and maye later threw an interception in scoring range coming off a disappointing week 1 maye didn t fully bounce back missing several plays he made a year ago and he wasn t comfortable in the pocket behind an offensive line that struggled especially as injuries struck however the splash plays highlighted by a 63 yarder to romeo doubs after maye escaped the pocket were a welcomed sight after last week in week 1 the qb didn t have a pass play of 20 plus yards on sunday he generated four the offense still has strides to make but it s much easier after a win that avoids an 0 2 start pats d gets in on the big plays it wasn t just the offense that sprayed big plays on the foxborough turf the new england defensive line dominated steelers blockers blasting aaron rodgers repeatedly the pats biggest plays came when they destroyed the 42 year old qb with the steelers in field goal range on third and 7 christian elliss walloped rodgers for a sack and forced fumble the ball bounced around for an eventual loss of 36 yards forcing a punt then early in the fourth quarter christian barmore hit rodgers forcing another fumble that elijah ponder scooped up for a touchdown effectively putting the game away for good measure rookie gabe jacas grabbed a flubbed catch for an interception that ensured the steelers wouldn t find pay dirt on sunday the pats allowed just 235 yards and 2 of 12 on third downs ugly day for steelers offense every aspect was bad for pittsburgh s offense the o line got walloped troy fautanu had a forgettable afternoon and guard spencer anderson was destroyed allowing seven qb pressures and a sack per next gen stats aaron rodgers was never comfortable struggled to maneuver muddy pockets and looked every bit of 42 on sunday before sitting for the final drive he completed 23 of 39 attempts for 187 yards threw an int and took four sacks the passing attack couldn t get out of its own way with drops and off the mark passes being the most memorable plays dk metcalf continued his atrocious start to the season catching four passes on nine targets for 27 yards with several miscues christian gonzalez usually locks up wr1s but right now metcalf is barely playing like a wr3 the run game was absent from start to finish putting the offense in bad down and distance situations mike mccarthy has a lot to figure out after two uninspiring offensive performances to open the season next gen stats insight for patriots steelers via nfl pro the patriots defense blitzed the steelers on 18 total dropbacks their most in a game since week 10 of 2024 when sending extra pass rushers they held the steelers to 43 passing yards 2 7 yards per attempt and a 22 2 success rate while also recording eight pressures two sacks and one interception nfl research the steelers scored just three points against the patriots tied for the second fewest by any team in which aaron rodgers was the starting quarterback rodgers finished with 187 passing yards no touchdowns and one interception his fifth straight start with one passing touchdown or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways packers avoid first 0 2 start in 20 years with gutty effort it wasn t pretty but green bay is in the win column in 2026 jordan love threw for just 145 yards the packers offense converted one of nine third downs and picked up at least one first down on only four of 12 drives and green bay committed 14 accepted penalties but a win is a win down 17 7 in the fourth quarter love and co strung together one of their better drives of the afternoon picking up four first downs with help from a field flipping azareye 39 h thomas defensive pass interference call and finding the end zone to pull within three a quick stop and skyy moore punt return later and green bay was in position to tie the game with a field goal after another three down stop in overtime with two consecutive sacks shared by four packers defenders green bay rode backup backs kaleb johnson and chris brooks into gang green territory where after another awful jets penalty and matthew golden first down trey smack smacked home the game winning field goal sunday s turnaround came in stark contrast to how the packers finished their season opener against minnesota when they blew a two score lead and lost by three scores green bay fans will be happy to sheath their knives for lafleur ahead of the home opener on thursday night as the pack have avoided starting 0 2 for the first time since 2006 jets collapse down stretch blow chance to start 2 0 on a gray afternoon in the meadowlands new york was in position to ride out an ugly win over the visiting packers through three quarters the jets had made fewer mistakes avoided nasty injuries and adjusted well to what green bay was throwing at them then fortunes turned up 14 7 new york benefitted from a marshawn lloyd fumble at the packers 18 yard line but the jets went three and out and neglected to go for it on fourth and 1 from the 9 setting up a field goal later tied 17 17 after two green bay scoring drives with the ball at the 50 yard line under two minutes to the jets decided to try a fourth and 1 dive the risk didn t pay off as braelon allen was stuffed at the line the packers didn t make anything of the turnover on downs but took their momentum into overtime where geno smith was sacked on back to back plays and new york punted the ball and game back to the pack for the second straight year the jets have outplayed their opponents in their home opener aaron rodgers steelers in 2025 only to fall just short in the end after such a positive start the loss felt like a familiar finish for aaron glenn s group and serves as a missed opportunity for new york to start 2 0 for the first time in 11 years sloppy outing for both sides matt lafleur and aaron glenn will use this game film as teaching tape teaching their players what not to do lest they play a more disciplined opponent in ensuing weeks the packers and jets combined for 27 accepted penalties for 289 yards an ugly affair all around green bay and new york kept each other in the game with ill timed fouls for the packers that s 26 penalties in two games only three teams have incurred more accepted fouls in the first two games of a campaign the weather might not have contributed to the poor discipline but it surely had an effect on the poor hands in this one the teams combined for eight fumbles five by green bay three by new york though only one was lost the jets special teams which had been key in their week 1 victory was super shaky with isaiah williams muffing two punts and new york surrendering a 63 yard skyy moore punt return leading to the packers game tying field goal drive next gen stats insight for jets packers via nfl pro packers pass rusher lukas van ness generated a career high nine pressures against the jets recording five of them in under 2 5 seconds tied for the third most by a packers defender since 2020 nfl research the jets blew a 17 7 fourth quarter lead in their week 2 overtime loss to the packers it was their first time blowing a double digit fourth quarter lead since week 9 of 2020 vs the patriots they had won 14 straight games in which they held a double digit fourth quarter lead entering week 2 back to top nick shook s takeaways browns pull off the improbable cleveland began sunday s contest exhibiting many of the same discouraging signs that doomed them in week 1 operational errors and penalties general disorganization and an inability to convert in key offensive situations unlike last week the browns defense showed up and kept the game within reach opening the door for deshaun watson and the rest of cleveland s offense to find a rhythm in the second half watson leaned on the youngsters around him connecting with rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston to keep drives moving using harold fannin as a safety valve and even converting a couple of third downs with his legs it was far from pretty but cleveland s offense pieced together two touchdown drives in the second half including a 12 play 68 yard march that ate up 6 07 and ended with blake whiteheart sneaking across the field for a wide open connection with watson for a 17 yard go ahead touchdown the browns had plenty to overcome sunday including poor offensive line play early self inflicted errors and a two hour weather delay and managed to outlast the buccaneers with a defensive stand amid a driving rain it s only one win but it will be a joyous flight back home to cleveland mayfield looks very uncomfortable in this offense after eight quarters of evidence it s pretty clear that baker mayfield hasn t found a comfortable place in offensive coordinator zac robinson s scheme tampa bay s approach was peculiar at times sunday producing sequences that saw repeated screens and swing passes to running backs while avoiding attempting to stretch the field much until late in the contest mayfield looks skittish in the pocket regardless of situation hesitating to fire and often trying to buy more time to survey as initial concepts fail to produce clear passing opportunities or he fails to spot them when they do come open it s only two weeks but it s fair to say the buccaneers offense looks a lot like the 2025 falcons also directed by robinson lacking consistent identity and intent while being operated by a quarterback who doesn t appear to be relaxed or confident that s not a good sign for a team aiming to climb back to the top of the nfc south qb change delayed for a week entering sunday s game many browns fans were eager to watch primarily because they believed it would be the last time they d have to suffer through an ugly deshaun watson led performance before coach todd monken decided to bench watson for shedeur sanders well they ll have to enjoy cleveland s win with a bit of bitterness because watson performed well enough to justify starting again next week he was far from perfect his performance is best described as fine but watson played an integral role in cleveland managing to mount a comeback confidently firing toward kc concepcion denzel boston and even isaiah bond for one key completion along the sideline and on must have downs in the fourth quarter watson kept the chains moving there s certainly no guarantee his success was anything more than a one week aberration but he looked much more like a quarterback capable of playing in the nfl this week than he did in week 1 when monken breaks down watson s performance to reporters this week his positive remarks will be much more believable next gen stats insight for browns buccaneers via nfl pro deshaun watson completed 24 of 30 pass attempts for 238 yards and two touchdowns averaging 0 25 epa per dropback his most as a brown and most since week 12 of the 2020 season nfl research denzel boston joined bobby mitchell and andre davis as the only browns with a receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games boston s first two receiving touchdowns went for 46 yards and 55 yards respectively he is the fourth player in nfl history to have a 45 plus yard receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games joining sammy white 1976 mac haik 1968 and bob hayes 1965 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways hurts comes in clutch after tough outing it wasn t the best day at the office for jalen hurts but when met with a deadline needing to lead a game winning drive with 1 56 remaining the super bowl lix most valuable player delivered hurts who threw a bad interception in the end zone during his first possession and another pick during the drive immediately preceding his last led philly on a nine play 65 yard drive to take the lead and the win from the titans he did so by becoming laser focused on devonta smith throwing to the eagles no 1 wide receiver on four of eight passes including a pretty 19 yard gain on third and 6 to set up philadelphia at the goal line on the next play he hit darius cooper for the wideout s first career touchdown to propel the eagles to a surprisingly difficult win he wasn t nearly perfect sunday going 26 of 37 for 264 yards two touchdowns and the two picks but he was clutch as ever when called upon to leave titans fans with some achy breaky hearts titans defense finally runs out of gas tennessee couldn t end drives quickly in the first half against philly allowing the eagles to dominate the time of possession with three drives that all took 11 or more plays and over 6 minutes 30 seconds although the titans did allow touchdowns on the second and third drives they made a massive early stop setting themselves up to take a 7 0 lead after amani hooker intercepted jalen hurts and returned it 92 yards to philadelphia s 10 yard line robert saleh s crew buckled down after halftime finally gaining some momentum with a pair of three and outs in the third quarter to no one s surprise jeffery simmons led the way making life difficult for hurts racking up seven pressures jacob martin had six and jermaine johnson had four as hurts seemed to regularly be running for his life and forced into poor or difficult throws it was simmons wrapping his arms around hurts as the qb threw his second pick of the day which eventually set the titans up for a go ahead joey slye field goal with just under two minutes remaining unfortunately a gassed tennessee defense that was on the field for over 13 minutes more than its offense couldn t hold up against philly s last second heroics after that eagles winning by skin of their teeth philadelphia found itself shorthanded right off the bat against the titans saquon barkley suffered a stinger on his first carry of the game after being stuffed at the line of scrimmage and having multiple big bodies land on him tight end dallas goedert then injured his knee on the second play of the second quarter barkley came back for the second half but only handled three more carries as he was clearly affected perhaps those setbacks disrupted philly s game plan but the offense fell into a deep sleep in the second half before miraculously waking up for some last drive magic that left philly s defense to keep it close enough for a win and vic fangio s crew luckily abided the eagles will certainly want some plays back especially after a few woeful missed tackles while allowing tennessee to go 84 yards to take the lead toward the end of the fourth quarter but the eagles ultimately held the titans to a field goal late just as they stumbled last week but recovered to stop a commanders two point conversion toward game s end to preserve a win it s been a high wire act thus far as the eagles try to find their groove but 2 0 is 2 0 next gen stats insight for eagles titans via nfl pro devonta smith caught six of eight targets outside the numbers for 77 yards and a touchdown including two sideline catches for 24 yards more than he had all of last season nfl research jalen hurts led his eighth fourth quarter comeback since 2023 tied for second most in the league back to top nick shook s takeaways waddle explodes a quiet debut muted some of the excitement surrounding jaylen waddle denver s prized offseason acquisition but that was merely a prelude to a loud introduction at mile high on sunday waddle went off in the broncos comeback win catching a 49 yard strike from bo nix early in the second quarter to set up denver s offense at jacksonville s 1 yard line and although denver settled for a field goal on that drive waddle was only getting started he logged six more catches on the day with four gaining double digit yardage and almost all of them making a key difference in denver s offensive awakening for one afternoon the broncos were able to realize the dream they d carried with them for years spending their sunday watching a deep threat thrive with a quarterback capable of finding him it s crucial to denver s offensive arc in 2026 one that can t rely too heavily on nix s playmaking or its stable of running backs the broncos will be at their best when waddle is a central figure and they saw firsthand how he can change their outlook on sunday jacksonville finally falters it s been quite some time since the jaguars fell apart in a regular season game sunday s performance wasn t quite a disintegration but it was a disappointing finish for an offense that could do no wrong in week 1 and suddenly couldn t find a method of success to counter denver s comeback after a strong first half that saw trevor lawrence pepper denver s defense with pinpoint passes lawrence regressed to the quarterback who too frequently attempts highly questionable passes and pays the price for it his interception swung momentum in the broncos favor and gave denver permission to hunt him for the rest of the day and the jaguars failed to adjust it all starts up front for jacksonville which struggled with denver s increased defensive aggression in the second half and surrendered a qb pressure rate of 45 2 hampering a passing attack that has been among the best in the nfl since the midpoint of the 2025 season fortunately it happened in week 2 against a top tier defense providing the jaguars with tape to correct they just need to ensure it doesn t become a weekly occurrence broncos bounce back save for one drive the broncos looked horribly overmatched in week 1 their offensive operation wasn t great in the first half sunday either with cbs cameras repeatedly showing a demonstrably frustrated davis webb shouting angrily on the sideline after their latest failure all of that changed though when cornerback riley moss slid in front of a lawrence pass in the fourth quarter and intercepted it breathing new life into the broncos and their anxious fans nix and co capitalized covering 64 yards in 10 plays and finishing with a well designed play action pass to fullback nate adkins for a touchdown to tie it at 13 defensively the broncos regained their identity after the moss interception shutting down a jaguars offense that moved freely between the 20s earlier in the contest and nearly intercepting lawrence a second time the following drive a five play 56 yard march that ended in a jonah coleman rushing score from 3 yards out almost seemed inevitable in one half the broncos returned to form and nix finally found some consistency along the way next gen stats insight for jaguars broncos via nfl pro bo nix completed five of six passes outside the tackle box for 110 yards one touchdown and a perfect passer rating 158 win over the dolphins the critique was his ineffectiveness on deep and intermediate passes 10 plus air yards he rectified that against the chargers throwing all three of his tds on deep and intermediate targets going 8 of 12 for 181 yards on such attempts one of those incompletions was an interception but it was only due to tre tucker slipping on the route cousins who will fool no one into thinking he s a mobile threat at this point stood tall on multiple throws under duress and he ably exposed los angeles defense despite las vegas failing to piece together a running game ashton jeanty averaged only 2 3 yards per carry on 21 attempts it wasn t all cousins of course tucker gave the chargers secondary fits for his second career 100 yard receiving game and cody white elevated from the practice squad saturday caught two tds defensively fifth round rookie hezekiah masses picked off justin herbert twice maxx crosby had four pressures and necessitated a hold by joe alt in the end zone to give the raiders a safety which effectively ended the game late still 38 year old cousins has been the biggest revelation for the raiders who are now 2 0 for the first time since 2021 placeholder for fernando mendoza or not cousins is leading las vegas to victories mcdaniel s offense is m i a the chargers fired offensive greg roman after scoring a combined 15 points in their last two playoff games and replaced him with mike mcdaniel who was expected to elevate los angeles offense to a new echelon as he did for several years coaching the dolphins that has not nearly been the result thus far the chargers have been held to 14 points in each of their opening losses the operation was sloppy across the board on sunday against las vegas much of the blame will rightfully be laid at justin herbert s feet he fumbled the ball three times half of the team s six times coughing it up although the chargers only lost one of those he wasn t able to find a rhythm early which caused l a to turn to omarion hampton to get something going 15 carries for 70 yards in the first half but when hampton slowed during the final two quarters with 24 yards on another eight carries the chargers really quieted down herbert finished 15 of 27 for 192 yards one touchdown two interceptions and a 59 5 passer rating there was ugliness everywhere though herbert s first pick happened because david njoku dropped the ball and right tackle joe alt committed four penalties trailing by three and facing a third and 1 toward the end of the third quarter the chargers self sabotaged when jake slaughter accidentally snapped the ball into tre harris legs as the receiver went in motion simply nothing went smoothly for the new look chargers offense chargers must take hard look at themselves it is not an overreaction to say the chargers are in deep deep trouble they have looked that bad and their upcoming schedule is that brutal los angeles offense as mentioned is in a state of disarray and the defense has made far too many mistakes in the first two weeks against offenses that are not considered world beaters now winless heading into week 3 the chargers are set to face a murderers row of opponents they play the bills seahawks broncos chiefs rams texans and ravens over the next seven games with a bye in week 7 there are no easy games in the nfl but jim harbaugh and co opened the season with a pair of matchups they were expected to dominate now it s difficult to find their first win if they don t rapidly improve their quality of play next gen stats insight for raiders chargers via nfl pro hezekiah masses played a total of 26 coverage snaps allowing two catches and 16 yards on six targets while recording two interceptions across 11 coverage snaps matched up with quentin johnston or ladd mcconkey the rookie did not allow a catch nfl research kirk cousins is the second quarterback in raiders history with three plus touchdown passes in each of the first two games of a season joining ken stabler in 1976 the raiders went on to win the super bowl that season back to top kevin patra s takeaways jsn s three tds power seahawks it took a full two plays for jaxon smith njigba to put his stamp on the contest blazing past the arizona defense for an 82 yard touchdown the reigning offensive player of the year was just warming up anytime drew lock needed a big play he sought out smith njigba the wideout blew the game open in the second half with td catches of 7 and 12 yards jsn showed once again he s always open generating 155 yards on nine catches with three scores he earned 120 more yards than any other seahawks pass catcher at times it appeared the seahawks were protecting the offense from lock including a slew of goal line runs but the qb did well to lean on his playmaking wr when he needed a play mike macdonald s defense smothers cardinals arizona had one good drive a 12 play 61 yard five first down td possession in the first half the rest of the afternoon from jeremiyah love and tyler allgeier 2 8 yards per carry with the run game silenced seattle was able to tee off on jacoby brissett the seahawks generated 18 qb pressures per next gen stats on season facing a cards team that put up nearly 400 yards in week 1 macdonald s crew held arizona to 151 yards 3 2 yards per play 10 first downs and 3 of 12 on third downs domination good vibes dissipate in desert coming off a week 1 upset mike lafleur s squad came in with some pop we saw the defense stand up in the first half including a big end of half goal line stand however with an offense unable to move the ball things collapsed in the second half as the game unraveled arizona was outscored 24 0 in the final two quarters jacoby brissett was as ineffective as we ve seen him in an arizona jersey dealing with an injury brissett was inaccurate and couldn t generate chunk gains arizona didn t have a play longer than 9 yards until the final garbage time drive trey mcbride earned 41 yards and a td no other cards player earned more than 18 receiving yards brissett finished 17 of 28 for 95 yards with a td and an int outside the one td drive arizona generated just five first downs on nine drives next gen stats insight for seahawks cardinals via nfl pro drew lock completed seven of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns lock completed all eight of his play action attempts for 71 yards his most play action completions as a seahawk nfl research the seahawks set a franchise record with their 12th straight win including playoffs dating back to week 12 2025 seattle also extended its win streak against the cardinals to 10 games the longest active win streak by any nfl team vs one opponent back to top dan parr s takeaways cowboys offense bounces back after a week 1 performance against the giants that left plenty to be desired dallas dropped 37 points on washington and scored on seven of eight possessions to secure its first victory of the season it was the form many folks were expecting to see from the jump for a unit that ranked second in total yards last season dak prescott went 26 of 31 84 with 279 yards and four tds he set the franchise record for career td passes 249 with his final scoring toss of the day a 24 yard bomb to ceedee lamb who finished with eight catches for 153 yards and two tds the cowboys still need to get the ground game going ranking near the bottom of the league with 135 rushing yards in their first two games but sunday s showing gives them something to build with a trip to brazil to face the ravens up next daniels woes won t go away we re once again being robbed of witnessing one of the most electric playmakers in the game after an injury plagued 2025 season jayden daniels left sunday s game with a dislocated left elbow he suffered on the last play of the first half he dislocated the same elbow last season and missed three games before returning only to aggravate the injury in his first game back last season washington went 3 7 without daniels in 2025 averaging 23 points per game in those contests the commanders still had life once backup marcus mariota entered the game at qb on sunday but they managed to score just 10 points with him at the helm which weren t nearly enough against dak and co it s not going to get any easier next week with the reigning champion seahawks and their suffocating defense visiting washington cowboys defense still has work to do while holding a team to 20 points is respectable washington posted 203 yards in the second quarter alone prior to jayden daniels injury on the final play of the half the commanders clearly had figured out how to attack dallas with daniels ability to create with his legs playing a leading role the new look secondary took a hit too with cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot leaving the game due to injury first year defensive coordinator christian parker now has a week to come up with a better plan for keeping a dual threat quarterback in check two time mvp lamar jackson awaits dallas in week 3
