news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job done stroud played solidly avoiding big mistakes and peppered the middle of the field however the lack of a rushing attack put the offense in bad spots the retooled offensive line looked a lot like last year opening few holes on the ground and not giving stroud much time the texans offense missed nico collins badly with none of the young wide receivers stepping up tight end dalton schultz 12 receptions for 140 yards generated 103 yards more than any other texans pass catcher on sunday houston missed several opportunities to make it a game with an early flubbed field goal attempt a stuffed fourth down and a missed 58 yard field goal all coming in the first three quarters the texans got into the red zone four times however they scored zero tds and accounted for just three points on those drives that won t get it done burrow hooks up with chase for two tds in road win there weren t gaudy numbers but joe burrow and ja marr chase showed why they are a premier duo burrow came out insistent on getting chase involved early the wr paid him off with a ridiculous twisting toe tap 32 yard td in the second quarter the duo hooked up again on a scramble drill to put up cincy by two scores in the third quarter the offensive line was an issue on sunday burrow was sacked five times and the texans generated 10 qb hits orlando brown five qb pressures two sacks dalton risner six qb pressures sack and dylan fairchild five qb pressures sack all struggled the good news is that when the bengals put up fewer than 300 yards in years past they usually took an l in 2026 they re 2 0 while the offense irons things out next gen stats insight for bengals texans via nfl pro the bengals generated 27 pressures on 62 dropbacks 43 5 the most pressures generated in a single game by the bengals since al golden took over as the bengals defensive coordinator last season five bengals recorded four or more pressures in week 2 including jonathan allen seven boye mafe seven cedric johnson six cashius howell five and dexter lawrence four allen recorded his most pressures in a game in the last four seasons while mafe tied his most pressures generated in a game in his career nfl research the bengals did not allow a single touchdown in week 2 at the texans their first game allowing no touchdowns since week 3 2022 at the jets cincinnati broke a franchise long and nfl long streak of 65 consecutive games allowing at least one touchdown the bills now own the longest active streak in the nfl having allowed at least one touchdown in 47 consecutive games back to top kevin patra s takeaways patriots splash big plays to run away from pittsburgh drake maye didn t author a particularly pretty game but the quarterback threw a trove of big plays to move the ball against an experienced steelers defense maye connected on passes of 29 29 30 and 63 yards the pats also generated big runs starting with treveyon henderson s 39 yard td sprint and rhamondre stevenson added a 24 yarder early in the second half the pats had several miscues that kept the game closer than it could have been stevenson fumbled in plus territory on the opening drive and maye later threw an interception in scoring range coming off a disappointing week 1 maye didn t fully bounce back missing several plays he made a year ago and he wasn t comfortable in the pocket behind an offensive line that struggled especially as injuries struck however the splash plays highlighted by a 63 yarder to romeo doubs after maye escaped the pocket were a welcomed sight after last week in week 1 the qb didn t have a pass play of 20 plus yards on sunday he generated four the offense still has strides to make but it s much easier after a win that avoids an 0 2 start pats d gets in on the big plays it wasn t just the offense that sprayed big plays on the foxborough turf the new england defensive line dominated steelers blockers blasting aaron rodgers repeatedly the pats biggest plays came when they destroyed the 42 year old qb with the steelers in field goal range on third and 7 christian elliss walloped rodgers for a sack and forced fumble the ball bounced around for an eventual loss of 36 yards forcing a punt then early in the fourth quarter christian barmore hit rodgers forcing another fumble that elijah ponder scooped up for a touchdown effectively putting the game away for good measure rookie gabe jacas grabbed a flubbed catch for an interception that ensured the steelers wouldn t find pay dirt on sunday the pats allowed just 235 yards and 2 of 12 on third downs ugly day for steelers offense every aspect was bad for pittsburgh s offense the o line got walloped troy fautanu had a forgettable afternoon and guard spencer anderson was destroyed allowing seven qb pressures and a sack per next gen stats aaron rodgers was never comfortable struggled to maneuver muddy pockets and looked every bit of 42 on sunday before sitting for the final drive he completed 23 of 39 attempts for 187 yards threw an int and took four sacks the passing attack couldn t get out of its own way with drops and off the mark passes being the most memorable plays dk metcalf continued his atrocious start to the season catching four passes on nine targets for 27 yards with several miscues christian gonzalez usually locks up wr1s but right now metcalf is barely playing like a wr3 the run game was absent from start to finish putting the offense in bad down and distance situations mike mccarthy has a lot to figure out after two uninspiring offensive performances to open the season next gen stats insight for patriots steelers via nfl pro the patriots defense blitzed the steelers on 18 total dropbacks their most in a game since week 10 of 2024 when sending extra pass rushers they held the steelers to 43 passing yards 2 7 yards per attempt and a 22 2 success rate while also recording eight pressures two sacks and one interception nfl research the steelers scored just three points against the patriots tied for the second fewest by any team in which aaron rodgers was the starting quarterback rodgers finished with 187 passing yards no touchdowns and one interception his fifth straight start with one passing touchdown or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways packers avoid first 0 2 start in 20 years with gutty effort it wasn t pretty but green bay is in the win column in 2026 jordan love threw for just 145 yards the packers offense converted one of nine third downs and picked up at least one first down on only four of 12 drives and green bay committed 14 accepted penalties but a win is a win down 17 7 in the fourth quarter love and co strung together one of their better drives of the afternoon picking up four first downs with help from a field flipping azareye 39 h thomas defensive pass interference call and finding the end zone to pull within three a quick stop and skyy moore punt return later and green bay was in position to tie the game with a field goal after another three down stop in overtime with two consecutive sacks shared by four packers defenders green bay rode backup backs kaleb johnson and chris brooks into gang green territory where after another awful jets penalty and matthew golden first down trey smack smacked home the game winning field goal sunday s turnaround came in stark contrast to how the packers finished their season opener against minnesota when they blew a two score lead and lost by three scores green bay fans will be happy to sheath their knives for lafleur ahead of the home opener on thursday night as the pack have avoided starting 0 2 for the first time since 2006 jets collapse down stretch blow chance to start 2 0 on a gray afternoon in the meadowlands new york was in position to ride out an ugly win over the visiting packers through three quarters the jets had made fewer mistakes avoided nasty injuries and adjusted well to what green bay was throwing at them then fortunes turned up 14 7 new york benefitted from a marshawn lloyd fumble at the packers 18 yard line but the jets went three and out and neglected to go for it on fourth and 1 from the 9 setting up a field goal later tied 17 17 after two green bay scoring drives with the ball at the 50 yard line under two minutes to the jets decided to try a fourth and 1 dive the risk didn t pay off as braelon allen was stuffed at the line the packers didn t make anything of the turnover on downs but took their momentum into overtime where geno smith was sacked on back to back plays and new york punted the ball and game back to the pack for the second straight year the jets have outplayed their opponents in their home opener aaron rodgers steelers in 2025 only to fall just short in the end after such a positive start the loss felt like a familiar finish for aaron glenn s group and serves as a missed opportunity for new york to start 2 0 for the first time in 11 years sloppy outing for both sides matt lafleur and aaron glenn will use this game film as teaching tape teaching their players what not to do lest they play a more disciplined opponent in ensuing weeks the packers and jets combined for 27 accepted penalties for 289 yards an ugly affair all around green bay and new york kept each other in the game with ill timed fouls for the packers that s 26 penalties in two games only three teams have incurred more accepted fouls in the first two games of a campaign the weather might not have contributed to the poor discipline but it surely had an effect on the poor hands in this one the teams combined for eight fumbles five by green bay three by new york though only one was lost the jets special teams which had been key in their week 1 victory was super shaky with isaiah williams muffing two punts and new york surrendering a 63 yard skyy moore punt return leading to the packers game tying field goal drive next gen stats insight for jets packers via nfl pro packers pass rusher lukas van ness generated a career high nine pressures against the jets recording five of them in under 2 5 seconds tied for the third most by a packers defender since 2020 nfl research the jets blew a 17 7 fourth quarter lead in their week 2 overtime loss to the packers it was their first time blowing a double digit fourth quarter lead since week 9 of 2020 vs the patriots they had won 14 straight games in which they held a double digit fourth quarter lead entering week 2 back to top nick shook s takeaways browns pull off the improbable cleveland began sunday s contest exhibiting many of the same discouraging signs that doomed them in week 1 operational errors and penalties general disorganization and an inability to convert in key offensive situations unlike last week the browns defense showed up and kept the game within reach opening the door for deshaun watson and the rest of cleveland s offense to find a rhythm in the second half watson leaned on the youngsters around him connecting with rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston to keep drives moving using harold fannin as a safety valve and even converting a couple of third downs with his legs it was far from pretty but cleveland s offense pieced together two touchdown drives in the second half including a 12 play 68 yard march that ate up 6 07 and ended with blake whiteheart sneaking across the field for a wide open connection with watson for a 17 yard go ahead touchdown the browns had plenty to overcome sunday including poor offensive line play early self inflicted errors and a two hour weather delay and managed to outlast the buccaneers with a defensive stand amid a driving rain it s only one win but it will be a joyous flight back home to cleveland mayfield looks very uncomfortable in this offense after eight quarters of evidence it s pretty clear that baker mayfield hasn t found a comfortable place in offensive coordinator zac robinson s scheme tampa bay s approach was peculiar at times sunday producing sequences that saw repeated screens and swing passes to running backs while avoiding attempting to stretch the field much until late in the contest mayfield looks skittish in the pocket regardless of situation hesitating to fire and often trying to buy more time to survey as initial concepts fail to produce clear passing opportunities or he fails to spot them when they do come open it s only two weeks but it s fair to say the buccaneers offense looks a lot like the 2025 falcons also directed by robinson lacking consistent identity and intent while being operated by a quarterback who doesn t appear to be relaxed or confident that s not a good sign for a team aiming to climb back to the top of the nfc south qb change delayed for a week entering sunday s game many browns fans were eager to watch primarily because they believed it would be the last time they d have to suffer through an ugly deshaun watson led performance before coach todd monken decided to bench watson for shedeur sanders well they ll have to enjoy cleveland s win with a bit of bitterness because watson performed well enough to justify starting again next week he was far from perfect his performance is best described as fine but watson played an integral role in cleveland managing to mount a comeback confidently firing toward kc concepcion denzel boston and even isaiah bond for one key completion along the sideline and on must have downs in the fourth quarter watson kept the chains moving there s certainly no guarantee his success was anything more than a one week aberration but he looked much more like a quarterback capable of playing in the nfl this week than he did in week 1 when monken breaks down watson s performance to reporters this week his positive remarks will be much more believable next gen stats insight for browns buccaneers via nfl pro deshaun watson completed 24 of 30 pass attempts for 238 yards and two touchdowns averaging 0 25 news_mentions.headline: Giants-Rams on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Los Angeles' 28-6 win
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams cruised to their first win of the season in prime time against the New York Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: home sweet home for rams basking in the comfortable confines of sofi stadium the rams returned home from a wayward australian adventure and returned to the form so many thought would be seen matthew stafford looked like the mvp from a season ago davante adams looked like the game tilting wide receiver he was for years and the los angeles defense with aaron donald at the center of it all was sterling as the giants sputtered with jaxson dart lost to a knee injury the rams overcame a couple turnovers and won handily more than a week removed from falling flat in their opener in the outback against the 49ers the rams handled their business and were impressive stafford rebounding from a zero touchdown week 1 proved that was an aberration with 327 passing yards and four touchdown passes that he did so without an injured puka nacua was all the more impressive adams was simply wonderful in the no 1 wr role hauling in a pair of touchdowns and nearly 200 yards while the two headed running game of kyren williams and blake corum also got the job done 164 combined rushing yards in a game that felt like a blowout despite the rams leading by only two scores throughout most of the night l a racked up 481 yards it wasn t perfect there were turnovers and too many missed opportunities but the rams got right on monday happy to be home feeling looking and playing like themselves monday nightmare for giants seven snaps into the game jaxson dart was savagely sandwiched by the rams pass rush and left grasping his left knee that was it for dart on monday before he was ruled out though dart was joined as being questionable to return by wide receiver malik nabers fortunately nabers returned to play after dinging up his shoulder dart never got back in and andrew thomas groin and brian burns ankle were injured late in the game it was a nightmare of an evening for the giants it was reported dart tried to return to action and general manager joe schoen said he d be ok eschewing long term concerns for the time being meanwhile the giants offense was a struggle bus with jameis winston at the helm the running game went nowhere either cam skattebo was the team s leading rusher with just 36 yards on 12 carries and was curiously replaced by najee harris for two runs inside the 10 yard line late in the first half the biggest takeaway in this one is that the giants offense is absolutely lost without dart and considering his injury history that puts new york in a precarious spot donald makes long awaited return it had been 981 days since aaron donald last played a game a wild card playoff loss against the detroit lions he made a much ado return monday highlighted by stopping najee harris on a third down tackle for loss in the second quarter donald contributed three tackles perhaps more importantly as head coach sean mcvay said after halftime he was energizing the rams defense and los angeles was outstanding jaxson dart and jameis winston were constantly harassed each facing 58 plus pressure rates and new york s running game went nowhere held to 52 yards once upon a time before myles garrett was acquired via trade and donald unretired the rams trading with the chiefs for trent mcduffie was their big offseason splash mcduffie was excellent recording his first interception with his new team and piling up four pass breakups allowing no catches on five targets this was a banner homecoming for donald and a suffocating performance from the d davante s still got it puka nacua was inactive with a hip injury and the rams lack of receiving depth was exposed fortunately davante adams let everyone know he s still got plenty left in the tank piling up eight receptions on 10 targets for 195 yards and two touchdowns the catches and yards were tops for his time with the rams but underscored that the 33 year old can still take over a game if need be and l a needed him second year tight end terrance ferguson shrugged off some bad drops and finished with six catches for 54 yards and a td but his contributions largely came after the game had long been settled beyond that nobody else had more than two catches adams was a force even with stafford dialed in him when adams hauled in an 11 yard fade for six in the third quarter it wasn t just vintage adams but it looked like a called shot an inevitable six points that everyone could see coming and simply couldn t be stopped big blues on both sides on the scoreboard it looked like the giants defense was keeping them in the game more so it was a matthew stafford interception and a kyren williams lost fumble on consecutive offensive plays in the second quarter that did the trick sure the nyg d played its part in those but rams mistakes let the giants hang around in the first half new york mustered just two qb pressures of stafford but somehow only trailed 14 3 with jaxson dart injuring his knee the giants collectively seemed to take a punch to the gut all their wind gone as the game felt like a one sided affair no matter how close the score was l a totaled 481 net yards on 60 plays 8 01 yards per play stafford was pressured on just 15 2 of his dropbacks by game s end a week after a sunday night win over the rival cowboys made the giants the talk of the town they re leaving the west coast battered bruised and beaten in lopsided fashion they ll need to mend up and shore up some issues on both sides of the ball next gen stats insight for giants rams via nfl pro giants rookie right guard francis mauigoa held aaron donald to zero qb pressures on 11 matchups donald had one total qb pressure three tackles and a run stuff on 32 snaps in his first game since the 2023 season nfl research davante adams 11 yard touchdown catch was the 95th of his career including playoffs of 20 yards or fewer which tied antonio gates for second all time only jerry rice 112 has more

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered MCL sprain in loss to Rams
news_mentions.description: Quarterback Jaxson Dart, who was knocked out of Monday's 28-6 loss to the Rams with a left knee injury, is believed to have suffered an MCL sprain, NFL Network Insiders Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo reported.
news_mentions.body_text: the giants must contend with an injury to their star quarterback but there s a small sigh of relief for now quarterback jaxson dart who was knocked out of monday s 28 6 loss to the rams with a left knee injury is believed to have suffered an mcl sprain nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo reported rapoport and garafolo added that dart s x rays were negative and he will have an mri on tuesday we ll know more tomorrow that s in the neighborhood of it head coach john harbaugh said when asked about the report of dart s sprained mcl we ll get an mri tomorrow and have a really good feel for it give you more information then dart sustained his injury on a third and 8 on the team s first drive as he dropped back and tossed a deep pass under pressure he was sandwiched between byron young and josaiah stewart upon letting the ball fly with the force of stewart s body pushing dart s knee inward the second year qb grasped at his knee following the incompletion and was seen to by new york s training staff before walking to the sideline under his own power entering the blue tent and later heading to the locker room for further evaluation he s going to be ok general manager joe schoen told espn s laura rutledge during halftime espn later reported during the broadcast that dart actually tried to re enter the game before the team overruled him supporting the notion the qb s injury shouldn t threaten his season at the time of dart s departure he was 3 of 5 for 20 yards jameis winston entered the game in relief of dart and was unable to find any momentum with a suddenly very overmatched giants team the veteran threw for 111 yards and an interception with a 37 3 passer rating on 11 of 27 passing without a passing game to speak of new york found it equally tough going on the ground cam skattebo managed only 36 yards on 12 totes as the team s leading ball carrier we didn t execute harbaugh said of the offense we didn t complete passes we didn t run the ball well we didn t make play down the field we had opportunities and we just didn t do it the giants were ultimately outgained 182 yards to 481 against the rams further highlighting dart s importance to new york now sitting at 1 1 all eyes for big blue will be on dart s prognosis as the team gathers more information

news_mentions.headline: Giants vs. Rams: Three must-know storylines for Monday's Week 2 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down three must-know storylines in Monday night's game between the New York Giants and Los Angeles Rams.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams ended week 1 as the only nfc west team without a win and the giants seamlessly transitioned into the john harbaugh era by enforcing their will on the cowboys in the sunday night opener just as everyone expected los angeles stumble out of the starting blocks was the more surprising of the two results and it sets up a pivotal early season game between two nfc clubs while the rams look to get into the win column big blue has an opportunity to make a huge statement it would be one thing to open the season by taking down an opponent in a divisional matchup games which often end up being tossups but following that up by traveling cross country to defeat the preseason super bowl favorites would put the league on notice regarding new york s emergence as a surprise contender such a statement would require the giants to earn a win over l a for the first time in a decade the giants have churned through four different head coaches and dropped four consecutive results to the rams since the club s last head to head victory in 2016 but that means little to new york s new era of stars a jaxson dart led contingent that has quickly proven capable of taking the fight to opponents no matter the odds three must know storylines 1 stafford seeks rebound performance matthew stafford s first start of the 2026 season didn t only pale in comparison to his 25 most valuable player campaign it was a low point of his six year tenure with the rams los angeles scored seven points the fewest the team has mustered in stafford s 75 starts and his 61 2 passer rating was the second worst by a reigning mvp in week 1 history per nfl research davante adams managed just 26 receiving yards his second lowest output as a ram while puka nacua who is out with a hip injury was relatively quiet outside of his 41 yard catch to set up los angeles lone score the opening week of the nfl calendar is always home to weird results though while it s strange seeing last year s best offense rank 32nd in points after one game few people if any assume such a result is indicative of how the rest of the season will go the rams caught a bit of a break with giants cornerback paulson adebo going on injured reserve and cb deonte banks being inactive due to a calf injury but they ll still have their work cut out for them without nacua against a new york defense that looked dangerous behind the new off ball linebacking duo of tremaine edmunds and arvell reese and a speedy pass rushing group led by abdul carter and brian burns the giants minimized damage against dallas which finished second in total offense last year holding the cowboys to 244 yards will they make it a trend by doing the same to last season s top total offense or will stafford return to mvp form 2 can giants win through another game of keep away everything was working offensively for new york in john harbaugh s first game at the helm jaxson dart delivered perfect throws with regularity going 23 of 29 for 230 yards three touchdowns and a 134 2 passer rating he also looked more mature and settled running the ball taking a late hit out of bounds early but otherwise protecting himself while rushing for 54 yards cam skattebo and malik nabers both looked good coming off injury and new tight end isaiah likely led all pass catchers in the game with eight receptions for 78 yards and two tds most impressive of all was the giants ability to sustain long drives tiring out dallas defense and preventing dak prescott and co from making it a shootout four of new york s seven possessions hit double digit plays five drives went 60 plus yards in the second half new york fielded two drives of eight plus minutes and a third that took the clock from 5 21 to triple zeroes it didn t matter that dallas scored both times it touched the ball after halftime there was no way to stage a comeback with possessions so limited by new york s methodical marches that ll likely be the strategy again versus the rams and it ll be even more impressive if dart and co can pull it off facing a defense of l a s caliber 3 rams must stop sky from falling it s far too early for chicken little to sound the alarm but it s difficult to imagine a worse start to the season for sean mcvay s crew the rams could neither stop nor score on the 49ers while opening the campaign in australia then after returning to l a star acquisition myles garrett underwent knee surgery that will knock him out at least a month though there was no shortage of criticism after mcvay s plan to travel to melbourne 24 hours before game time failed to yield results the other explanation is potentially more concerning if the rams did feel 100 to play so soon after arriving that would mean they simply didn t measure up to a rival that is likely to challenge them for the division either way l a is now staring at an 0 1 record and a matchup against an upstart giants squad some panic could creep in among the fan base should the rams lose especially with difficult games on deck against the broncos eagles and bills

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys' Jerry Jones: Giants were 'better than we thought they were' in season opener
news_mentions.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones gave the Giants credit on Friday for playing better than he thought they could in the season opener, but he's confident Dallas will recover and improve moving forward.
news_mentions.body_text: dennis green delivered the famous they are who we thought they were line following his cardinals 2006 monday night loss to the bears twenty years later jerry jones came to the opposite realization while assessing his cowboys week 1 defeat to the giants they just did a good job all over jones said of the giants in a friday interview on 105 3 the fan i will tell you they were better than we thought they were i m anxious to see how new york continues to play but really a combination of things we didn t play as well as we should play and can play but they played better than i thought they could jones wasn t the only one surprised by the giants who spectacularly thwarted expectations while never trailing dallas on the way to a season opening victory jaxson dart threw for 230 yards and three touchdowns on 23 of 29 passing and joined battering ram cam skattebo in dolling out damage on the ground the duo combined for 135 rushing yards with skattebo punching one in for six big blue sidelined the cowboys vaunted offense for large swaths of the contest exposing a dallas defense that was expected to be much improved under new defensive coordinator christian parker following a transformative offseason the cowboys instead allowed the giants to win the possession battle by over 13 minutes and blew several coverages both on vital downs and to allow open pass catchers running free in the end zone though jones graciously gave new york its share of credit he also noted the learning process the cowboys have undergone thanks to considerable scheme and personnel changes it s a process dallas must accelerate ahead of sunday s matchup against the commanders of course jones said when asked if he also felt the cowboys opened the season worse than he thought they d be to say it that way i d rather say it more positively that we re not at the level we re not at the level that we thought we would be i can give you a lot of reasons logical reasons you re dealing with conceptually a new coaching staff dealing with a new to a lot of people out there defensive scheme and then you re dealing with people who are fresh in to that scheme it s a challenge to put it together and ready to go we didn t play well last week what i meant to say was new york had really more to do with it than i thought they would so that s a factor but washington could have a lot to do with it here sunday too so we ve got to be ready to step up the level of play there s no question the upcoming matchup with washington gives both teams two divisional games right out of the gate whichever team loses sunday will fall to both 0 2 overall and in the nfc east for all that went wrong to kick off the season jones believes his squad will show up vastly improved for a vital showdown at home the improvement certainly from where we played sunday that improvement is to be expected and will be there jones said i m just gonna say it it will be there i know how hard these guys are working i know their physical capabilities and i also know their motivation so you ll see improvement i ll go on the record as saying that

news_mentions.headline: Two truths and a lie: Ben Johnson is the new Bill Walsh, while John Harbaugh has revived the Giants
news_mentions.description: Is Ben Johnson this generation's Bill Walsh? Are the Giants BACK under John Harbaugh? Which surprise team feels like a mirage? With early-season takes flying all over the NFL world, Bucky Brooks reveals two truths and a lie.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he explores three emerging viewpoints as we head into the 2026 campaign s second sunday the nfl world is still teeming with takes from week 1 that s what happens when a football starved public gets its first real meal since winter initial impressions breed strong opinions ultimately some prove prescient others preposterous with that in mind i d like to evaluate the legitimacy of a few nascent narratives prior to this season s second full helping of pigskin what s real and what s fake which early observations do i stand behind stand against here are two truths and a lie truth ben johnson is this generation s bill walsh no disrespect to kyle shanahan and sean mcvay s wizardry but ben johnson is the guru who will define the 2020s as a legendary play caller the second year head coach of the chicago bears has awakened a hibernating offense transforming it into a juggernaut that has defensive coordinators shaking in their boots as they prepare to face the monsters of the midway johnson s bears bludgeon opponents with a mix of power and pizzazz fielding an exotic smash mouth offense with an mvp caliber quarterback a pair of potential 1 000 yard rushers and a talented collection of pass catchers the savvy schemer can call any play he wants with supreme confidence in the team s talent tactics and execution moreover johnson knows his rock solid offensive line will impose its will on foes leaving them battered and bruised after a 60 minute war in the trenches given the overwhelming physicality and toughness this unit displays whenever it takes the field chicago is establishing itself as an offensive bully that pushes around adversaries chicago finished 2025 ranked ninth in points and sixth in total offense but johnson boldly stated in august that he wants the bears to set an nfl scoring record in 2026 then they hit the road for the season opener and dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers flexing their muscles against a completely overwhelmed defense the bears enjoyed a rare 250 250 game eclipsing the yardage figure in passing 261 and rushing 291 d andre swift led the way on the ground with 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries while kyle monangai reached the century mark on just 10 totes including a 61 yard touchdown meanwhile caleb williams completed 72 4 percent of his passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns adding 65 yards and two more scores with his legs the crazy part is that kalif raymond not rome odunze or luther burden led the receiving corps in targets nine catches eight and yards 84 shoot tight end colston loveland who took the league by storm in the second half of his rookie season didn t even have a catch and yet chicago nearly scored 60 points in 60 minutes the video game like exhibition demonstrated johnson s brilliance as a play caller further proving his deft ability to juggle a collection of weapons that s something he showcased as detroit s offensive coordinator from 2022 through 24 when the lions fielded three straight top five units in points and yards now he s doing the same thing in the windy city pulling all the right levers with a potent pack of playmakers bill walsh transformed the game with his west coast offense and a star studded lineup that featured joe montana jerry rice and roger craig among others the hall of fame coach made a pass heavy approach the norm these days johnson has balance back in vogue chicago ranked third in rushing and 10th in passing last season in 2026 the bears could finish in the top five in both categories with a well rounded approach creative scheming and a deep bag of tricks johnson is setting the standard for modern offense i can t wait to see what his bears do this sunday against the vikings brian flores blitz happy defense is challenging to most though johnson boasts a 5 1 record when calling plays against the ballyhooed coordinator truth the giants are back with john harbaugh the new york giants have enjoyed their greatest successes with hard nosed disciplinarians leading the charge bill parcells and tom coughlin each guided the franchise to two super bowl titles with both head men using old school blueprints that prioritized discipline toughness and attention to detail over flashy schemes and star power that throwback approach is back in the building with john harbaugh in charge the soon to be 64 year old compiled a 180 113 record with the baltimore ravens winning a lombardi trophy and six afc north titles while appearing in the playoffs 12 times in 18 seasons the grizzled leader built a culture of hard work physicality and toughness in baltimore holding his players accountable for meeting the standard on every snap now he s doing the same thing in nyc in a dazzling debut on sunday night football harbaugh guided his team to a 28 20 upset of the eternally hyped dallas cowboys suddenly the football world is buzzing about the upstart g men being dark horse contenders in the nfc the 2026 giants are built like the proud organization s four super bowl winning squads from 1986 1990 2007 and 2011 the first three of those teams in particular relied heavily on dominant defense a potent running game and a quarterback who makes plays in the clutch sound familiar this year s d still has some questions in the back end but the salty front seven is vintage big blue new york has a collection of pass rushers brian burns kayvon thibodeaux abdul carter chauncey golston and arvell reese who can jump into the old nascar packages that terrorized opponents in previous nyg title runs moreover free agent addition tremaine edmunds gives this team a reliable nerve center with the middle linebacker directing traffic to keep everyone on the same page the unit showed championship caliber communication and attention to detail last sunday night while playing with the physicality that s always been a hallmark of the franchise s great defenses offensively the giants have embraced a slow down style forcing opponents to adjust to a deliberate run oriented game plan that chews up the clock and reduces total possessions while qb jaxson dart will get chances to push the ball downfield to malik nabers and isaiah likely these giants want to control games with a lower risk approach that leans heavily on cam skattebo and the rushing attack to string together first downs the ground and pound strategy is part of the team s plan to set the tempo and push opponents out of their comfort zone particularly when going against high powered offenses that want to play shootouts against the cowboys the giants comfortably won time of possession 36 40 to 23 20 and went 9 for 11 on third down new york ran 16 more offensive plays than dallas 68 to 52 which helps explain why cowboys qb dak prescott lost his patience and threw an uncharacteristic interception setting up a giants score right before halftime admittedly it s only been one game maintaining perspective is key and the giants immediately face another stiff test in prime time visiting los angeles this week to play the rams on monday night football still i m confident that the culture and blueprint harbaugh is establishing will have big blue back in the championship hunt sooner than many anticipate lie the nfc west actually has four good teams the excitement following the cardinals week 1 upset of the chargers has led some observers to offer hot takes on the bird gang s immediate prospects in 2026 the optimism springing from the desert is a far cry from the doom and gloom that hovered over the franchise for most of the offseason while i hate to be the bearer of bad news to a fan base reveling in its week 1 win the cardinals are destined to finish as cellar dwellers and miss the playoffs for a fifth straight season the fanfare over mike lafleur s impressive debut is understandable but it will eventually subside as teams settle in and arizona s film circulates around the league astute observers will quickly scan last week s game and see the chargers beat themselves with a series of blunders and miscues typically seen at your local high school on a friday night the bolts lost the turnover battle minus two had a punt blocked and were stopped on downs three times the errors allowed the cardinals to dominate time of possession 37 31 to 22 29 and run 21 more plays although the cardinals deserve credit for finding a winning formula victories will be very hard to come by in a brutally tough schedule looking at the rosters and depth charts throughout the nfc west it is hard to find a position group where the cardinals have an edge in personnel yes arizona has a few blue chip players see te trey mcbride s budda baker and rookie rb jeremiyah love but the superior depth and talent on the seahawks rams and 49ers will require lafleur and co to out scheme everyone and in case you haven t noticed those three teams are pretty damn well coached in a league where jimmys and joes matter more than x s and o s the talent discrepancy between the cardinals and the nfc s true contenders ultimately will lead to a string of losses that leaves arizona behind the competition this sunday the cards host the reigning super bowl champions sam darnold remains sidelined for the seahawks but as we saw in seattle s 13 10 win over new england mike macdonald s team is plenty capable of winning games with defense though lafleur certainly can continue to build this team s competitive culture the first time head coach faces long odds when it comes to orchestrating a true rags to riches turnaround in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: New York Giants training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Jeremy Bergman provides a refresher on the New York Giants' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the new york giants offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location quest diagnostics training facility east rutherford new jersey fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at buffalo bills 1 p m et on saturday aug 9 nfl network week 2 vs new york jets 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs new england patriots 8 p m et on thursday aug 21 prime video 2025 schedule note despite finishing the 2024 season tied for the worst overall record the giants enter the 2025 campaign with the hardest strength of schedule in the league for context the two other three win teams from last season the browns and titans rank 13th and 29th in sos respectively nfl research what you need to know 1 not quite the four headed monster in cleveland the giants quarterback quartet will still be an oddity to watch this summer tommy devito is the lone returning signal caller from 2024 but is slated to be qb4 if that by season s beginning new york imported two charismatic leaders in russell wilson and jameis winston with the former expected to take starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1

material_news_signals.headline: Cowboys' Jerry Jones: Giants were 'better than we thought they were' in season opener
material_news_signals.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones gave the Giants credit on Friday for playing better than he thought they could in the season opener, but he's confident Dallas will recover and improve moving forward.
material_news_signals.body_text: dennis green delivered the famous they are who we thought they were line following his cardinals 2006 monday night loss to the bears twenty years later jerry jones came to the opposite realization while assessing his cowboys week 1 defeat to the giants they just did a good job all over jones said of the giants in a friday interview on 105 3 the fan i will tell you they were better than we thought they were i m anxious to see how new york continues to play but really a combination of things we didn t play as well as we should play and can play but they played better than i thought they could jones wasn t the only one surprised by the giants who spectacularly thwarted expectations while never trailing dallas on the way to a season opening victory jaxson dart threw for 230 yards and three touchdowns on 23 of 29 passing and joined battering ram cam skattebo in dolling out damage on the ground the duo combined for 135 rushing yards with skattebo punching one in for six big blue sidelined the cowboys vaunted offense for large swaths of the contest exposing a dallas defense that was expected to be much improved under new defensive coordinator christian parker following a transformative offseason the cowboys instead allowed the giants to win the possession battle by over 13 minutes and blew several coverages both on vital downs and to allow open pass catchers running free in the end zone though jones graciously gave new york its share of credit he also noted the learning process the cowboys have undergone thanks to considerable scheme and personnel changes it s a process dallas must accelerate ahead of sunday s matchup against the commanders of course jones said when asked if he also felt the cowboys opened the season worse than he thought they d be to say it that way i d rather say it more positively that we re not at the level we re not at the level that we thought we would be i can give you a lot of reasons logical reasons you re dealing with conceptually a new coaching staff dealing with a new to a lot of people out there defensive scheme and then you re dealing with people who are fresh in to that scheme it s a challenge to put it together and ready to go we didn t play well last week what i meant to say was new york had really more to do with it than i thought they would so that s a factor but washington could have a lot to do with it here sunday too so we ve got to be ready to step up the level of play there s no question the upcoming matchup with washington gives both teams two divisional games right out of the gate whichever team loses sunday will fall to both 0 2 overall and in the nfc east for all that went wrong to kick off the season jones believes his squad will show up vastly improved for a vital showdown at home the improvement certainly from where we played sunday that improvement is to be expected and will be there jones said i m just gonna say it it will be there i know how hard these guys are working i know their physical capabilities and i also know their motivation so you ll see improvement i ll go on the record as saying that
