news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: Jim Harbaugh 'not deterred' by Chargers' 0-2 start following double-digit loss to Raiders
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Chargers started 0-2 with losses to the Arizona Cardinals and Las Vegas Raiders.
news_mentions.body_text: the los angeles chargers look in trouble after sunday s 26 14 loss to the las vegas raiders which pushed the club to 0 2 to start the season despite the dismal start jim harbaugh remained positive i m not deterred harbaugh said via espn no one in that locker room is deterred the chargers were supposed to romp over two rebuilding teams to open the season instead they began the year with back to back upset losses at home it wasn t just bad it was 100 years in the making bad for l a according to opta stats the chargers are the second team in nfl history to lose back to back games by double digits with both coming at home against teams that had a sub 200 win percentage the previous season the other was the 1926 racine tornadoes oct 10 17 who played just one more game before folding everything looks disjointed for the chargers justin herbert doesn t look comfortable under new offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel the offensive line once again continues to struggle turnovers plague the unit the defense has been pushed around particularly up front hasn t done enough to disrupt the qb and the secondary has gotten picked apart there s no time for us to be patient with how we re playing herbert said it s not good enough so we have to be better in the second straight 26 14 loss herbert struggled to find consistency sunday he finished 15 for 27 for 192 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions omarion hampton s fourth quarter fumble sealed the team s loss for the rotten cherry on top pro bowl right tackle joe alt who struggled all game with penalties was called for a hold in the end zone giving the raiders a safety and the game s final two points we ll look at the tape we ll go back to work that s all i know how to do harbaugh said the first two games were important for the chargers to get off on a good foot because a menacing gauntlet lies ahead starting with week 3 against the buffalo bills l a faces 2025 playoff teams in five of its next seven games the other two squads patrick mahomes chiefs and lamar jackson s ravens either the chargers will devolve and wash out before thanksgiving or they ll barnstorm their difficult stretch and prove harbaugh correct defensive back derwin james took a fiery approach after sunday s disappointing loss we got to look each other in the eye man and just tell the truth and just get better james said because right now that s just looks trash i m angry but being angry don t fix anything the chargers have a lot to fix quickly

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job done stroud played solidly avoiding big mistakes and peppered the middle of the field however the lack of a rushing attack put the offense in bad spots the retooled offensive line looked a lot like last year opening few holes on the ground and not giving stroud much time the texans offense missed nico collins badly with none of the young wide receivers stepping up tight end dalton schultz 12 receptions for 140 yards generated 103 yards more than any other texans pass catcher on sunday houston missed several opportunities to make it a game with an early flubbed field goal attempt a stuffed fourth down and a missed 58 yard field goal all coming in the first three quarters the texans got into the red zone four times however they scored zero tds and accounted for just three points on those drives that won t get it done burrow hooks up with chase for two tds in road win there weren t gaudy numbers but joe burrow and ja marr chase showed why they are a premier duo burrow came out insistent on getting chase involved early the wr paid him off with a ridiculous twisting toe tap 32 yard td in the second quarter the duo hooked up again on a scramble drill to put up cincy by two scores in the third quarter the offensive line was an issue on sunday burrow was sacked five times and the texans generated 10 qb hits orlando brown five qb pressures two sacks dalton risner six qb pressures sack and dylan fairchild five qb pressures sack all struggled the good news is that when the bengals put up fewer than 300 yards in years past they usually took an l in 2026 they re 2 0 while the offense irons things out next gen stats insight for bengals texans via nfl pro the bengals generated 27 pressures on 62 dropbacks 43 5 the most pressures generated in a single game by the bengals since al golden took over as the bengals defensive coordinator last season five bengals recorded four or more pressures in week 2 including jonathan allen seven boye mafe seven cedric johnson six cashius howell five and dexter lawrence four allen recorded his most pressures in a game in the last four seasons while mafe tied his most pressures generated in a game in his career nfl research the bengals did not allow a single touchdown in week 2 at the texans their first game allowing no touchdowns since week 3 2022 at the jets cincinnati broke a franchise long and nfl long streak of 65 consecutive games allowing at least one touchdown the bills now own the longest active streak in the nfl having allowed at least one touchdown in 47 consecutive games back to top kevin patra s takeaways patriots splash big plays to run away from pittsburgh drake maye didn t author a particularly pretty game but the quarterback threw a trove of big plays to move the ball against an experienced steelers defense maye connected on passes of 29 29 30 and 63 yards the pats also generated big runs starting with treveyon henderson s 39 yard td sprint and rhamondre stevenson added a 24 yarder early in the second half the pats had several miscues that kept the game closer than it could have been stevenson fumbled in plus territory on the opening drive and maye later threw an interception in scoring range coming off a disappointing week 1 maye didn t fully bounce back missing several plays he made a year ago and he wasn t comfortable in the pocket behind an offensive line that struggled especially as injuries struck however the splash plays highlighted by a 63 yarder to romeo doubs after maye escaped the pocket were a welcomed sight after last week in week 1 the qb didn t have a pass play of 20 plus yards on sunday he generated four the offense still has strides to make but it s much easier after a win that avoids an 0 2 start pats d gets in on the big plays it wasn t just the offense that sprayed big plays on the foxborough turf the new england defensive line dominated steelers blockers blasting aaron rodgers repeatedly the pats biggest plays came when they destroyed the 42 year old qb with the steelers in field goal range on third and 7 christian elliss walloped rodgers for a sack and forced fumble the ball bounced around for an eventual loss of 36 yards forcing a punt then early in the fourth quarter christian barmore hit rodgers forcing another fumble that elijah ponder scooped up for a touchdown effectively putting the game away for good measure rookie gabe jacas grabbed a flubbed catch for an interception that ensured the steelers wouldn t find pay dirt on sunday the pats allowed just 235 yards and 2 of 12 on third downs ugly day for steelers offense every aspect was bad for pittsburgh s offense the o line got walloped troy fautanu had a forgettable afternoon and guard spencer anderson was destroyed allowing seven qb pressures and a sack per next gen stats aaron rodgers was never comfortable struggled to maneuver muddy pockets and looked every bit of 42 on sunday before sitting for the final drive he completed 23 of 39 attempts for 187 yards threw an int and took four sacks the passing attack couldn t get out of its own way with drops and off the mark passes being the most memorable plays dk metcalf continued his atrocious start to the season catching four passes on nine targets for 27 yards with several miscues christian gonzalez usually locks up wr1s but right now metcalf is barely playing like a wr3 the run game was absent from start to finish putting the offense in bad down and distance situations mike mccarthy has a lot to figure out after two uninspiring offensive performances to open the season next gen stats insight for patriots steelers via nfl pro the patriots defense blitzed the steelers on 18 total dropbacks their most in a game since week 10 of 2024 when sending extra pass rushers they held the steelers to 43 passing yards 2 7 yards per attempt and a 22 2 success rate while also recording eight pressures two sacks and one interception nfl research the steelers scored just three points against the patriots tied for the second fewest by any team in which aaron rodgers was the starting quarterback rodgers finished with 187 passing yards no touchdowns and one interception his fifth straight start with one passing touchdown or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways packers avoid first 0 2 start in 20 years with gutty effort it wasn t pretty but green bay is in the win column in 2026 jordan love threw for just 145 yards the packers offense converted one of nine third downs and picked up at least one first down on only four of 12 drives and green bay committed 14 accepted penalties but a win is a win down 17 7 in the fourth quarter love and co strung together one of their better drives of the afternoon picking up four first downs with help from a field flipping azareye 39 h thomas defensive pass interference call and finding the end zone to pull within three a quick stop and skyy moore punt return later and green bay was in position to tie the game with a field goal after another three down stop in overtime with two consecutive sacks shared by four packers defenders green bay rode backup backs kaleb johnson and chris brooks into gang green territory where after another awful jets penalty and matthew golden first down trey smack smacked home the game winning field goal sunday s turnaround came in stark contrast to how the packers finished their season opener against minnesota when they blew a two score lead and lost by three scores green bay fans will be happy to sheath their knives for lafleur ahead of the home opener on thursday night as the pack have avoided starting 0 2 for the first time since 2006 jets collapse down stretch blow chance to start 2 0 on a gray afternoon in the meadowlands new york was in position to ride out an ugly win over the visiting packers through three quarters the jets had made fewer mistakes avoided nasty injuries and adjusted well to what green bay was throwing at them then fortunes turned up 14 7 new york benefitted from a marshawn lloyd fumble at the packers 18 yard line but the jets went three and out and neglected to go for it on fourth and 1 from the 9 setting up a field goal later tied 17 17 after two green bay scoring drives with the ball at the 50 yard line under two minutes to the jets decided to try a fourth and 1 dive the risk didn t pay off as braelon allen was stuffed at the line the packers didn t make anything of the turnover on downs but took their momentum into overtime where geno smith was sacked on back to back plays and new york punted the ball and game back to the pack for the second straight year the jets have outplayed their opponents in their home opener aaron rodgers steelers in 2025 only to fall just short in the end after such a positive start the loss felt like a familiar finish for aaron glenn s group and serves as a missed opportunity for new york to start 2 0 for the first time in 11 years sloppy outing for both sides matt lafleur and aaron glenn will use this game film as teaching tape teaching their players what not to do lest they play a more disciplined opponent in ensuing weeks the packers and jets combined for 27 accepted penalties for 289 yards an ugly affair all around green bay and new york kept each other in the game with ill timed fouls for the packers that s 26 penalties in two games only three teams have incurred more accepted fouls in the first two games of a campaign the weather might not have contributed to the poor discipline but it surely had an effect on the poor hands in this one the teams combined for eight fumbles five by green bay three by new york though only one was lost the jets special teams which had been key in their week 1 victory was super shaky with isaiah williams muffing two punts and new york surrendering a 63 yard skyy moore punt return leading to the packers game tying field goal drive next gen stats insight for jets packers via nfl pro packers pass rusher lukas van ness generated a career high nine pressures against the jets recording five of them in under 2 5 seconds tied for the third most by a packers defender since 2020 nfl research the jets blew a 17 7 fourth quarter lead in their week 2 overtime loss to the packers it was their first time blowing a double digit fourth quarter lead since week 9 of 2020 vs the patriots they had won 14 straight games in which they held a double digit fourth quarter lead entering week 2 back to top nick shook s takeaways browns pull off the improbable cleveland began sunday s contest exhibiting many of the same discouraging signs that doomed them in week 1 operational errors and penalties general disorganization and an inability to convert in key offensive situations unlike last week the browns defense showed up and kept the game within reach opening the door for deshaun watson and the rest of cleveland s offense to find a rhythm in the second half watson leaned on the youngsters around him connecting with rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston to keep drives moving using harold fannin as a safety valve and even converting a couple of third downs with his legs it was far from pretty but cleveland s offense pieced together two touchdown drives in the second half including a 12 play 68 yard march that ate up 6 07 and ended with blake whiteheart sneaking across the field for a wide open connection with watson for a 17 yard go ahead touchdown the browns had plenty to overcome sunday including poor offensive line play early self inflicted errors and a two hour weather delay and managed to outlast the buccaneers with a defensive stand amid a driving rain it s only one win but it will be a joyous flight back home to cleveland mayfield looks very uncomfortable in this offense after eight quarters of evidence it s pretty clear that baker mayfield hasn t found a comfortable place in offensive coordinator zac robinson s scheme tampa bay s approach was peculiar at times sunday producing sequences that saw repeated screens and swing passes to running backs while avoiding attempting to stretch the field much until late in the contest mayfield looks skittish in the pocket regardless of situation hesitating to fire and often trying to buy more time to survey as initial concepts fail to produce clear passing opportunities or he fails to spot them when they do come open it s only two weeks but it s fair to say the buccaneers offense looks a lot like the 2025 falcons also directed by robinson lacking consistent identity and intent while being operated by a quarterback who doesn t appear to be relaxed or confident that s not a good sign for a team aiming to climb back to the top of the nfc south qb change delayed for a week entering sunday s game many browns fans were eager to watch primarily because they believed it would be the last time they d have to suffer through an ugly deshaun watson led performance before coach todd monken decided to bench watson for shedeur sanders well they ll have to enjoy cleveland s win with a bit of bitterness because watson performed well enough to justify starting again next week he was far from perfect his performance is best described as fine but watson played an integral role in cleveland managing to mount a comeback confidently firing toward kc concepcion denzel boston and even isaiah bond for one key completion along the sideline and on must have downs in the fourth quarter watson kept the chains moving there s certainly no guarantee his success was anything more than a one week aberration but he looked much more like a quarterback capable of playing in the nfl this week than he did in week 1 when monken breaks down watson s performance to reporters this week his positive remarks will be much more believable next gen stats insight for browns buccaneers via nfl pro deshaun watson completed 24 of 30 pass attempts for 238 yards and two touchdowns averaging 0 25 epa per dropback his most as a brown and most since week 12 of the 2020 season nfl research denzel boston joined bobby mitchell and andre davis as the only browns with a receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games boston s first two receiving touchdowns went for 46 yards and 55 yards respectively he is the fourth player in nfl history to have a 45 plus yard receiving touchdown in each of their first two career games joining sammy white 1976 mac haik 1968 and bob hayes 1965 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways hurts comes in clutch after tough outing it wasn t the best day at the office for jalen hurts but when met with a deadline needing to lead a game winning drive with 1 56 remaining the super bowl lix most valuable player delivered hurts who threw a bad interception in the end zone during his first possession and another pick during the drive immediately preceding his last led philly on a nine play 65 yard drive to take the lead and the win from the titans he did so by becoming laser focused on devonta smith throwing to the eagles no 1 wide receiver on four of eight passes including a pretty 19 yard gain on third and 6 to set up philadelphia at the goal line on the next play he hit darius cooper for the wideout s first career touchdown to propel the eagles to a surprisingly difficult win he wasn t nearly perfect sunday going 26 of 37 for 264 yards two touchdowns and the two picks but he was clutch as ever when called upon to leave titans fans with some achy breaky hearts titans defense finally runs out of gas tennessee couldn t end drives quickly in the first half against philly allowing the eagles to dominate the time of possession with three drives that all took 11 or more plays and over 6 minutes 30 seconds although the titans did allow touchdowns on the second and third drives they made a massive early stop setting themselves up to take a 7 0 lead after amani hooker intercepted jalen hurts and returned it 92 yards to philadelphia s 10 yard line robert saleh s crew buckled down after halftime finally gaining some momentum with a pair of three and outs in the third quarter to no one s surprise jeffery simmons led the way making life difficult for hurts racking up seven pressures jacob martin had six and jermaine johnson had four as hurts seemed to regularly be running for his life and forced into poor or difficult throws it was simmons wrapping his arms around hurts as the qb threw his second pick of the day which eventually set the titans up for a go ahead joey slye field goal with just under two minutes remaining unfortunately a gassed tennessee defense that was on the field for over 13 minutes more than its offense couldn t hold up against philly s last second heroics after that eagles winning by skin of their teeth philadelphia found itself shorthanded right off the bat against the titans saquon barkley suffered a stinger on his first carry of the game after being stuffed at the line of scrimmage and having multiple big bodies land on him tight end dallas goedert then injured his knee on the second play of the second quarter barkley came back for the second half but only handled three more carries as he was clearly affected perhaps those setbacks disrupted philly s game plan but the offense fell into a deep sleep in the second half before miraculously waking up for some last drive magic that left philly s defense to keep it close enough for a win and vic fangio s crew luckily abided the eagles will certainly want some plays back especially after a few woeful missed tackles while allowing tennessee to go 84 yards to take the lead toward the end of the fourth quarter but the eagles ultimately held the titans to a field goal late just as they stumbled last week but recovered to stop a commanders two point conversion toward game s end to preserve a win it s been a high wire act thus far as the eagles try to find their groove but 2 0 is 2 0 next gen stats insight for eagles titans yard strike from bo nix early in the second quarter to set up denver s offense at jacksonville s 1 yard line and although denver settled for a field goal on that drive waddle was only getting started he logged six more catches on the day with four gaining double digit yardage and almost all of them making a key difference in denver s offensive awakening for one afternoon the broncos were able to realize the dream they d carried with them for years spending their sunday watching a deep threat thrive with a quarterback capable of finding him it s crucial to denver s offensive arc in 2026 one that can t rely too heavily on nix s playmaking or its stable of running backs the broncos will be at their best when waddle is a central figure and they saw firsthand how he can change their outlook on sunday jacksonville finally falters it s been quite some time since the jaguars fell apart in a regular season game sunday s performance wasn t quite a disintegration but it was a disappointing finish for an offense that could do no wrong in week 1 and suddenly couldn t find a method of success to counter denver s comeback after a strong first half that saw trevor lawrence pepper denver s defense with pinpoint passes lawrence regressed to the quarterback who too frequently attempts highly questionable passes and pays the price for it his interception swung momentum in the broncos favor and gave denver permission to hunt him for the rest of the day and the jaguars failed to adjust it all starts up front for jacksonville which struggled with denver s increased defensive aggression in the second half and surrendered a qb pressure rate of 45 2 hampering a passing attack that has been among the best in the nfl since the midpoint of the 2025 season fortunately it happened in week 2 against a top tier defense providing the jaguars with tape to correct they just need to ensure it doesn t become a weekly occurrence broncos bounce back save for one drive the broncos looked horribly overmatched in week 1 their offensive operation wasn t great in the first half sunday either with cbs cameras repeatedly showing a demonstrably frustrated davis webb shouting angrily on the sideline after their latest failure all of that changed though when cornerback riley moss slid in front of a lawrence pass in the fourth quarter and intercepted it breathing new life into the broncos and their anxious fans nix and co capitalized covering 64 yards in 10 plays and finishing with a well designed play action pass to fullback nate adkins for a touchdown to tie it at 13 defensively the broncos regained their identity after the moss interception shutting down a jaguars offense that moved freely between the 20s earlier in the contest and nearly intercepting lawrence a second time the following drive a five play 56 yard march that ended in a jonah coleman rushing score from 3 yards out almost seemed inevitable in one half the broncos returned to form and nix finally found some result thus far the chargers have been held to 14 points in each of their opening losses the operation was sloppy across the board on sunday against las vegas much of the blame will rightfully be laid at justin herbert s feet he fumbled the ball three times half of the team s six times coughing it up although the chargers only lost one of those he wasn t able to find a rhythm early which caused l a to turn to omarion hampton to get something going 15 carries for 70 yards in the first half but when hampton slowed during the final two quarters with 24 yards on another eight carries the chargers really quieted down herbert finished 15 of 27 for 192 yards one touchdown two interceptions and a 59 5 passer rating there was ugliness everywhere though herbert s first pick happened because david njoku dropped the ball and right tackle joe alt committed four penalties trailing by three and facing a third and 1 toward the end of the third quarter the chargers self sabotaged when jake slaughter accidentally snapped the ball into tre harris legs as the receiver went in motion simply nothing went smoothly for the new look chargers offense chargers must take hard look at themselves it is not an overreaction to say the chargers are in deep deep trouble they have looked that bad and their upcoming schedule is that brutal los angeles offense as mentioned is in a state of disarray and the defense has made far too many mistakes in the first two weeks against offenses that are not considered world beaters now winless heading into week 3 the chargers are set to face a murderers row of opponents they play the bills seahawks broncos chiefs rams texans and ravens over the next seven games with a bye in week 7 there are no easy games in the nfl but jim harbaugh and co opened the season news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams considered 'week to week' after suffering hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Caleb Williams is viewed as "week to week" after injurying his hamstring during Sunday's loss to the Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears expect caleb williams to miss time but the quarterback avoided a major hamstring injury head coach ben johnson said monday on espn 1000 that the team believes williams will be week to week following an mri exam it sounds like it s gonna be a week to week deal for him johnson said i gotta still talk with our trainer here we ll do that here shortly and i ll have the lowdown from him but it sounds like it s week to week but will likely miss some time johnson later told reporters the bears received a somewhat encouraging report about williams injury adding that the qb may not practice this week williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after coming up lame on a scramble in the fourth quarter the qb was emotional while being carted off the field but was reportedly seen in the locker room later walking without aid and only a slight limp yeah potentially dodged a bullet johnson added on monday we ll see he s tough and he comes back from these types of things better than the average human so we ll see while potentially missing the qb for next monday night s week 3 game against the philadelphia eagles is a negative overall it could be much worse for williams tyson bagent will get the start if williams is unable to go given the fragility of hamstring injuries the bears could play it cautiously with williams an injury that returns with a tweak if not properly healed could linger all season with a soft tissue injury it will be interesting to see how willing williams is to scamper when he returns he has used his legs with aplomb to open the 2026 season

news_mentions.headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffers dislocated left elbow in loss to Cowboys
news_mentions.description: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the first half of Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels has been beset by another injury the washington commanders quarterback suffered a dislocated left elbow in sunday s 37 20 loss head coach dan quinn told reporters following the game quinn told reporters x rays did not show a fracture but daniels will travel back home with the team and undergo more imaging on monday once i know an update that we can move forward with then i ll give you that quinn said man are we bummed for him he was really playing his ass off we will rally so hard around marcus mariota until jayden s back that s what we talked about as a team daniels suffered the injury on the final play of the first half he stumbled after taking a snap under center and braced himself with his left arm before falling to the turf in obvious pain as his pass attempt fell incomplete medical staff quickly attended to daniels on the field at at t stadium and he was eventually carted to the locker room the commanders ruled daniels out after halftime i thought looking back on it at the 1 yard line we need touchdowns quinn said of the third and goal play call with three seconds remaining in the second quarter i don t regret that call obviously any time someone s injured you play the what if game i don t think this is one of those times for me i hate that it happened i wasn t hesitant about going into that spot we re going to be aggressive in this game against their offense so i don t regret that obviously the outcome sucks but it wasn t a what if or i wish i had done something differently daniels was 11 of 17 for 96 yards with a touchdown at the time of his injury he also had 69 yards rushing on seven attempts mariota started the second half for the commanders in place of daniels and as quinn mentioned will take over under center for as long as daniels is out daniels dislocated his left elbow last season during a game against the seahawks on nov 2 2025 and missed the following three weeks he would appear in just one other game that season a blowout loss to the vikings in which he aggravated the injury daniels electrified the nfl in 2024 leading washington to a surprise trip to the nfc championship game and winning offensive rookie of the year honors last year however was a slog for both daniels and the commanders daniels started seven games during his sophomore season and was sidelined multiple times suffering a knee sprain and a hamstring injury before the november elbow injury

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffers hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's loss to the Minnesota Vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter.
news_mentions.body_text: chicago bears quarterback caleb williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter williams went down while scrambling on first and goal with chicago trailing 6 3 the qb appeared to be in pain on the field grabbing at his right leg williams had to be helped off the field and was carted from the sideline to the locker room bears head coach ben johnson told reporters after the game that he did not have a sense on the severity of the injury we ll know more tomorrow johnson said johnson added he had spoken with williams prior to his postgame news conference and the third year pro was in good spirits i m actually happy it s nothing with the knee johnson told reporters that was my first inclination but the hamstring could be pretty damaging as well we ll see how bad it is tomorrow and we ll go from there chgo sports adam jahns reported that williams was seen in the locker room walking under his own power without the use of crutches one week after exploding for 59 points in a win over the panthers williams and the bears offense struggled against a stout vikings defense williams was 15 of 26 for 138 yards with an interception on a rainy day at soldier field at the time of the injury and chicago proceeded to have a potential game tying field goal blocked after the drive stalled with williams out of the game tyson bagent replaced williams under center for chicago and nearly led the bears to a comeback but bagent was sacked by dallas turner on fourth down in the red zone to end the game bagent would be in line to start if williams missed extended time bagent started four games during the 2023 season compiling a 2 2 record
