news_mentions.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba continues to dominate, no matter who's at QB: 'This guy is a wizard'
news_mentions.body_text: glendale ariz jaxon smith njigba often found himself in 34 the zone 34 last season but it had been nearly five years since he ascended to the level he showcased sunday afternoon including playoffs the star wideout racked up ten 100 yard games in 2025 during the seattle seahawks 39 romp to their second super bowl title twice the reigning nfl offensive player of the year snagged a pair of touchdown passes in a game but never thrice like he did when breaking into the national spotlight as a sophomore at ohio state in the thrilling 2022 rose bowl smith njigba set an fbs bowl record with 347 receiving yards and three touchdown receptions he didn 39 t quite match that distance with his 155 receiving yards on sunday but he scored three touchdowns for the first time since his college days as the seahawks improved to 2 0 with a 31 7 win against the arizona cardinals 34 it 39 s been a minute 34 said a reflective smith njigba 34 it 39 s awesome being in that zone putting points up for our team whatever it takes to win i 39 m willing to do whatever it takes any time you get opportunities you got to execute and put points on the board 34 not only did smith njigba become the first seahawks player since dk metcalf with three receiving touchdowns in a game he also made life significantly easier for backup quarterback drew lock who started in place of sam darnold seattle 39 s starting quarterback is out with a glute injury though coach mike macdonald said postgame that darnold 39 s timetable for returning has shifted quite drastically for the better darnold could start as soon as sept 27 against the washington commanders it was lock 39 s show on sunday however with smith njigba in a leading role on seattle 39 s second offensive play of the game lock dropped back and heaved a deep pass down the right sideline for smith njigba who was five yards behind the last line of arizona 39 s defense when he caught the ball smith njigba deked cardinals cornerback will johnson with a devastating head fake then slipped behind safety budda baker for a career long 82 yard touchdown reception 34 that 39 s my hooping skills right there 34 smith njigba said of his head fake lock wasn 39 t expecting smith njigba to be so open nor for him to run his route in such a manner 34 but that 39 s the beauty of playing with him 34 lock said 34 he 39 s going to find ways to get open it might not be the most conventional but that 39 s what makes him a ballplayer and that 39 s what makes him one of the best receivers the offensive player of the year last year 34 smith njigba 39 s next two touchdowns overshadowed a somewhat sloppy first half for the seahawks in which seattle and arizona each scored seven points he put seattle up for good on the opening drive of the second half when he ran a slant to perfection sneaking behind cardinals cornerback max melton to corral a seed from lock for a seven yard touchdown the 24 year old put the game out of reach early in the fourth quarter when lock threaded a pass through three cardinals defenders on third and 6 from arizona 39 s 12 yard line it wasn 39 t until aj barner plunged into the end zone from one yard out with 1 11 remaining in the game that a seahawks player not named smith njigba found the end zone for seattle this season smith njigba had the seahawks 39 lone touchdown in their season opening 13 10 win against the new england patriots as much as the seahawks long for the return of darnold who has missed all but five offensive snaps this season smith njigba is well on his way to another banner year regardless his 277 receiving yards lead the league while his four receiving touchdowns are tied with detroit lions standout amon ra st brown smith njigba has proven that seattle 39 s offense isn 39 t about who is throwing the passes or what scheme first year offensive coordinator brian fleury runs the game plan is quite simple get the ball to smith njigba and let the all pro figure out the rest 34 when he catches the ball we 39 re just like 39 man this guy is a wizard 39 34 defensive lineman leonard williams said 34 it 39 s nice to have big playmakers on offense 34 it doesn 39 t hurt to have a stingy defense either seattle allowed a game tying touchdown pass from jacoby brissett to trey mcbride to start the second quarter but otherwise stifled the cardinals arizona finished the game with only 151 yards of total offense including just 44 yards after halftime including last year 39 s playoff run the seahawks have won a franchise record 12 consecutive games thanks in large part to their defensive dominance the members of the unit that refers to itself as the dark side didn 39 t give that accomplishment much thought in the immediate aftermath of sunday 39 s shellacking 34 i think that 39 s what 39 s so beautiful about this team 34 williams said 34 i don 39 t think anyone 39 s thinking about that i think we 39 re so honed in on just being who we are 34 two games into their title defense the seahawks have demonstrated they are a well oiled machine capable of running it back and contending for what would be the franchise 39 s third super bowl title certainly seattle would benefit from darnold running the offense again but lock was more than adequate in his absence completing 19 of 26 attempts for 235 yards and those three touchdown passes to smith njigba 34 we 39 re on record about how we feel about him 34 macdonald said of lock 34 so he just backed that up today but it 39 s a 12 as 1 thing everybody having each other 39 s back 34 perhaps smith njigba though is a bit more irreplaceable than the rest of the seahawks the franchise made it abundantly clear how it feels about smith njigba when it made him the highest paid wide receiver in the nfl on an annual basis with a four year 168 8 million deal in march the seahawks dished the dough out for smith njigba because few nfl wide receivers if any can carry an offense quite like he can sunday 39 s performance was the latest in a line of many dominant ones for smith njigba who hauled in touchdown receptions from lock with ease just like that new year 39 s day in 2022 when he burst onto the scene 34 drew he is a special talent and sees the field very well and can make any throw 34 smith njigba said 34 i know he 39 s looking for me and i just want to be there for him 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: Todd Monken fires back after win over Buccaneers: ‘Browns are the Browns, (expletive) that’
news_mentions.description: Cleveland Browns coach Todd Monken clapped back at former Pittsburgh Steelers coach Mike Tomlin after Sunday's win in Tampa Bay.
news_mentions.body_text: after todd monken won his first game as cleveland browns head coach he took the chance to shoot back at the naysayers including former steelers coach mike tomlin browns are gonna browns expletive that monken said at the end of his press conference following cleveland s 23 19 win over tampa bay on sunday the guys took that to heart the comment referred to tomlin now an nbc analyst who quoted former steelers receiver juju smith schuster s the browns is the browns line while discussing cleveland s week 1 loss to jacksonville last week on sunday the browns overcame a 10 point second half deficit to beat baker mayfield and the buccaneers the much maligned deshaun watson outplayed mayfield throwing for 238 yards and two touchdowns while avoiding negative plays watson hit tight end blake whiteheart for the go ahead 17 yard td with just under four minutes remaining after a two plus hour weather delay cleveland hung on for the win monken s message clearly resonated in the locker room monk said what he said watson said after the win that s how we all feel for his part tomlin didn t fret the clapback hey i m glad that i can still motivate although i m not coaching anymore tomlin said chuckling during nbc s sunday night football pregame show the browns win keeps watson in the starting saddle as cleveland returns to ohio for their first home game of the 2026 campaign during the preseason home fans booed watson heavily and he took exception we ll see how the starter is received after bringing the browns home with a 1 1 record

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job done stroud played solidly avoiding big mistakes and peppered the middle of the field however the lack of a rushing attack put the offense in bad spots the retooled offensive line looked a lot like last year opening few holes on the ground and not giving stroud much time the texans offense missed nico collins badly with none of the young wide receivers stepping up tight end dalton schultz 12 that s waited longer for a win than the colts unfortunately for indianapolis it waited excruciatingly longer for its ninth straight loss with an injury to alec pierce exposing the colts offensive depth even more sauce gardner and charvarius ward also dealt with injuries that hamstrung the defense it made the colts ability to hang around sunday all the more impressive but the struggles and losses are piling up jonathan taylor was a stud at times 24 carries for 92 yards two touchdowns but corralled for large swaths in others josh downs came up pretty big seven receptions for 72 yards tyler warren was relatively quiet aside from the first td of the game and daniel jones simply couldn t rely on laquon treadwell or keenan allen in more than four quarters of football indy totaled 329 yards of offense while its defense gave up north of 520 fortune isn t smiling on shane steichen s team right now it will need to in a hurry treadwell s topsy turvy play emblematic with ample time left in the fourth quarter nbc s cris collinsworth proclaimed a pivotal upcoming down as the play of the game it wasn t there were about 17 more plays of the game thereafter perhaps the most symbolic of the craziness of the evening was 2016 first round pick turned journeyman laquon treadwell s 48 yard reception in overtime with the colts trailing 30 27 daniel jones and co took over and the qb heaved a long ball to treadwell treadwell bobbled the ball before collecting it fell to the ground sprang up and had possession punched out by nohl williams and recovered by the chiefs game over nope replay showed that l 39 jarius sneed s hand had glanced treadwell s side after the receiver had established final control so there was no fumble now it was the chiefs with their backs against the wall they held though and after indy tied it up on a spencer shrader field goal k c marched down for the game winner the colts held the lead three times in the first half but trailed throughout the second after patrick mahomes navigated an 80 yard go ahead drive to begin the third quarter it looked like the chiefs would pull away at 27 20 but it wasn t to be despite mahomes and co outgaining jones squad 523 329 this one went down to the final play the chiefs emerging as 2 0 looking like their old selves meanwhile the colts will keep scratching their helmets wondering what else can go wrong before they get back in the win column next gen stats insight for colts chiefs via nfl pro creed humphrey did not allow a pressure across 51 pass blocking snaps against the colts his second consecutive game without a pressure allowed nfl research the colts extended their nfl long losing streak to nine games the streak began in week 12 2025 when indianapolis lost to kansas city in overtime back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top
