news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) inactive for Monday's game vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: The Rams will be without another star on "Monday Night Football." Puka Nacua is officially inactive for Los Angeles' prime-time game against the Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams will be without another star on monday night football puka nacua is officially inactive for los angeles prime time game against the giants the wide receiver popped up on the injury report with what was labeled as a hip issue friday missing that practice and the team s saturday session before receiving a questionable designation head coach sean mcvay described nacua s injury as groin soreness telling reporters it was not associated with the psoas issue that caused the 25 year old to miss some time during the preseason regardless of where exactly nacua is hurting he s unable to partake in an important game for the rams as they look to avoid an 0 2 hole to start a season they entered with realistic super bowl aspirations although nacua was not his typically explosive self in los angeles season opener against the 49ers collecting five catches for 74 yards he was the only rams pass catcher to get anything going in the 27 7 loss his yardage total was nearly half of matthew stafford s 155 through the air and a sizable chunk of it came on a 41 yard connection before the game got out of hand his absence is a massive blow for stafford as the reigning most valuable player looks to get back on track especially considering wideout jordan whittington will also miss the contest due to a quad injury davante adams is likely in line for a ton of targets and will be supplemented by other receivers such as konata mumpfield xavier smith and tutu atwell the rams also roster a diverse tight end corps led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson and running backs kyren williams and blake corum are capable of contributing in the passing game too just a couple weeks into the season the rams are already juggling a couple injuries to big names along with nacua being unable to go monday los angeles will be without myles garrett for at least four games after the star pass rusher underwent knee surgery and was placed on injured reserve there remains an impressive array of stars in l a but mcvay s crew is certainly dealing with some difficulties in the early going they ll look to overcome them to move to 1 1 when they kick off against the giants 1 0 on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: TE Zach Ertz reuniting with Eagles, signing to Philadelphia's practice squad
news_mentions.description: Philadelphia is bringing back one of its best. The Eagles are signing tight end Zach Ertz to the practice squad, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia is bringing back one of its best the eagles are signing tight end zach ertz to the practice squad espn s adam schefter reported monday ertz who is coming off a torn acl suffered while playing for the commanders last season began his career as a 2013 second round draft pick by the eagles he racked up 579 receptions 6 267 yards and 38 touchdowns for philly over a stretch of eight plus seasons that included three pro bowl campaigns and a super bowl victory he was traded during the 2021 campaign to the cardinals for whom he played through 2023 and then spent a pair of seasons in washington he currently sits at 8 592 receiving yards and 57 tds on 825 career catches there had been rumblings that a reunion for ertz and the eagles might be on the table and recent injuries in the tight end room likely made the decision a little easier dallas goedert suffered a sprained mcl on sunday and will miss some time while rookie eli stowers is currently on injured reserve with a hamstring injury thus ertz is coming back to the practice squad healthy and with a very real chance to make an impact for the eagles he also has an opportunity to make some franchise history in a hurry as the 35 year old returns only 11 receptions shy of the eagles all time catch record currently held by harold carmichael 589 ertz is sure to hear the cheers from the philly faithful assuming he jumps to the active roster and sees the field and he ll receive yet another ovation should he end up stamping his name in the record books

news_mentions.headline: Falcons name Michael Penix Jr. starting quarterback for Week 3 game vs. Packers
news_mentions.description: Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons in their Week 3 game against the Green Bay Packers, the team announced.
news_mentions.body_text: after 10 long months michael penix is ready for live nfl action penix will start at quarterback for the atlanta falcons in their week 3 game against the green bay packers on thursday night the team announced on monday penix will be making his first start since suffering a season ending knee injury last november he was officially a full participant in monday s estimated practice report cooper rush started atlanta s first two games of the 2026 season both losses in place of the sidelined penix and tua tagovailoa who has been dealing with an oblique injury falcons coach kevin stefanski said earlier monday that he had no update on who his week 3 starter would be but had an idea where atlanta was going in the end the falcons are going back to their 2024 first round pick penix s road back to the field lasted a little longer than expected after tearing knee ligaments in november and undergoing surgery penix was not cleared to fully participate in practice until aug 22 tagovailoa who was signed in the offseason for the veteran minimum was named the week 1 starter over the still ramping penix but was sidelined due to an oblique injury suffered during practice that week in came rush who through two weeks has struggled to put in mildly the 32 year old journeyman completed 56 4 of his passes for 229 yards and a league high four interceptions in atlanta s first two games which it lost by a combined score of 54 16 rush was benched in the second half of sunday s blowout loss to carolina in favor of undrafted rookie jack strand who fared no better in penix atlanta hopes to have its first glimpse of a legitimate starting qb leading stefanski s offense in 2026 before suffering his season ending injury the southpaw was having a solid campaign in his first full year as starter completing 60 1 of his passes for 1 982 yards nine touchdowns and three picks he finished the year with a league best 1 1 int percentage the falcons could surely use penix s sturdy production to get off the mat on a short week at 0 2 atlanta will be traveling to face the packers in their home opener at a hostile lambeau field atlanta is no stranger to a left handed quarterback stunning the green bay faithful in prime time see mike vick in the 2002 wild card round we ll see if penix can deliver a similar performance on thursday night football

news_mentions.headline: Kyler Murray clears concussion protocol, will start for Vikings in Week 3 vs. Buccaneers
news_mentions.description: Kyler Murray has been cleared from the NFL's concussion protocol, putting him in place to start for the 2-0 Minnesota Vikings against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 3.
news_mentions.body_text: vikings quarterback kyler murray has been cleared from the nfl s concussion protocol putting him in place to start for 2 0 minnesota against the tampa bay buccaneers in week 3 head coach kevin o connell announced on monday murray practiced throughout last week in a limited capacity in the lead up to week 2 s game against the chicago bears but was ruled out on friday carson wentz started sunday s 9 3 win over the bears and went 11 of 20 for 143 yards on a rainy day at soldier field in his first season with the vikings after seven with the arizona cardinals murray s debut for minnesota was cut short when he suffered a concussion in the first quarter of his team s week 1 39 22 win over the green bay packers murray slid during the play but incurred a big hit from green bay s javon bullard and lukas van ness murray was replaced by wentz who would help lead the vikings to a comeback win prior to his exit murray was 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception the no 1 overall pick in the 2019 nfl draft murray will now battle opposite the bucs baker mayfield the top selection in the 2018 nfl draft at 4 05 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Jim Harbaugh 'not deterred' by Chargers' 0-2 start following double-digit loss to Raiders
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Chargers started 0-2 with losses to the Arizona Cardinals and Las Vegas Raiders.
news_mentions.body_text: the los angeles chargers look in trouble after sunday s 26 14 loss to the las vegas raiders which pushed the club to 0 2 to start the season despite the dismal start jim harbaugh remained positive i m not deterred harbaugh said via espn no one in that locker room is deterred the chargers were supposed to romp over two rebuilding teams to open the season instead they began the year with back to back upset losses at home it wasn t just bad it was 100 years in the making bad for l a according to opta stats the chargers are the second team in nfl history to lose back to back games by double digits with both coming at home against teams that had a sub 200 win percentage the previous season the other was the 1926 racine tornadoes oct 10 17 who played just one more game before folding everything looks disjointed for the chargers justin herbert doesn t look comfortable under new offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel the offensive line once again continues to struggle turnovers plague the unit the defense has been pushed around particularly up front hasn t done enough to disrupt the qb and the secondary has gotten picked apart there s no time for us to be patient with how we re playing herbert said it s not good enough so we have to be better in the second straight 26 14 loss herbert struggled to find consistency sunday he finished 15 for 27 for 192 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions omarion hampton s fourth quarter fumble sealed the team s loss for the rotten cherry on top pro bowl right tackle joe alt who struggled all game with penalties was called for a hold in the end zone giving the raiders a safety and the game s final two points we ll look at the tape we ll go back to work that s all i know how to do harbaugh said the first two games were important for the chargers to get off on a good foot because a menacing gauntlet lies ahead starting with week 3 against the buffalo bills l a faces 2025 playoff teams in five of its next seven games the other two squads patrick mahomes chiefs and lamar jackson s ravens either the chargers will devolve and wash out before thanksgiving or they ll barnstorm their difficult stretch and prove harbaugh correct defensive back derwin james took a fiery approach after sunday s disappointing loss we got to look each other in the eye man and just tell the truth and just get better james said because right now that s just looks trash i m angry but being angry don t fix anything the chargers have a lot to fix quickly

news_mentions.headline: Todd Monken fires back after win over Buccaneers: ‘Browns are the Browns, (expletive) that’
news_mentions.description: Cleveland Browns coach Todd Monken clapped back at former Pittsburgh Steelers coach Mike Tomlin after Sunday's win in Tampa Bay.
news_mentions.body_text: after todd monken won his first game as cleveland browns head coach he took the chance to shoot back at the naysayers including former steelers coach mike tomlin browns are gonna browns expletive that monken said at the end of his press conference following cleveland s 23 19 win over tampa bay on sunday the guys took that to heart the comment referred to tomlin now an nbc analyst who quoted former steelers receiver juju smith schuster s the browns is the browns line while discussing cleveland s week 1 loss to jacksonville last week on sunday the browns overcame a 10 point second half deficit to beat baker mayfield and the buccaneers the much maligned deshaun watson outplayed mayfield throwing for 238 yards and two touchdowns while avoiding negative plays watson hit tight end blake whiteheart for the go ahead 17 yard td with just under four minutes remaining after a two plus hour weather delay cleveland hung on for the win monken s message clearly resonated in the locker room monk said what he said watson said after the win that s how we all feel for his part tomlin didn t fret the clapback hey i m glad that i can still motivate although i m not coaching anymore tomlin said chuckling during nbc s sunday night football pregame show the browns win keeps watson in the starting saddle as cleveland returns to ohio for their first home game of the 2026 campaign during the preseason home fans booed watson heavily and he took exception we ll see how the starter is received after bringing the browns home with a 1 1 record

news_mentions.headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffers dislocated left elbow in loss to Cowboys
news_mentions.description: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the first half of Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
news_mentions.body_text: jayden daniels has been beset by another injury the washington commanders quarterback suffered a dislocated left elbow in sunday s 37 20 loss head coach dan quinn told reporters following the game quinn told reporters x rays did not show a fracture but daniels will travel back home with the team and undergo more imaging on monday once i know an update that we can move forward with then i ll give you that quinn said man are we bummed for him he was really playing his ass off we will rally so hard around marcus mariota until jayden s back that s what we talked about as a team daniels suffered the injury on the final play of the first half he stumbled after taking a snap under center and braced himself with his left arm before falling to the turf in obvious pain as his pass attempt fell incomplete medical staff quickly attended to daniels on the field at at t stadium and he was eventually carted to the locker room the commanders ruled daniels out after halftime i thought looking back on it at the 1 yard line we need touchdowns quinn said of the third and goal play call with three seconds remaining in the second quarter i don t regret that call obviously any time someone s injured you play the what if game i don t think this is one of those times for me i hate that it happened i wasn t hesitant about going into that spot we re going to be aggressive in this game against their offense so i don t regret that obviously the outcome sucks but it wasn t a what if or i wish i had done something differently daniels was 11 of 17 for 96 yards with a touchdown at the time of his injury he also had 69 yards rushing on seven attempts mariota started the second half for the commanders in place of daniels and as quinn mentioned will take over under center for as long as daniels is out daniels dislocated his left elbow last season during a game against the seahawks on nov 2 2025 and missed the following three weeks he would appear in just one other game that season a blowout loss to the vikings in which he aggravated the injury daniels electrified the nfl in 2024 leading washington to a surprise trip to the nfc championship game and winning offensive rookie of the year honors last year however was a slog for both daniels and the commanders daniels started seven games during his sophomore season and was sidelined multiple times suffering a knee sprain and a hamstring injury before the november elbow injury

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffers hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's loss to the Minnesota Vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter.
news_mentions.body_text: chicago bears quarterback caleb williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter williams went down while scrambling on first and goal with chicago trailing 6 3 the qb appeared to be in pain on the field grabbing at his right leg williams had to be helped off the field and was carted from the sideline to the locker room bears head coach ben johnson told reporters after the game that he did not have a sense on the severity of the injury we ll know more tomorrow johnson said johnson added he had spoken with williams prior to his postgame news conference and the third year pro was in good spirits i m actually happy it s nothing with the knee johnson told reporters that was my first inclination but the hamstring could be pretty damaging as well we ll see how bad it is tomorrow and we ll go from there chgo sports adam jahns reported that williams was seen in the locker room walking under his own power without the use of crutches one week after exploding for 59 points in a win over the panthers williams and the bears offense struggled against a stout vikings defense williams was 15 of 26 for 138 yards with an interception on a rainy day at soldier field at the time of the injury and chicago proceeded to have a potential game tying field goal blocked after the drive stalled with williams out of the game tyson bagent replaced williams under center for chicago and nearly led the bears to a comeback but bagent was sacked by dallas turner on fourth down in the red zone to end the game bagent would be in line to start if williams missed extended time bagent started four games during the 2023 season compiling a 2 2 record

news_mentions.headline: Former Giants GM Ernie Accorsi dies at age of 84
news_mentions.description: Longtime NFL executive Ernie Accorsi, who built the New York Giants core that won the Super Bowl twice after his retirement has died. He was 84.
news_mentions.body_text: new york longtime nfl executive ernie accorsi who built the new york giants core that won the super bowl twice after his retirement has died he was 84 the giants and accorsi s family announced sunday that he died saturday a cause of death and where accorsi was when he died were not provided accorsi was general manager of the giants from 1998 2006 and received championship rings from their title runs in the 07 and 11 seasons he also became the second gm enshrined in the franchise s ring of honor ernie helped shape the course of new york giants history through his vision leadership and unwavering belief in building a championship organization owner john mara said in a statement beyond his accomplishments as a football executive he was a trusted advisor and dear friend his legacy will forever be part of the giants and he will be greatly missed accorsi was in charge when new york hired tom coughlin as coach and traded for quarterback eli manning after the chargers took him with the first pick in the 2004 draft the giants made the playoffs four out of six seasons from 05 11 i call ernie every draft week for the last 12 years maybe longer than that and just thank him for making the trade and believing in me and bringing me to the new york giants manning said in a statement i know he was the believer in me and kind of the reason i got here i appreciated him so much for building such great teams and giving us the opportunity to win some championships here accorsi a native of hershey pennsylvania got a communications degree from wake forest served in the u s army and was a sportswriter before working in public relations at penn state and for the baltimore colts he spent time at the league office before rejoining the colts as assistant general manager ernie accorsi was one of the most respected football minds in nfl history and a dear friend whose wisdom and perspective i valued tremendously commissioner roger goodell said in a statement throughout his remarkable career he shaped championship caliber clubs and earned the admiration of everyone who worked with him accorsi was promoted to baltimore s gm in 1982 then served in that role with the cleveland browns from 1985 92 before going to the giants they won two nfc east titles during his tenure with them before breaking through with manning amani toomer antonio pierce and michael strahan ernie was very decisive very opinionated coughlin said in a statement his mind was as sharp as a tack he loved to laugh he was a great storyteller great storyteller he loved to have an audience and laugh and then everyone else would laugh with him accorsi s family said the giants were more than a team to him and expressed gratitude to the mara family for its loyalty and friendship copyright 2026 the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) carted off vs. Jets
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 2 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 2 sunday arizona cardinals cornerback bo melton toe was ruled out of sunday s game against the seahawks atlanta falcons cornerback a j terrell groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the panthers defensive end samson ebukam hamstring also was ruled out baltimore ravens offensive tackle ronnie stanley toe did not return to sunday s loss to the saints carolina panthers safety nick scott abdomen was ruled out of sunday s win over the falcons chicago bears quarterback caleb williams was carted to the locker room after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to vikings dallas cowboys cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot did not to return quarter he was quickly ruled out with a neck injury coach matt lafleur said after the game that reed has movement in his extremities and will remain in the new jersey area overnight offensive tackle news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Falcons' Michael Penix Jr. could start Week 3; Tua Tagovailoa not expected to be moved
news_mentions.description: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. is nearing a return from his knee injury ahead of Atlanta's Week 3 game against the Packers. Penix may make his first 2026 start on Thursday night, roughly 10 months since suffering his latest ACL injury.
news_mentions.body_text: michael penix s return is nigh after another week of fully participating in practice but being ruled out the falcons quarterback could finally make his first 2026 start in atlanta s week 3 game against the green bay packers on thursday night nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported sunday per sources penix s potential season debut comes just over 10 months since he suffered his latest acl injury the third year qb was a full participant in practice this week yet again but ceded first team reps to cooper rush on friday the 32 year old journeyman will get his second straight start sunday against the carolina panthers meanwhile tua tagovailoa could also return thursday night from his oblique injury tagovailoa was in line to start week 1 against pittsburgh before suffering the injury during practice tagovailoa is expected to practice this week and might be active against green bay serving as penix s backup per rapoport and schefter despite rumors to the contrary the ex dolphins quarterback is not expected to be moved either via release or trade rapoport and schefter added tagovailoa signed in atlanta this offseason for the veteran minimum after his release from miami who took him in the first round of the 2020 nfl draft if neither penix himself a 2024 first round selection nor tagovailoa can return by thursday s week 3 game their next opportunity to play is 11 days later the falcons open week 3 on thursday but close week 4 with a monday night game against the rival new orleans saints on oct 5 atlanta 0 1 has been in a quarterback quandary all offseason tagovailoa and penix were expected to battle for the week 1 qb1 role but the former was hampered by an early camp back injury and the latter was cleared to practice in full only late in the summer now with penix and tagovailoa returning to near full health the falcons can finally round into form as autumn begins

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys' Jerry Jones: Giants were 'better than we thought they were' in season opener
news_mentions.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones gave the Giants credit on Friday for playing better than he thought they could in the season opener, but he's confident Dallas will recover and improve moving forward.
news_mentions.body_text: dennis green delivered the famous they are who we thought they were line following his cardinals 2006 monday night loss to the bears twenty years later jerry jones came to the opposite realization while assessing his cowboys week 1 defeat to the giants they just did a good job all over jones said of the giants in a friday interview on 105 3 the fan i will tell you they were better than we thought they were i m anxious to see how new york continues to play but really a combination of things we didn t play as well as we should play and can play but they played better than i thought they could jones wasn t the only one surprised by the giants who spectacularly thwarted expectations while never trailing dallas on the way to a season opening victory jaxson dart threw for 230 yards and three touchdowns on 23 of 29 passing and joined battering ram cam skattebo in dolling out damage on the ground the duo combined for 135 rushing yards with skattebo punching one in for six big blue sidelined the cowboys vaunted offense for large swaths of the contest exposing a dallas defense that was expected to be much improved under new defensive coordinator christian parker following a transformative offseason the cowboys instead allowed the giants to win the possession battle by over 13 minutes and blew several coverages both on vital downs and to allow open pass catchers running free in the end zone though jones graciously gave new york its share of credit he also noted the learning process the cowboys have undergone thanks to considerable scheme and personnel changes it s a process dallas must accelerate ahead of sunday s matchup against the commanders of course jones said when asked if he also felt the cowboys opened the season worse than he thought they d be to say it that way i d rather say it more positively that we re not at the level we re not at the level that we thought we would be i can give you a lot of reasons logical reasons you re dealing with conceptually a new coaching staff dealing with a new to a lot of people out there defensive scheme and then you re dealing with people who are fresh in to that scheme it s a challenge to put it together and ready to go we didn t play well last week what i meant to say was new york had really more to do with it than i thought they would so that s a factor but washington could have a lot to do with it here sunday too so we ve got to be ready to step up the level of play there s no question the upcoming matchup with washington gives both teams two divisional games right out of the gate whichever team loses sunday will fall to both 0 2 overall and in the nfc east for all that went wrong to kick off the season jones believes his squad will show up vastly improved for a vital showdown at home the improvement certainly from where we played sunday that improvement is to be expected and will be there jones said i m just gonna say it it will be there i know how hard these guys are working i know their physical capabilities and i also know their motivation so you ll see improvement i ll go on the record as saying that

news_mentions.headline: David Montgomery not satisfied with three-TD Texans debut heading into Week 2: 'I'll improve'
news_mentions.description: Running back David Montgomery was not satisfied with his three-touchdown Houston Texans debut. He's hoping for better efficiency and a win in his Week 2 encore against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news_mentions.body_text: david montgomery found the end zone three times in his first game as a texan the most by any player in his debut in team history per nfl pro the running back was nonetheless disappointed with his outing both due to failing to come away with a victory and what he believes was personally a subpar performance it was cool but it didn t really feel that cool or that good when we don t come out with a win montgomery told andrew siciliano on friday s episode of the nfl report and i didn t perform or play as good as i wanted to i felt like i left a few things out there for my o line and for the rest of my guys on the team i ll improve first game it was cool but we didn t get the win montgomery was key to helping the texans keep up with the bills in an eventual 36 31 loss opening his td hat trick with a 1 yard plunge before later dashing through a huge hole for 18 yards to paydirt his third score came on a 7 yard catch montgomery s first td reception since his 2022 campaign with the bears all three scores changed the lead in houston s favor montgomery is correct in pointing out he left some opportunities on the field though his frequent trips to the end zone obscured an uncharacteristically inefficient performance as the 29 year old averaged only 3 0 yards per carry producing 60 yards on 20 attempts the meager yardage output is obviously a small sample size at this point but montgomery has strung together four straight seasons averaging 4 0 plus yards per carry so he knows he s capable of more he believes the texans are as well with hopes that will start to show on sunday in another potential playoff preview against the bengals just another game to me quite frankly montgomery said of facing his hometown cincinnati squad preparing the same way that i always prepare going against another great defense they made a lot of improvements this offseason it ll be exciting it ll be good to see where we are see if we can get on track to get our first w

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) questionable to play Monday vs. Giants after missing second straight practice
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is considered questionable to play Monday against the Giants due to a hip injury, head coach Sean McVay said.
news_mentions.body_text: there are some injury concerns over another rams star wide receiver puka nacua is questionable to play monday against the giants although nacua is officially listed on the injury report with a hip ailment head coach sean mcvay told reporters nacua is dealing with some groin soreness that is separate from the psoas issue that caused him to miss time during training camp nacua who was a surprise non participant in friday s practice also sat out saturday s session if the two time pro bowler ends up missing the contest or seeing diminished playing time due to his injury los angeles will have to dig deep to find production elsewhere in the passing game nacua was the only rams pass catcher who got going in any way during the team s season opening bludgeoning by the 49ers and even still he was relatively quiet outside of a 41 yard catch nacua hauled in five receptions for 74 yards in week 1 while no one else on the team went over 30 yards davante adams would likely shoulder a large burden of work as matthew stafford s go to guy should nacua end up sitting jordan whittington quad is doubtful to play which leaves konata mumpfield xavier smith cj daniels and tutu atwell available as well as a deep tight end group led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson it s not an ideal situation for the rams to be dealing with an ailing nacua at the start of a season that began with great expectations l a s early injury hurdles also extend to the defensive side with star acquisition myles garrett on injured reserve following knee surgery still there s plenty of stars to get the job done including defensive lineman aaron donald who plans to make his season debut against new york after ending a two year retirement to rejoin the rams at the end of august it remains to be seen if nacua suits up along with donald for the momentous occasion the rams kick off against the giants on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Rams' Aaron Donald plans to make season debut Monday vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams defensive lineman Aaron Donald is set to make his official return to the field. When asked about potentially playing Monday night against the New York Giants, Donald, who unretired on Aug. 30, told reporters, "That's the plan."
news_mentions.body_text: the rams won t have myles garrett for their home opener but they might welcome a franchise legend back to the field during his friday media availability defensive tackle aaron donald told reporters the plan is for him to play in los angeles monday night contest against the new york giants that s the plan donald said two practices today have another practice tomorrow and then we ll see but feeling good donald did not travel with the rams to their season opening loss in melbourne australia choosing to stay back in southern california to focus on his ramp up process prior to making his season debut with donald not in the picture and garrett dealing with a knee injury that eventually required surgery and placement on injured reserve the rams were clobbered by the san francisco 49ers 27 7 it was just one game of course and donald valued his preparation for returning to nfl game action an environment he hasn t seen since he retired after the 2023 season more than rushing himself back to the field after los angeles completed a blockbuster trade for garrett on june 1 donald spent the summer flirting with coming out of retirement to rejoin the rams he didn t officially do so until aug 30 though leaving him a limited window to prepare himself physically for the marathon that is an nfl season traveling to australia was likely never going to fit into those plans the extra week of practice however appears to have positioned donald to make his return in the same stadium he last called home i don t know i ain t really think about that donald said when asked what it will feel like to run out on the field at sofi stadium again because to me i know i ain t play in two years but being back around i feel like i was just here last year time flies by so fast and i kind of forget that i didn t play football in two years i kind of just feel like i m just back to my normal self and like i was playing last year even though i wasn t i m just going to take it all in enjoy it try to give the fans something to cheer for enjoy the game and try to come away with a win

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job matter neither did the chiefs instead they eked this one out which might be the best of signs for k c to come having gone 11 0 in one score games in 2024 the chiefs were an nfl worst 1 9 in such games last season now mahomes and co are 1 0 in nail biters and perfect through two weeks it s a long road but this is a good beginning banged up colts lose ot heartbreaker there s been no team in the nfl that s waited longer for a win than the colts unfortunately for indianapolis it waited excruciatingly longer for its ninth straight loss with an injury to alec pierce exposing the colts offensive depth even more sauce gardner and charvarius ward also dealt with injuries that hamstrung the defense it made the colts ability to hang around sunday all the more impressive but the struggles and losses are piling up jonathan taylor was a stud at times 24 carries for 92 yards two touchdowns but corralled for large swaths in others josh downs came up pretty big seven receptions for 72 yards tyler warren was relatively quiet aside from the first td of the game and daniel jones simply couldn t rely on laquon treadwell or keenan allen in more than four quarters of football indy totaled 329 yards of offense while its defense gave up north of 520 fortune isn t smiling on shane steichen s team right now it will need to in a hurry treadwell s topsy turvy play emblematic with ample time left in the fourth quarter nbc s cris collinsworth proclaimed a pivotal upcoming down as the play of the game it wasn t there were about 17 more plays of the game thereafter perhaps the most symbolic of the craziness of the evening was 2016 first round pick turned journeyman laquon treadwell s 48 yard reception in overtime with the colts trailing 30 27 daniel jones and co took over and the qb heaved a long ball to treadwell treadwell bobbled the ball before collecting it fell to the ground sprang up and had possession punched out by nohl williams and recovered by the chiefs game over nope replay showed that l 39 jarius sneed s hand had glanced treadwell s side after the receiver had established final control so there was no fumble now it was the chiefs with their backs against the wall they held though and after indy tied it up on a spencer shrader field goal k c marched down for the game winner the colts held the lead three times in the first half but trailed throughout the second after patrick mahomes navigated an 80 yard go ahead drive to begin the third quarter it looked like the chiefs would pull away at 27 20 but it wasn t to be despite mahomes and co outgaining jones squad 523 329 this one went down to the final play the chiefs emerging as 2 0 looking like their old selves meanwhile the colts will keep scratching their helmets wondering what else can go wrong before they get back in the win column next gen stats insight for colts chiefs via nfl pro creed humphrey did not allow a pressure across 51 pass blocking snaps against the colts his second consecutive game without a pressure allowed nfl research the colts extended their nfl long losing streak to nine games the streak began in week 12 2025 when indianapolis lost to kansas city in overtime back to top

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top
