news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams considered 'week to week' after suffering hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Caleb Williams is viewed as "week to week" after injurying his hamstring during Sunday's loss to the Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears expect caleb williams to miss time but the quarterback avoided a major hamstring injury head coach ben johnson said monday on espn 1000 that the team believes williams will be week to week following an mri exam it sounds like it s gonna be a week to week deal for him johnson said i gotta still talk with our trainer here we ll do that here shortly and i ll have the lowdown from him but it sounds like it s week to week but will likely miss some time johnson later told reporters the bears received a somewhat encouraging report about williams injury adding that the qb may not practice this week williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after coming up lame on a scramble in the fourth quarter the qb was emotional while being carted off the field but was reportedly seen in the locker room later walking without aid and only a slight limp yeah potentially dodged a bullet johnson added on monday we ll see he s tough and he comes back from these types of things better than the average human so we ll see while potentially missing the qb for next monday night s week 3 game against the philadelphia eagles is a negative overall it could be much worse for williams tyson bagent will get the start if williams is unable to go given the fragility of hamstring injuries the bears could play it cautiously with williams an injury that returns with a tweak if not properly healed could linger all season with a soft tissue injury it will be interesting to see how willing williams is to scamper when he returns he has used his legs with aplomb to open the 2026 season

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL fantasy football waiver wire, Week 3: RB Jonah Coleman, QB Bryce Young among top targets
news_mentions.description: Which players should you scoop up to give your fantasy team a boost heading into Week 3? Matt Okada spotlights the top waiver-wire targets at each position, including Broncos RB Jonah Coleman and Panthers QB Bryce Young.
news_mentions.body_text: two sundays of fantasy football in the books time for the week 3 waiver wire some of the names listed below might end up winning leagues at the very least several of them could be difference makers in the immediate future do not take the waiver wire for granted this is where the rubber meets the road in our imaginary game i ll be here every week from now until fantasy championships hope to have you along for the full ride let s win some hardware notes players must be rostered in less than 60 of espn leagues to be eligible for the column all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted top 15 overall waiver wire targets and here are my top waiver wire targets by position quarterbacks running backs washington commanders rb rachaad white is rostered in 65 percent of leagues above the 60 threshold of eligibility for this file but he was exceptional on sunday both on the ground and as a receiver and should be scooped up if available wide receivers san francisco 49ers wr deebo samuel is already rostered in 68 of leagues above the 60 threshold of eligibility for this file but he might be worth adding in the other 32 with de zhaun stribling out for multiple months tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Colts WR Alec Pierce (heel) to miss several weeks, won't have surgery
news_mentions.description: Wide receiver Alec Pierce sustained a heel injury in the Colts' loss to the Chiefs on Sunday night. He is set to miss several weeks but won't have surgery.
news_mentions.body_text: indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce will miss several weeks due to aggravating a heel injury that he had surgically repaired nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday evening pierce injured in sunday night s loss to the kansas city chiefs is likely to be headed to injured reserve rapoport reported as pierce intends to rehab and forgo surgery surgery is still a possibility for pierce but if all goes well with recovery he should return midseason the big play maven has led the nfl in yards per reception in each of his last two seasons but injuries haven t allowed him to get off the ground in 2026 re signing with the colts on a four year 114 million contract in march pierce underwent surgery on his heel in the spring and missed offseason work and most of training camp prior to be activated off the physically unable to perform list in august in 2025 pierce posted 47 catches for 1 003 yards his first 1 000 yard season and six touchdowns it led to him signing a lucrative extension with indy but through two games he s mustered just five receptions for 72 yards it ll be some time before he can add to those numbers pierce s absence leaves the colts wr corps rather barren beyond josh downs with keenan allen and laquon treadwell as the top reserves former giants receiver darius slayton is set to join the squad espn reported

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) inactive for Monday's game vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: The Rams will be without another star on "Monday Night Football." Puka Nacua is officially inactive for Los Angeles' prime-time game against the Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams will be without another star on monday night football puka nacua is officially inactive for los angeles prime time game against the giants the wide receiver popped up on the injury report with what was labeled as a hip issue friday missing that practice and the team s saturday session before receiving a questionable designation head coach sean mcvay described nacua s injury as groin soreness telling reporters it was not associated with the psoas issue that caused the 25 year old to miss some time during the preseason regardless of where exactly nacua is hurting he s unable to partake in an important game for the rams as they look to avoid an 0 2 hole to start a season they entered with realistic super bowl aspirations although nacua was not his typically explosive self in los angeles season opener against the 49ers collecting five catches for 74 yards he was the only rams pass catcher to get anything going in the 27 7 loss his yardage total was nearly half of matthew stafford s 155 through the air and a sizable chunk of it came on a 41 yard connection before the game got out of hand his absence is a massive blow for stafford as the reigning most valuable player looks to get back on track especially considering wideout jordan whittington will also miss the contest due to a quad injury davante adams is likely in line for a ton of targets and will be supplemented by other receivers such as konata mumpfield xavier smith and tutu atwell the rams also roster a diverse tight end corps led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson and running backs kyren williams and blake corum are capable of contributing in the passing game too just a couple weeks into the season the rams are already juggling a couple injuries to big names along with nacua being unable to go monday los angeles will be without myles garrett for at least four games after the star pass rusher underwent knee surgery and was placed on injured reserve there remains an impressive array of stars in l a but mcvay s crew is certainly dealing with some difficulties in the early going they ll look to overcome them to move to 1 1 when they kick off against the giants 1 0 on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: TE Zach Ertz reuniting with Eagles, signing to Philadelphia's practice squad
news_mentions.description: Philadelphia is bringing back one of its best. The Eagles are signing tight end Zach Ertz to the practice squad, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia is bringing back one of its best the eagles are signing tight end zach ertz to the practice squad espn s adam schefter reported monday ertz who is coming off a torn acl suffered while playing for the commanders last season began his career as a 2013 second round draft pick by the eagles he racked up 579 receptions 6 267 yards and 38 touchdowns for philly over a stretch of eight plus seasons that included three pro bowl campaigns and a super bowl victory he was traded during the 2021 campaign to the cardinals for whom he played through 2023 and then spent a pair of seasons in washington he currently sits at 8 592 receiving yards and 57 tds on 825 career catches there had been rumblings that a reunion for ertz and the eagles might be on the table and recent injuries in the tight end room likely made the decision a little easier dallas goedert suffered a sprained mcl on sunday and will miss some time while rookie eli stowers is currently on injured reserve with a hamstring injury thus ertz is coming back to the practice squad healthy and with a very real chance to make an impact for the eagles he also has an opportunity to make some franchise history in a hurry as the 35 year old returns only 11 receptions shy of the eagles all time catch record currently held by harold carmichael 589 ertz is sure to hear the cheers from the philly faithful assuming he jumps to the active roster and sees the field and he ll receive yet another ovation should he end up stamping his name in the record books

news_mentions.headline: Giants vs. Rams: Three must-know storylines for Monday's Week 2 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down three must-know storylines in Monday night's game between the New York Giants and Los Angeles Rams.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams ended week 1 as the only nfc west team without a win and the giants seamlessly transitioned into the john harbaugh era by enforcing their will on the cowboys in the sunday night opener just as everyone expected los angeles stumble out of the starting blocks was the more surprising of the two results and it sets up a pivotal early season game between two nfc clubs while the rams look to get into the win column big blue has an opportunity to make a huge statement it would be one thing to open the season by taking down an opponent in a divisional matchup games which often end up being tossups but following that up by traveling cross country to defeat the preseason super bowl favorites would put the league on notice regarding new york s emergence as a surprise contender such a statement would require the giants to earn a win over l a for the first time in a decade the giants have churned through four different head coaches and dropped four consecutive results to the rams since the club s last head to head victory in 2016 but that means little to new york s new era of stars a jaxson dart led contingent that has quickly proven capable of taking the fight to opponents no matter the odds three must know storylines 1 stafford seeks rebound performance matthew stafford s first start of the 2026 season didn t only pale in comparison to his 25 most valuable player campaign it was a low point of his six year tenure with the rams los angeles scored seven points the fewest the team has mustered in stafford s 75 starts and his 61 2 passer rating was the second worst by a reigning mvp in week 1 history per nfl research davante adams managed just 26 receiving yards his second lowest output as a ram while puka nacua who is out with a hip injury was relatively quiet outside of his 41 yard catch to set up los angeles lone score the opening week of the nfl calendar is always home to weird results though while it s strange seeing last year s best offense rank 32nd in points after one game few people if any assume such a result is indicative of how the rest of the season will go the rams caught a bit of a break with giants cornerback paulson adebo going on injured reserve and cb deonte banks being inactive due to a calf injury but they ll still have their work cut out for them without nacua against a new york defense that looked dangerous behind the new off ball linebacking duo of tremaine edmunds and arvell reese and a speedy pass rushing group led by abdul carter and brian burns the giants minimized damage against dallas which finished second in total offense last year holding the cowboys to 244 yards will they make it a trend by doing the same to last season s top total offense or will stafford return to mvp form 2 can giants win through another game of keep away everything was working offensively for new york in john harbaugh s first game at the helm jaxson dart delivered perfect throws with regularity going 23 of 29 for 230 yards three touchdowns and a 134 2 passer rating he also looked more mature and settled running the ball taking a late hit out of bounds early but otherwise protecting himself while rushing for 54 yards cam skattebo and malik nabers both looked good coming off injury and new tight end isaiah likely led all pass catchers in the game with eight receptions for 78 yards and two tds most impressive of all was the giants ability to sustain long drives tiring out dallas defense and preventing dak prescott and co from making it a shootout four of new york s seven possessions hit double digit plays five drives went 60 plus yards in the second half new york fielded two drives of eight plus minutes and a third that took the clock from 5 21 to triple zeroes it didn t matter that dallas scored both times it touched the ball after halftime there was no way to stage a comeback with possessions so limited by new york s methodical marches that ll likely be the strategy again versus the rams and it ll be even more impressive if dart and co can pull it off facing a defense of l a s caliber 3 rams must stop sky from falling it s far too early for chicken little to sound the alarm but it s difficult to imagine a worse start to the season for sean mcvay s crew the rams could neither stop nor score on the 49ers while opening the campaign in australia then after returning to l a star acquisition myles garrett underwent knee surgery that will knock him out at least a month though there was no shortage of criticism after mcvay s plan to travel to melbourne 24 hours before game time failed to yield results the other explanation is potentially more concerning if the rams did feel 100 to play so soon after arriving that would mean they simply didn t measure up to a rival that is likely to challenge them for the division either way l a is now staring at an 0 1 record and a matchup against an upstart giants squad some panic could creep in among the fan base should the rams lose especially with difficult games on deck against the broncos eagles and bills

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) questionable to play Monday vs. Giants after missing second straight practice
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is considered questionable to play Monday against the Giants due to a hip injury, head coach Sean McVay said.
news_mentions.body_text: there are some injury concerns over another rams star wide receiver puka nacua is questionable to play monday against the giants although nacua is officially listed on the injury report with a hip ailment head coach sean mcvay told reporters nacua is dealing with some groin soreness that is separate from the psoas issue that caused him to miss time during training camp nacua who was a surprise non participant in friday s practice also sat out saturday s session if the two time pro bowler ends up missing the contest or seeing diminished playing time due to his injury los angeles will have to dig deep to find production elsewhere in the passing game nacua was the only rams pass catcher who got going in any way during the team s season opening bludgeoning by the 49ers and even still he was relatively quiet outside of a 41 yard catch nacua hauled in five receptions for 74 yards in week 1 while no one else on the team went over 30 yards davante adams would likely shoulder a large burden of work as matthew stafford s go to guy should nacua end up sitting jordan whittington quad is doubtful to play which leaves konata mumpfield xavier smith cj daniels and tutu atwell available as well as a deep tight end group led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson it s not an ideal situation for the rams to be dealing with an ailing nacua at the start of a season that began with great expectations l a s early injury hurdles also extend to the defensive side with star acquisition myles garrett on injured reserve following knee surgery still there s plenty of stars to get the job done including defensive lineman aaron donald who plans to make his season debut against new york after ending a two year retirement to rejoin the rams at the end of august it remains to be seen if nacua suits up along with donald for the momentous occasion the rams kick off against the giants on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Rams' Aaron Donald plans to make season debut Monday vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams defensive lineman Aaron Donald is set to make his official return to the field. When asked about potentially playing Monday night against the New York Giants, Donald, who unretired on Aug. 30, told reporters, "That's the plan."
news_mentions.body_text: the rams won t have myles garrett for their home opener but they might welcome a franchise legend back to the field during his friday media availability defensive tackle aaron donald told reporters the plan is for him to play in los angeles monday night contest against the new york giants that s the plan donald said two practices today have another practice tomorrow and then we ll see but feeling good donald did not travel with the rams to their season opening loss in melbourne australia choosing to stay back in southern california to focus on his ramp up process prior to making his season debut with donald not in the picture and garrett dealing with a knee injury that eventually required surgery and placement on injured reserve the rams were clobbered by the san francisco 49ers 27 7 it was just one game of course and donald valued his preparation for returning to nfl game action an environment he hasn t seen since he retired after the 2023 season more than rushing himself back to the field after los angeles completed a blockbuster trade for garrett on june 1 donald spent the summer flirting with coming out of retirement to rejoin the rams he didn t officially do so until aug 30 though leaving him a limited window to prepare himself physically for the marathon that is an nfl season traveling to australia was likely never going to fit into those plans the extra week of practice however appears to have positioned donald to make his return in the same stadium he last called home i don t know i ain t really think about that donald said when asked what it will feel like to run out on the field at sofi stadium again because to me i know i ain t play in two years but being back around i feel like i was just here last year time flies by so fast and i kind of forget that i didn t play football in two years i kind of just feel like i m just back to my normal self and like i was playing last year even though i wasn t i m just going to take it all in enjoy it try to give the fans something to cheer for enjoy the game and try to come away with a win

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job done stroud played solidly avoiding big mistakes and peppered the middle of the field however the lack of a rushing attack put the offense in bad spots the retooled offensive line looked a lot like last year opening few holes on the ground and not giving stroud much time the texans offense missed nico collins badly with none of the young wide receivers stepping up tight end dalton schultz 12 receptions for 140 yards generated 103 yards more than any other texans pass catcher on sunday houston missed several opportunities to make it a game with an early flubbed field goal attempt a stuffed depth even more sauce gardner and charvarius ward also dealt with injuries that hamstrung the defense it made the colts ability to hang around sunday all the more impressive but the struggles and losses are piling up jonathan taylor was a stud at times 24 carries for 92 yards two touchdowns but corralled for large swaths in others josh downs came up pretty big seven receptions for 72 yards tyler warren was relatively quiet aside from the first td of the game and daniel jones simply couldn t rely on laquon treadwell or keenan allen in more than four quarters of football indy totaled 329 yards of offense while its defense gave up north of 520 fortune isn t smiling on shane steichen s team right now it will need to in a hurry treadwell s topsy turvy play emblematic with ample time left in the fourth quarter nbc s cris collinsworth proclaimed a pivotal upcoming down as the play of the game it wasn t there were about 17 more plays of the game thereafter perhaps the most symbolic of the craziness of the evening was 2016 first round pick turned journeyman laquon treadwell s 48 yard reception in overtime with the colts trailing 30 27 daniel jones and co took over and the qb heaved a long ball to treadwell treadwell bobbled the ball before collecting it fell to the ground sprang up and had possession punched out by nohl williams and recovered by the chiefs game over nope replay showed that l 39 jarius sneed s hand had glanced treadwell s side after the receiver had established final control so there was no fumble now it was the chiefs with their backs against the wall they held though and after indy tied it up on a spencer shrader field goal k c marched down for the game winner the colts held the lead three times in the first half but trailed throughout the second after patrick mahomes navigated an 80 yard go ahead drive to begin the third quarter it looked like the chiefs would pull away at 27 20 but it wasn t to be despite mahomes and co outgaining jones squad 523 329 this one went down to the final play the chiefs emerging as 2 0 looking like their old selves meanwhile the colts will keep scratching their helmets wondering what else can go wrong before they get back in the win column next gen stats insight for colts chiefs via nfl pro creed humphrey did not allow a pressure across 51 pass blocking snaps against the colts his second consecutive game without a pressure allowed nfl research the colts extended their nfl long losing streak to nine games the streak began in week 12 2025 when indianapolis lost to kansas city in overtime back to top

news_mentions.headline: Two truths and a lie: Ben Johnson is the new Bill Walsh, while John Harbaugh has revived the Giants
news_mentions.description: Is Ben Johnson this generation's Bill Walsh? Are the Giants BACK under John Harbaugh? Which surprise team feels like a mirage? With early-season takes flying all over the NFL world, Bucky Brooks reveals two truths and a lie.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he explores three emerging viewpoints as we head into the 2026 campaign s second sunday the nfl world is still teeming with takes from week 1 that s what happens when a football starved public gets its first real meal since winter initial impressions breed strong opinions ultimately some prove prescient others preposterous with that in mind i d like to evaluate the legitimacy of a few nascent narratives prior to this season s second full helping of pigskin what s real and what s fake which early observations do i stand behind stand against here are two truths and a lie truth ben johnson is this generation s bill walsh no disrespect to kyle shanahan and sean mcvay s wizardry but ben johnson is the guru who will define the 2020s as a legendary play caller the second year head coach of the chicago bears has awakened a hibernating offense transforming it into a juggernaut that has defensive coordinators shaking in their boots as they prepare to face the monsters of the midway johnson s bears bludgeon opponents with a mix of power and pizzazz fielding an exotic smash mouth offense with an mvp caliber quarterback a pair of potential 1 000 yard rushers and a talented collection of pass catchers the savvy schemer can call any play he wants with supreme confidence in the team s talent tactics and execution moreover johnson knows his rock solid offensive line will impose its will on foes leaving them battered and bruised after a 60 minute war in the trenches given the overwhelming physicality and toughness this unit displays whenever it takes the field chicago is establishing itself as an offensive bully that pushes around adversaries chicago finished 2025 ranked ninth in points and sixth in total offense but johnson boldly stated in august that he wants the bears to set an nfl scoring record in 2026 then they hit the road for the season opener and dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers flexing their muscles against a completely overwhelmed defense the bears enjoyed a rare 250 250 game eclipsing the yardage figure in passing 261 and rushing 291 d andre swift led the way on the ground with 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries while kyle monangai reached the century mark on just 10 totes including a 61 yard touchdown meanwhile caleb williams completed 72 4 percent of his passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns adding 65 yards and two more scores with his legs the crazy part is that kalif raymond not rome odunze or luther burden led the receiving corps in targets nine catches eight and yards 84 shoot tight end colston loveland who took the league by storm in the second half of his rookie season didn t even have a catch and yet chicago nearly scored 60 points in 60 minutes the video game like exhibition demonstrated johnson s brilliance as a play caller further proving his deft ability to juggle a collection of weapons that s something he showcased as detroit s offensive coordinator from 2022 through 24 when the lions fielded three straight top five units in points and yards now he s doing the same thing in the windy city pulling all the right levers with a potent pack of playmakers bill walsh transformed the game with his west coast offense and a star studded lineup that featured joe montana jerry rice and roger craig among others the hall of fame coach made a pass heavy approach the norm these days johnson has balance back in vogue chicago ranked third in rushing and 10th in passing last season in 2026 the bears could finish in the top five in both categories with a well rounded approach creative scheming and a deep bag of tricks johnson is setting the standard for modern offense i can t wait to see what his bears do this sunday against the vikings brian flores blitz happy defense is challenging to most though johnson boasts a 5 1 record when calling plays against the ballyhooed coordinator truth the giants are back with john harbaugh the new york giants have enjoyed their greatest successes with hard nosed disciplinarians leading the charge bill parcells and tom coughlin each guided the franchise to two super bowl titles with both head men using old school blueprints that prioritized discipline toughness and attention to detail over flashy schemes and star power that throwback approach is back in the building with john harbaugh in charge the soon to be 64 year old compiled a 180 113 record with the baltimore ravens winning a lombardi trophy and six afc north titles while appearing in the playoffs 12 times in 18 seasons the grizzled leader built a culture of hard work physicality and toughness in baltimore holding his players accountable for meeting the standard on every snap now he s doing the same thing in nyc in a dazzling debut on sunday night football harbaugh guided his team to a 28 20 upset of the eternally hyped dallas cowboys suddenly the football world is buzzing about the upstart g men being dark horse contenders in the nfc the 2026 giants are built like the proud organization s four super bowl winning squads from 1986 1990 2007 and 2011 the first three of those teams in particular relied heavily on dominant defense a potent running game and a quarterback who makes plays in the clutch sound familiar this year s d still has some questions in the back end but the salty front seven is vintage big blue new york has a collection of pass rushers brian burns kayvon thibodeaux abdul carter chauncey golston and arvell reese who can jump into the old nascar packages that terrorized opponents in previous nyg title runs moreover free agent addition tremaine edmunds gives this team a reliable nerve center with the middle linebacker directing traffic to keep everyone on the same page the unit showed championship caliber communication and attention to detail last sunday night while playing with the physicality that s always been a hallmark of the franchise s great defenses offensively the giants have embraced a slow down style forcing opponents to adjust to a deliberate run oriented game plan that chews up the clock and reduces total possessions while qb jaxson dart will get chances to push the ball downfield to malik nabers and isaiah likely these giants want to control games with a lower risk approach that leans heavily on cam skattebo and the rushing attack to string together first downs the ground and pound strategy is part of the team s plan to set the tempo and push opponents out of their comfort zone particularly when going against high powered offenses that want to play shootouts against the cowboys the giants comfortably won time of possession 36 40 to 23 20 and went 9 for 11 on third down new york ran 16 more offensive plays than dallas 68 to 52 which helps explain why cowboys qb dak prescott lost his patience and threw an uncharacteristic interception setting up a giants score right before halftime admittedly it s only been one game maintaining perspective is key and the giants immediately face another stiff test in prime time visiting los angeles this week to play the rams on monday night football still i m confident that the culture and blueprint harbaugh is establishing will have big blue back in the championship hunt sooner than many anticipate lie the nfc west actually has four good teams the excitement following the cardinals week 1 upset of the chargers has led some observers to offer hot takes on the bird gang s immediate prospects in 2026 the optimism springing from the desert is a far cry from the doom and gloom that hovered over the franchise for most of the offseason while i hate to be the bearer of bad news to a fan base reveling in its week 1 win the cardinals are destined to finish as cellar dwellers and miss the playoffs for a fifth straight season the fanfare over mike lafleur s impressive debut is understandable but it will eventually subside as teams settle in and arizona s film circulates around the league astute observers will quickly scan last week s game and see the chargers beat themselves with a series of blunders and miscues typically seen at your local high school on a friday night the bolts lost the turnover battle minus two had a punt blocked and were stopped on downs three times the errors allowed the cardinals to dominate time of possession 37 31 to 22 29 and run 21 more plays although the cardinals deserve credit for finding a winning formula victories will be very hard to come by in a brutally tough schedule looking at the rosters and depth charts throughout the nfc west it is hard to find a position group where the cardinals have an edge in personnel yes arizona has a few blue chip players see te trey mcbride s budda baker and rookie rb jeremiyah love but the superior depth and talent on the seahawks rams and 49ers will require lafleur and co to out scheme everyone and in case you haven t noticed those three teams are pretty damn well coached in a league where jimmys and joes matter more than x s and o s the talent discrepancy between the cardinals and the nfc s true contenders ultimately will lead to a string of losses that leaves arizona behind the competition this sunday the cards host the reigning super bowl champions sam darnold remains sidelined for the seahawks but as we saw in seattle s 13 10 win over new england mike macdonald s team is plenty capable of winning games with defense though lafleur certainly can continue to build this team s competitive culture the first time head coach faces long odds when it comes to orchestrating a true rags to riches turnaround in 2026

news_mentions.body_text: week 1 is in the books and with it came so much fuzzy familiarity the pitter patter of coffee dripping into your favorite team branded mug as you agonize over your fantasy lineup the agony of your early round picks failing to generate adequate production looking at you ja marr chase omarion hampton and de von achane the unbridled euphoria of your flex running back vulturing a goal line touchdown to secure your victory how great is it to have those football shaped neurons firing around your brain again some of our sleepers from last week delivered thank you te1 isaiah likely and te7 juwan johnson some of them slammed the snooze button and went right back to bed come on wr78 marvin harrison fantasy football is a roller coaster so strap in keep your hands inside the vehicle at all times and get ready to ride in week 2 note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses
