news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: Kyler Murray clears concussion protocol, will start for Vikings in Week 3 vs. Buccaneers
news_mentions.description: Kyler Murray has been cleared from the NFL's concussion protocol, putting him in place to start for the 2-0 Minnesota Vikings against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 3.
news_mentions.body_text: vikings quarterback kyler murray has been cleared from the nfl s concussion protocol putting him in place to start for 2 0 minnesota against the tampa bay buccaneers in week 3 head coach kevin o connell announced on monday murray practiced throughout last week in a limited capacity in the lead up to week 2 s game against the chicago bears but was ruled out on friday carson wentz started sunday s 9 3 win over the bears and went 11 of 20 for 143 yards on a rainy day at soldier field in his first season with the vikings after seven with the arizona cardinals murray s debut for minnesota was cut short when he suffered a concussion in the first quarter of his team s week 1 39 22 win over the green bay packers murray slid during the play but incurred a big hit from green bay s javon bullard and lukas van ness murray was replaced by wentz who would help lead the vikings to a comeback win prior to his exit murray was 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception the no 1 overall pick in the 2019 nfl draft murray will now battle opposite the bucs baker mayfield the top selection in the 2018 nfl draft at 4 05 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Todd Monken fires back after win over Buccaneers: ‘Browns are the Browns, (expletive) that’
news_mentions.description: Cleveland Browns coach Todd Monken clapped back at former Pittsburgh Steelers coach Mike Tomlin after Sunday's win in Tampa Bay.
news_mentions.body_text: after todd monken won his first game as cleveland browns head coach he took the chance to shoot back at the naysayers including former steelers coach mike tomlin browns are gonna browns expletive that monken said at the end of his press conference following cleveland s 23 19 win over tampa bay on sunday the guys took that to heart the comment referred to tomlin now an nbc analyst who quoted former steelers receiver juju smith schuster s the browns is the browns line while discussing cleveland s week 1 loss to jacksonville last week on sunday the browns overcame a 10 point second half deficit to beat baker mayfield and the buccaneers the much maligned deshaun watson outplayed mayfield throwing for 238 yards and two touchdowns while avoiding negative plays watson hit tight end blake whiteheart for the go ahead 17 yard td with just under four minutes remaining after a two plus hour weather delay cleveland hung on for the win monken s message clearly resonated in the locker room monk said what he said watson said after the win that s how we all feel for his part tomlin didn t fret the clapback hey i m glad that i can still motivate although i m not coaching anymore tomlin said chuckling during nbc s sunday night football pregame show the browns win keeps watson in the starting saddle as cleveland returns to ohio for their first home game of the 2026 campaign during the preseason home fans booed watson heavily and he took exception we ll see how the starter is received after bringing the browns home with a 1 1 record

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and at least early in the contest the unit s three first half drives all resulted in field goal tries with riley patterson converting twice the dolphins outgained the 49ers in the first half 165 yards to 125 and held the ball for nearly nine more minutes than the home team for as well as malik willis and de 39 von achane played the difference going into the locker room came in the red zone where miami struggled to convert with a pair of drives stalling at the san francisco 10 and 5 yard lines unfortunately the story changed in the second half miami failed to amass more than 15 yards on four straight possessions before a garbage time 77 yard touchdown connection between willis and ryan miller there s still a lot to clean up that ll likely be a common theme for this young team throughout the season but there were definite positives early in this contest that willis and co can build on in addition miami s improvement on third down its 47 conversion rate up from 20 in week 1 was another step in the right direction next gen stats insight for dolphins 49ers via nfl pro brock purdy completed all 10 of his downfield pass attempts 10 air yards against the dolphins for 211 yards and a touchdown it was the most completions without an incompletion by a qb on downfield passes since week 5 2021 carson wentz vs baltimore nfl research brock purdy recorded a 149 1 passer rating 287 passing yards two passing touchdowns in the 49ers week 2 win over miami this was his eighth career start with a 140 passer rating tying joe montana for second in 49ers history including playoffs behind only steve young 13 only lamar jackson has more such games 12 than purdy since the latter entered the league in 2022 back to top grant gordon s takeaways visions of chiefs of old shine with a prime time audience looking on for the second week in a row kicker harrison butker booted a 40 yard game winner in overtime to send the chiefs to a 2 0 start it s quite the difference from the 0 2 genesis of last year s disastrous 6 11 showing it wasn t the prettiest win but it was a glimpse of what used to be with patrick mahomes producing a glistening line of 32 of 47 passing for 382 yards three touchdowns and a 114 0 rating the first of those three touchdowns went to travis kelce who turned in nine receptions for 101 yards it was the first time mahomes topped 300 passing yards and kelce had 100 plus receiving in the same game since week 7 2023 fresh face kenneth walker added 117 yards on the ground though he didn t run as wild as he did in his debut against the broncos for that matter neither did the chiefs instead they eked this one out which might be the best of signs for k c to come having gone 11 0 in one score games in 2024 the chiefs were an nfl worst 1 9 in such games last season now mahomes and co are 1 0 in nail biters and perfect through two weeks it s a long road but this is a good beginning banged up colts lose ot heartbreaker there s been no team in the nfl that s waited longer for a win than the colts unfortunately for indianapolis it waited excruciatingly longer for its ninth straight loss with an injury to alec pierce exposing the colts offensive depth even more sauce gardner and charvarius ward also dealt with injuries that hamstrung the defense it made the colts ability to hang around sunday all the more impressive but the struggles and losses are piling up jonathan taylor was a stud at times 24 carries for 92 yards two touchdowns but corralled for large swaths in others josh downs came up pretty big seven receptions for 72 yards tyler warren was relatively quiet aside from the first td of the game and daniel jones simply couldn t rely on laquon treadwell or keenan allen in more than four quarters of football indy totaled 329 yards of offense while its defense gave up north of 520 fortune isn t smiling on shane steichen s team right now it will need to in a hurry treadwell s topsy turvy play emblematic with ample time left in the fourth quarter nbc s cris collinsworth proclaimed a pivotal upcoming down as the play of the game it wasn t there were about 17 more plays of the game thereafter perhaps the most symbolic of the craziness of the evening was 2016 first round pick turned journeyman laquon treadwell s 48 yard reception in overtime with the colts trailing 30 27 daniel jones and co took over and the qb heaved a long ball to treadwell treadwell bobbled the ball before collecting it fell to the ground sprang up and had possession punched out by nohl williams and recovered by the chiefs game over nope replay showed that l 39 jarius sneed s hand had glanced treadwell s side after the receiver had established final control so there was no fumble now it was the chiefs with their backs against the wall they held though and after indy tied it up on a spencer shrader field goal k c marched down for the game winner the colts held the lead three times in the first half but trailed throughout the second after patrick mahomes navigated an 80 yard go ahead drive to begin the third quarter it looked like the chiefs would pull away at 27 20 but it wasn t to be despite mahomes and co outgaining jones squad 523 329 this one went down to the final play the chiefs emerging as 2 0 looking like their old selves meanwhile the colts will keep scratching their helmets wondering what else can go wrong before they get back in the win column next gen stats insight for colts chiefs via nfl pro creed humphrey did not allow a pressure across 51 pass blocking snaps against the colts his second consecutive game without a pressure allowed nfl research the colts extended their nfl long losing streak to nine games the streak began in week 12 2025 when indianapolis lost to kansas city in overtime back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: Tampa Bay Buccaneers training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the tampa bay buccaneers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location adventhealth training center tampa florida fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs tennessee titans 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs buffalo bills 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the buccaneers who won six of their final seven regular season games in 2024 end the 2025 campaign with six consecutive games against teams that missed the playoffs nfl research what you need to know 1 a new challenge has reared its head just ahead of buccaneers training camp find an early season replacement for tristan wirfs the all pro left tackle underwent knee surgery on july 8 and is likely to begin the season on the physically unable to perform list which would sideline him at least four games there s no replacing the only player in nfl history who has earned all pro honors at both tackle positions but the silver lining is there s plenty of time to prepare currently on the left tackle depth chart are veteran charlie heck a newcomer and undrafted rookie benjamin chukwuma but perhaps a temporary reshuffling is in order will luke goedeke try his hand at a tackle switch or will left guard ben bredeson another newcomer man the position it s too early to tell now but figuring it out will be a camp priority tampa begins the 2025 season with two road games and hosts the defending super bowl champions in week 4 with wirfs likely out 2 the buccaneers surged toward their fourth consecutive nfc title last season thanks to balanced offense that consistently put up points the unit returns in 2025 largely unchanged barring the availability of wirfs but one other facet of the offense that could be interesting over the next few months is how the depth chart shakes out at wide receiver with mike evans leading the way chris godwin s health and potential return to form is the first item to monitor the bucs are hopeful the veteran wr will be ready for week 1 after a brutal ankle dislocation disrupted a fantastic season in 2024 but the club seems to be prepared either way that s where the head scratching begins tampa selected emeka egbuka with the 19th overall pick and the ohio state product seems poised for the slot role especially with godwin s guidance jalen mcmillan came on strong late last season and is in line for more playing time in year 2 add in veteran sterling shepard trey palmer and seventh rounder tez johnson to the mix and therein lies a good problem to have for the bucs 3 haason reddick was the biggest offseason addition for a buccaneers team that is in need of pressure off the edges defensive tackles vita vea and calijah kancey led the team in sacks in 2024 following a lengthy contract squabble that spilled into the regular season reddick s lone campaign with the jets was one to forget but a new beginning in tampa bay could be what the two time pro bowler needs reddick who previously had four consecutive 10 plus sack seasons before 2024 joins an aggressive todd bowles scheme that will lean on his pass rushing talents and bring him opportunity to cash in on his one year deal there s also a fourth round pick to watch david walker the highest nfl draftee ever from central arkansas had coaches buzzing after rookie minicamp

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on
