news_mentions.headline: Two truths and a lie: Ben Johnson is the new Bill Walsh, while John Harbaugh has revived the Giants
news_mentions.description: Is Ben Johnson this generation's Bill Walsh? Are the Giants BACK under John Harbaugh? Which surprise team feels like a mirage? With early-season takes flying all over the NFL world, Bucky Brooks reveals two truths and a lie.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he explores three emerging viewpoints as we head into the 2026 campaign s second sunday the nfl world is still teeming with takes from week 1 that s what happens when a football starved public gets its first real meal since winter initial impressions breed strong opinions ultimately some prove prescient others preposterous with that in mind i d like to evaluate the legitimacy of a few nascent narratives prior to this season s second full helping of pigskin what s real and what s fake which early observations do i stand behind stand against here are two truths and a lie truth ben johnson is this generation s bill walsh no disrespect to kyle shanahan and sean mcvay s wizardry but ben johnson is the guru who will define the 2020s as a legendary play caller the second year head coach of the chicago bears has awakened a hibernating offense transforming it into a juggernaut that has defensive coordinators shaking in their boots as they prepare to face the monsters of the midway johnson s bears bludgeon opponents with a mix of power and pizzazz fielding an exotic smash mouth offense with an mvp caliber quarterback a pair of potential 1 000 yard rushers and a talented collection of pass catchers the savvy schemer can call any play he wants with supreme confidence in the team s talent tactics and execution moreover johnson knows his rock solid offensive line will impose its will on foes leaving them battered and bruised after a 60 minute war in the trenches given the overwhelming physicality and toughness this unit displays whenever it takes the field chicago is establishing itself as an offensive bully that pushes around adversaries chicago finished 2025 ranked ninth in points and sixth in total offense but johnson boldly stated in august that he wants the bears to set an nfl scoring record in 2026 then they hit the road for the season opener and dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers flexing their muscles against a completely overwhelmed defense the bears enjoyed a rare 250 250 game eclipsing the yardage figure in passing 261 and rushing 291 d andre swift led the way on the ground with 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries while kyle monangai reached the century mark on just 10 totes including a 61 yard touchdown meanwhile caleb williams completed 72 4 percent of his passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns adding 65 yards and two more scores with his legs the crazy part is that kalif raymond not rome odunze or luther burden led the receiving corps in targets nine catches eight and yards 84 shoot tight end colston loveland who took the league by storm in the second half of his rookie season didn t even have a catch and yet chicago nearly scored 60 points in 60 minutes the video game like exhibition demonstrated johnson s brilliance as a play caller further proving his deft ability to juggle a collection of weapons that s something he showcased as detroit s offensive coordinator from 2022 through 24 when the lions fielded three straight top five units in points and yards now he s doing the same thing in the windy city pulling all the right levers with a potent pack of playmakers bill walsh transformed the game with his west coast offense and a star studded lineup that featured joe montana jerry rice and roger craig among others the hall of fame coach made a pass heavy approach the norm these days johnson has balance back in vogue chicago ranked third in rushing and 10th in passing last season in 2026 the bears could finish in the top five in both categories with a well rounded approach creative scheming and a deep bag of tricks johnson is setting the standard for modern offense i can t wait to see what his bears do this sunday against the vikings brian flores blitz happy defense is challenging to most though johnson boasts a 5 1 record when calling plays against the ballyhooed coordinator truth the giants are back with john harbaugh the new york giants have enjoyed their greatest successes with hard nosed disciplinarians leading the charge bill parcells and tom coughlin each guided the franchise to two super bowl titles with both head men using old school blueprints that prioritized discipline toughness and attention to detail over flashy schemes and star power that throwback approach is back in the building with john harbaugh in charge the soon to be 64 year old compiled a 180 113 record with the baltimore ravens winning a lombardi trophy and six afc north titles while appearing in the playoffs 12 times in 18 seasons the grizzled leader built a culture of hard work physicality and toughness in baltimore holding his players accountable for meeting the standard on every snap now he s doing the same thing in nyc in a dazzling debut on sunday night football harbaugh guided his team to a 28 20 upset of the eternally hyped dallas cowboys suddenly the football world is buzzing about the upstart g men being dark horse contenders in the nfc the 2026 giants are built like the proud organization s four super bowl winning squads from 1986 1990 2007 and 2011 the first three of those teams in particular relied heavily on dominant defense a potent running game and a quarterback who makes plays in the clutch sound familiar this year s d still has some questions in the back end but the salty front seven is vintage big blue new york has a collection of pass rushers brian burns kayvon thibodeaux abdul carter chauncey golston and arvell reese who can jump into the old nascar packages that terrorized opponents in previous nyg title runs moreover free agent addition tremaine edmunds gives this team a reliable nerve center with the middle linebacker directing traffic to keep everyone on the same page the unit showed championship caliber communication and attention to detail last sunday night while playing with the physicality that s always been a hallmark of the franchise s great defenses offensively the giants have embraced a slow down style forcing opponents to adjust to a deliberate run oriented game plan that chews up the clock and reduces total possessions while qb jaxson dart will get chances to push the ball downfield to malik nabers and isaiah likely these giants want to control games with a lower risk approach that leans heavily on cam skattebo and the rushing attack to string together first downs the ground and pound strategy is part of the team s plan to set the tempo and push opponents out of their comfort zone particularly when going against high powered offenses that want to play shootouts against the cowboys the giants comfortably won time of possession 36 40 to 23 20 and went 9 for 11 on third down new york ran 16 more offensive plays than dallas 68 to 52 which helps explain why cowboys qb dak prescott lost his patience and threw an uncharacteristic interception setting up a giants score right before halftime admittedly it s only been one game maintaining perspective is key and the giants immediately face another stiff test in prime time visiting los angeles this week to play the rams on monday night football still i m confident that the culture and blueprint harbaugh is establishing will have big blue back in the championship hunt sooner than many anticipate lie the nfc west actually has four good teams the excitement following the cardinals week 1 upset of the chargers has led some observers to offer hot takes on the bird gang s immediate prospects in 2026 the optimism springing from the desert is a far cry from the doom and gloom that hovered over the franchise for most of the offseason while i hate to be the bearer of bad news to a fan base reveling in its week 1 win the cardinals are destined to finish as cellar dwellers and miss the playoffs for a fifth straight season the fanfare over mike lafleur s impressive debut is understandable but it will eventually subside as teams settle in and arizona s film circulates around the league astute observers will quickly scan last week s game and see the chargers beat themselves with a series of blunders and miscues typically seen at your local high school on a friday night the bolts lost the turnover battle minus two had a punt blocked and were stopped on downs three times the errors allowed the cardinals to dominate time of possession 37 31 to 22 29 and run 21 more plays although the cardinals deserve credit for finding a winning formula victories will be very hard to come by in a brutally tough schedule looking at the rosters and depth charts throughout the nfc west it is hard to find a position group where the cardinals have an edge in personnel yes arizona has a few blue chip players see te trey mcbride s budda baker and rookie rb jeremiyah love but the superior depth and talent on the seahawks rams and 49ers will require lafleur and co to out scheme everyone and in case you haven t noticed those three teams are pretty damn well coached in a league where jimmys and joes matter more than x s and o s the talent discrepancy between the cardinals and the nfc s true contenders ultimately will lead to a string of losses that leaves arizona behind the competition this sunday the cards host the reigning super bowl champions sam darnold remains sidelined for the seahawks but as we saw in seattle s 13 10 win over new england mike macdonald s team is plenty capable of winning games with defense though lafleur certainly can continue to build this team s competitive culture the first time head coach faces long odds when it comes to orchestrating a true rags to riches turnaround in 2026

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba continues to dominate, no matter who's at QB: 'This guy is a wizard'
news_mentions.body_text: glendale ariz jaxon smith njigba often found himself in 34 the zone 34 last season but it had been nearly five years since he ascended to the level he showcased sunday afternoon including playoffs the star wideout racked up ten 100 yard games in 2025 during the seattle seahawks 39 romp to their second super bowl title twice the reigning nfl offensive player of the year snagged a pair of touchdown passes in a game but never thrice like he did when breaking into the national spotlight as a sophomore at ohio state in the thrilling 2022 rose bowl smith njigba set an fbs bowl record with 347 receiving yards and three touchdown receptions he didn 39 t quite match that distance with his 155 receiving yards on sunday but he scored three touchdowns for the first time since his college days as the seahawks improved to 2 0 with a 31 7 win against the arizona cardinals 34 it 39 s been a minute 34 said a reflective smith njigba 34 it 39 s awesome being in that zone putting points up for our team whatever it takes to win i 39 m willing to do whatever it takes any time you get opportunities you got to execute and put points on the board 34 not only did smith njigba become the first seahawks player since dk metcalf with three receiving touchdowns in a game he also made life significantly easier for backup quarterback drew lock who started in place of sam darnold seattle 39 s starting quarterback is out with a glute injury though coach mike macdonald said postgame that darnold 39 s timetable for returning has shifted quite drastically for the better darnold could start as soon as sept 27 against the washington commanders it was lock 39 s show on sunday however with smith njigba in a leading role on seattle 39 s second offensive play of the game lock dropped back and heaved a deep pass down the right sideline for smith njigba who was five yards behind the last line of arizona 39 s defense when he caught the ball smith njigba deked cardinals cornerback will johnson with a devastating head fake then slipped behind safety budda baker for a career long 82 yard touchdown reception 34 that 39 s my hooping skills right there 34 smith njigba said of his head fake lock wasn 39 t expecting smith njigba to be so open nor for him to run his route in such a manner 34 but that 39 s the beauty of playing with him 34 lock said 34 he 39 s going to find ways to get open it might not be the most conventional but that 39 s what makes him a ballplayer and that 39 s what makes him one of the best receivers the offensive player of the year last year 34 smith njigba 39 s next two touchdowns overshadowed a somewhat sloppy first half for the seahawks in which seattle and arizona each scored seven points he put seattle up for good on the opening drive of the second half when he ran a slant to perfection sneaking behind cardinals cornerback max melton to corral a seed from lock for a seven yard touchdown the 24 year old put the game out of reach early in the fourth quarter when lock threaded a pass through three cardinals defenders on third and 6 from arizona 39 s 12 yard line it wasn 39 t until aj barner plunged into the end zone from one yard out with 1 11 remaining in the game that a seahawks player not named smith njigba found the end zone for seattle this season smith njigba had the seahawks 39 lone touchdown in their season opening 13 10 win against the new england patriots as much as the seahawks long for the return of darnold who has missed all but five offensive snaps this season smith njigba is well on his way to another banner year regardless his 277 receiving yards lead the league while his four receiving touchdowns are tied with detroit lions standout amon ra st brown smith njigba has proven that seattle 39 s offense isn 39 t about who is throwing the passes or what scheme first year offensive coordinator brian fleury runs the game plan is quite simple get the ball to smith njigba and let the all pro figure out the rest 34 when he catches the ball we 39 re just like 39 man this guy is a wizard 39 34 defensive lineman leonard williams said 34 it 39 s nice to have big playmakers on offense 34 it doesn 39 t hurt to have a stingy defense either seattle allowed a game tying touchdown pass from jacoby brissett to trey mcbride to start the second quarter but otherwise stifled the cardinals arizona finished the game with only 151 yards of total offense including just 44 yards after halftime including last year 39 s playoff run the seahawks have won a franchise record 12 consecutive games thanks in large part to their defensive dominance the members of the unit that refers to itself as the dark side didn 39 t give that accomplishment much thought in the immediate aftermath of sunday 39 s shellacking 34 i think that 39 s what 39 s so beautiful about this team 34 williams said 34 i don 39 t think anyone 39 s thinking about that i think we 39 re so honed in on just being who we are 34 two games into their title defense the seahawks have demonstrated they are a well oiled machine capable of running it back and contending for what would be the franchise 39 s third super bowl title certainly seattle would benefit from darnold running the offense again but lock was more than adequate in his absence completing 19 of 26 attempts for 235 yards and those three touchdown passes to smith njigba 34 we 39 re on record about how we feel about him 34 macdonald said of lock 34 so he just backed that up today but it 39 s a 12 as 1 thing everybody having each other 39 s back 34 perhaps smith njigba though is a bit more irreplaceable than the rest of the seahawks the franchise made it abundantly clear how it feels about smith njigba when it made him the highest paid wide receiver in the nfl on an annual basis with a four year 168 8 million deal in march the seahawks dished the dough out for smith njigba because few nfl wide receivers if any can carry an offense quite like he can sunday 39 s performance was the latest in a line of many dominant ones for smith njigba who hauled in touchdown receptions from lock with ease just like that new year 39 s day in 2022 when he burst onto the scene 34 drew he is a special talent and sees the field very well and can make any throw 34 smith njigba said 34 i know he 39 s looking for me and i just want to be there for him 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams considered 'week to week' after suffering hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Caleb Williams is viewed as "week to week" after injurying his hamstring during Sunday's loss to the Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears expect caleb williams to miss time but the quarterback avoided a major hamstring injury head coach ben johnson said monday on espn 1000 that the team believes williams will be week to week following an mri exam it sounds like it s gonna be a week to week deal for him johnson said i gotta still talk with our trainer here we ll do that here shortly and i ll have the lowdown from him but it sounds like it s week to week but will likely miss some time johnson later told reporters the bears received a somewhat encouraging report about williams injury adding that the qb may not practice this week williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after coming up lame on a scramble in the fourth quarter the qb was emotional while being carted off the field but was reportedly seen in the locker room later walking without aid and only a slight limp yeah potentially dodged a bullet johnson added on monday we ll see he s tough and he comes back from these types of things better than the average human so we ll see while potentially missing the qb for next monday night s week 3 game against the philadelphia eagles is a negative overall it could be much worse for williams tyson bagent will get the start if williams is unable to go given the fragility of hamstring injuries the bears could play it cautiously with williams an injury that returns with a tweak if not properly healed could linger all season with a soft tissue injury it will be interesting to see how willing williams is to scamper when he returns he has used his legs with aplomb to open the 2026 season

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffers hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's loss to the Minnesota Vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter.
news_mentions.body_text: chicago bears quarterback caleb williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter williams went down while scrambling on first and goal with chicago trailing 6 3 the qb appeared to be in pain on the field grabbing at his right leg williams had to be helped off the field and was carted from the sideline to the locker room bears head coach ben johnson told reporters after the game that he did not have a sense on the severity of the injury we ll know more tomorrow johnson said johnson added he had spoken with williams prior to his postgame news conference and the third year pro was in good spirits i m actually happy it s nothing with the knee johnson told reporters that was my first inclination but the hamstring could be pretty damaging as well we ll see how bad it is tomorrow and we ll go from there chgo sports adam jahns reported that williams was seen in the locker room walking under his own power without the use of crutches one week after exploding for 59 points in a win over the panthers williams and the bears offense struggled against a stout vikings defense williams was 15 of 26 for 138 yards with an interception on a rainy day at soldier field at the time of the injury and chicago proceeded to have a potential game tying field goal blocked after the drive stalled with williams out of the game tyson bagent replaced williams under center for chicago and nearly led the bears to a comeback but bagent was sacked by dallas turner on fourth down in the red zone to end the game bagent would be in line to start if williams missed extended time bagent started four games during the 2023 season compiling a 2 2 record

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys' Jerry Jones: Giants were 'better than we thought they were' in season opener
news_mentions.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones gave the Giants credit on Friday for playing better than he thought they could in the season opener, but he's confident Dallas will recover and improve moving forward.
news_mentions.body_text: dennis green delivered the famous they are who we thought they were line following his cardinals 2006 monday night loss to the bears twenty years later jerry jones came to the opposite realization while assessing his cowboys week 1 defeat to the giants they just did a good job all over jones said of the giants in a friday interview on 105 3 the fan i will tell you they were better than we thought they were i m anxious to see how new york continues to play but really a combination of things we didn t play as well as we should play and can play but they played better than i thought they could jones wasn t the only one surprised by the giants who spectacularly thwarted expectations while never trailing dallas on the way to a season opening victory jaxson dart threw for 230 yards and three touchdowns on 23 of 29 passing and joined battering ram cam skattebo in dolling out damage on the ground the duo combined for 135 rushing yards with skattebo punching one in for six big blue sidelined the cowboys vaunted offense for large swaths of the contest exposing a dallas defense that was expected to be much improved under new defensive coordinator christian parker following a transformative offseason the cowboys instead allowed the giants to win the possession battle by over 13 minutes and blew several coverages both on vital downs and to allow open pass catchers running free in the end zone though jones graciously gave new york its share of credit he also noted the learning process the cowboys have undergone thanks to considerable scheme and personnel changes it s a process dallas must accelerate ahead of sunday s matchup against the commanders of course jones said when asked if he also felt the cowboys opened the season worse than he thought they d be to say it that way i d rather say it more positively that we re not at the level we re not at the level that we thought we would be i can give you a lot of reasons logical reasons you re dealing with conceptually a new coaching staff dealing with a new to a lot of people out there defensive scheme and then you re dealing with people who are fresh in to that scheme it s a challenge to put it together and ready to go we didn t play well last week what i meant to say was new york had really more to do with it than i thought they would so that s a factor but washington could have a lot to do with it here sunday too so we ve got to be ready to step up the level of play there s no question the upcoming matchup with washington gives both teams two divisional games right out of the gate whichever team loses sunday will fall to both 0 2 overall and in the nfc east for all that went wrong to kick off the season jones believes his squad will show up vastly improved for a vital showdown at home the improvement certainly from where we played sunday that improvement is to be expected and will be there jones said i m just gonna say it it will be there i know how hard these guys are working i know their physical capabilities and i also know their motivation so you ll see improvement i ll go on the record as saying that

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) questionable to play Monday vs. Giants after missing second straight practice
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is considered questionable to play Monday against the Giants due to a hip injury, head coach Sean McVay said.
news_mentions.body_text: there are some injury concerns over another rams star wide receiver puka nacua is questionable to play monday against the giants although nacua is officially listed on the injury report with a hip ailment head coach sean mcvay told reporters nacua is dealing with some groin soreness that is separate from the psoas issue that caused him to miss time during training camp nacua who was a surprise non participant in friday s practice also sat out saturday s session if the two time pro bowler ends up missing the contest or seeing diminished playing time due to his injury los angeles will have to dig deep to find production elsewhere in the passing game nacua was the only rams pass catcher who got going in any way during the team s season opening bludgeoning by the 49ers and even still he was relatively quiet outside of a 41 yard catch nacua hauled in five receptions for 74 yards in week 1 while no one else on the team went over 30 yards davante adams would likely shoulder a large burden of work as matthew stafford s go to guy should nacua end up sitting jordan whittington quad is doubtful to play which leaves konata mumpfield xavier smith cj daniels and tutu atwell available as well as a deep tight end group led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson it s not an ideal situation for the rams to be dealing with an ailing nacua at the start of a season that began with great expectations l a s early injury hurdles also extend to the defensive side with star acquisition myles garrett on injured reserve following knee surgery still there s plenty of stars to get the job done including defensive lineman aaron donald who plans to make his season debut against new york after ending a two year retirement to rejoin the rams at the end of august it remains to be seen if nacua suits up along with donald for the momentous occasion the rams kick off against the giants on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an sunday s showing gives them something to build with a trip to brazil to face the ravens up next daniels woes won t go away we re once again being robbed of witnessing one of the most electric playmakers in the game after an injury plagued 2025 season jayden daniels left sunday s game with a dislocated left elbow he suffered on the last play of the first half he dislocated the same elbow last season and missed three games before returning only to aggravate the injury in his first game back last season washington went 3 7 without daniels in 2025 averaging 23 points per game in those contests the commanders still had life once backup marcus mariota entered the game at qb on sunday but they managed to score just 10 points with him at the helm which weren t nearly enough against dak and co it s not going to get any easier next week with the reigning champion seahawks and their suffocating defense visiting washington cowboys defense still has work to do while holding a team to 20 points is respectable washington posted 203 yards in the second quarter alone prior to jayden daniels injury on the final play of the half the commanders clearly had figured out how to attack dallas with daniels ability to create with his legs playing a leading role the new look secondary took a hit too with cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot leaving the game due to injury first year defensive coordinator christian parker now has a week to come up with a better plan for keeping a dual threat quarterback in check two time mvp lamar jackson awaits dallas in week 3 next gen stats insight for commanders cowboys via nfl pro all four of dak prescott s touchdown passes traveled at least 10 yards downfield in the air tying a career high nfl research with sunday s victory at at t stadium dak prescott has won 20 consecutive home games against nfc east opponents he s now tied with tom brady 2007 2014 for the longest home winning streak in division games since the afl nfl merger in 1970 back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways efficiency name of 49ers game five drives five touchdowns san francisco s offense was something to behold sunday against a young dolphins defense finding the paint on five consecutive drives to build a 35 6 lead after three quarters brock purdy never seemed stressed channeling his best oprah winfrey impression you get a touchdown you get a touchdown christian mccaffrey and purdy got the party started with a pair of td runs in the first half before the scoreboard blew wide open in the third quarter with george kittle kyle juszczyk and mccaffrey finding the end zone purdy who was replaced by mac jones midway through the fourth quarter finished his banner day 20 of 22 passing for 287 yards two touchdowns with no interceptions while leading the team in rushing with 30 yards and another score on three carries milestone day for mccaffrey kittle on a day that was all about kyle shanahan s offense it was no shock that the heartbeat of the supporting cast shined brightest christian mccaffrey had just 67 scrimmage yards but made the most of his touches near the goal line his pair of rushing scores put him in elite company as he became the third player in nfl history to record 50 plus scrimmage tds with multiple teams joining hall of famers marshall faulk rams 85 colts 51 and randy moss vikings 92 patriots 50 but perhaps the most exciting aspect of san francisco s offensive frenzy was george kittle s return to prominence after missing six games in 2025 with an achilles injury and a modest week 1 outing in australia the seven time pro bowler led the team with 80 receiving yards and his first touchdown a 12 yard reception on a busted coverage since the injury kittle s third catch of the day also marked his 600th career reception the 11th tight end in league history to accomplish that feat fins find offensive improvement the miami offense took unquestioned steps forward from last week s opener at least early in the contest the unit s three first half drives all resulted in field goal tries with riley patterson converting twice the dolphins outgained the 49ers in the first half 165 yards to 125 and held the ball for nearly nine more minutes than the home team for as well as malik willis and de 39 von achane played the difference going into the locker room came in the red zone where miami struggled to convert with a pair of drives stalling at the san francisco 10 and 5 yard lines unfortunately the story changed in the second half miami failed to amass more than 15 yards on four straight possessions before a garbage time 77 yard touchdown connection between willis and ryan miller there s still a lot to clean up that ll likely be a common theme for this young team throughout the season but there were definite positives early in this contest that willis and co can build on in addition miami s improvement on third down its 47 conversion rate up from 20 in week 1 was another step in the right direction next gen stats insight for dolphins 49ers via nfl pro brock purdy completed all 10 of his downfield pass attempts 10 air yards against the dolphins for 211 yards and a touchdown it was the most completions without an incompletion by a qb on downfield passes since week 5 2021 carson wentz vs baltimore nfl research brock purdy recorded a 149 1 passer rating 287 passing yards two passing touchdowns in the 49ers week 2 win over miami this was his eighth career start with a 140 passer rating tying joe montana for second in 49ers history including playoffs behind only steve young 13 only lamar jackson has more such games 12 than purdy since the latter entered the league in 2022 back to top grant gordon s takeaways visions of chiefs of old shine with a prime time audience looking on for the second week in a row kicker harrison butker booted a 40 yard game winner in overtime to send the chiefs to a 2 0 start it s quite the difference from the 0 2 genesis of last year s disastrous 6 11 showing it wasn t the prettiest win but it was a glimpse of what used to be with patrick mahomes producing a glistening line of 32 of 47 passing for 382 yards three touchdowns and a 114 0 rating the first of those three touchdowns went to travis kelce who turned in nine receptions for 101 yards it was the first time mahomes topped 300 passing yards and kelce had 100 plus receiving in the same game since week 7 2023 fresh face kenneth walker added 117 yards on the ground though he didn t run as wild as he did in his debut against the broncos for that matter neither did the chiefs instead they eked this one out which might be the best of signs for k c to come having gone 11 0 in one score games in 2024 the chiefs were an nfl worst 1 9 in such games last season now mahomes and co are 1 0 in nail biters and perfect through two weeks it s a long road but this is a good beginning banged up colts lose ot heartbreaker there s been no team in the nfl that s waited longer for a win than the colts unfortunately for indianapolis it waited excruciatingly longer for its ninth straight loss with an injury to alec pierce exposing the colts offensive depth even more sauce gardner and charvarius ward also dealt with injuries that hamstrung the defense it made the colts ability to hang around sunday all the more impressive but the struggles and losses are piling up jonathan taylor was a stud at times 24 carries for 92 yards two touchdowns but corralled for large swaths in others josh downs came up pretty big seven receptions for 72 yards tyler warren was relatively quiet aside from the first td of the game and daniel jones simply couldn t rely on laquon treadwell or keenan allen in more than four quarters of football indy totaled 329 yards of offense while its defense gave up north of 520 fortune isn t smiling on shane steichen s team right now it will need to in a hurry treadwell s topsy turvy play emblematic with ample time left in the fourth quarter nbc s cris collinsworth proclaimed a pivotal upcoming down as the play of the game it wasn t there were about 17 more plays of the game thereafter perhaps the most symbolic of the craziness of the evening was 2016 first round pick turned journeyman laquon treadwell s 48 yard reception in overtime with the colts trailing 30 27 daniel jones and co took over and the qb heaved a long ball to treadwell treadwell bobbled the ball before collecting it fell to the ground sprang up and had possession punched out by nohl williams and recovered by the chiefs game over nope replay showed that l 39 jarius sneed s hand had glanced treadwell s side after the receiver had established final control so there was no fumble now it was the chiefs with their backs against the wall they held though and after indy tied it up on a spencer shrader field goal k c marched down for the game winner the colts held the lead three times in the first half but trailed throughout the second after patrick mahomes navigated an 80 yard go ahead drive to begin the third quarter it looked like the chiefs would pull away at 27 20 but it wasn t to be despite mahomes and co outgaining jones squad 523 329 this one went down to the final play the chiefs emerging as 2 0 looking like their old selves meanwhile the colts will keep scratching their helmets wondering what else can go wrong before they get back in the win column next gen stats insight for colts chiefs via nfl pro creed humphrey did not allow a pressure across 51 pass blocking snaps against the colts his second consecutive game without a pressure allowed nfl research the colts extended their nfl long losing streak to nine games the streak began in week 12 2025 when indianapolis lost to kansas city in overtime back to top

news_mentions.headline: Two truths and a lie: Ben Johnson is the new Bill Walsh, while John Harbaugh has revived the Giants
news_mentions.description: Is Ben Johnson this generation's Bill Walsh? Are the Giants BACK under John Harbaugh? Which surprise team feels like a mirage? With early-season takes flying all over the NFL world, Bucky Brooks reveals two truths and a lie.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he explores three emerging viewpoints as we head into the 2026 campaign s second sunday the nfl world is still teeming with takes from week 1 that s what happens when a football starved public gets its first real meal since winter initial impressions breed strong opinions ultimately some prove prescient others preposterous with that in mind i d like to evaluate the legitimacy of a few nascent narratives prior to this season s second full helping of pigskin what s real and what s fake which early observations do i stand behind stand against here are two truths and a lie truth ben johnson is this generation s bill walsh no disrespect to kyle shanahan and sean mcvay s wizardry but ben johnson is the guru who will define the 2020s as a legendary play caller the second year head coach of the chicago bears has awakened a hibernating offense transforming it into a juggernaut that has defensive coordinators shaking in their boots as they prepare to face the monsters of the midway johnson s bears bludgeon opponents with a mix of power and pizzazz fielding an exotic smash mouth offense with an mvp caliber quarterback a pair of potential 1 000 yard rushers and a talented collection of pass catchers the savvy schemer can call any play he wants with supreme confidence in the team s talent tactics and execution moreover johnson knows his rock solid offensive line will impose its will on foes leaving them battered and bruised after a 60 minute war in the trenches given the overwhelming physicality and toughness this unit displays whenever it takes the field chicago is establishing itself as an offensive bully that pushes around adversaries chicago finished 2025 ranked ninth in points and sixth in total offense but johnson boldly stated in august that he wants the bears to set an nfl scoring record in 2026 then they hit the road for the season opener and dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers flexing their muscles against a completely overwhelmed defense the bears enjoyed a rare 250 250 game eclipsing the yardage figure in passing 261 and rushing 291 d andre swift led the way on the ground with 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries while kyle monangai reached the century mark on just 10 totes including a 61 yard touchdown meanwhile caleb williams completed 72 4 percent of his passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns adding 65 yards and two more scores with his legs the crazy part is that kalif raymond not rome odunze or luther burden led the receiving corps in targets nine catches eight and yards 84 shoot tight end colston loveland who took the league by storm in the second half of his rookie season didn t even have a catch and yet chicago nearly scored 60 points in 60 minutes the video game like exhibition demonstrated johnson s brilliance as a play caller further proving his deft ability to juggle a collection of weapons that s something he showcased as detroit s offensive coordinator from 2022 through 24 when the lions fielded three straight top five units in points and yards now he s doing the same thing in the windy city pulling all the right levers with a potent pack of playmakers bill walsh transformed the game with his west coast offense and a star studded lineup that featured joe montana jerry rice and roger craig among others the hall of fame coach made a pass heavy approach the norm these days johnson has balance back in vogue chicago ranked third in rushing and 10th in passing last season in 2026 the bears could finish in the top five in both categories with a well rounded approach creative scheming and a deep bag of tricks johnson is setting the standard for modern offense i can t wait to see what his bears do this sunday against the vikings brian flores blitz happy defense is challenging to most though johnson boasts a 5 1 record when calling plays against the ballyhooed coordinator truth the giants are back with john harbaugh the new york giants have enjoyed their greatest successes with hard nosed disciplinarians leading the charge bill parcells and tom coughlin each guided the franchise to two super bowl titles with both head men using old school blueprints that prioritized discipline toughness and attention to detail over flashy schemes and star power that throwback approach is back in the building with john harbaugh in charge the soon to be 64 year old compiled a 180 113 record with the baltimore ravens winning a lombardi trophy and six afc north titles while appearing in the playoffs 12 times in 18 seasons the grizzled leader built a culture of hard work physicality and toughness in baltimore holding his players accountable for meeting the standard on every snap now he s doing the same thing in nyc in a dazzling debut on sunday night football harbaugh guided his team to a 28 20 upset of the eternally hyped dallas cowboys suddenly the football world is buzzing about the upstart g men being dark horse contenders in the nfc the 2026 giants are built like the proud organization s four super bowl winning squads from 1986 1990 2007 and 2011 the first three of those teams in particular relied heavily on dominant defense a potent running game and a quarterback who makes plays in the clutch sound familiar this year s d still has some questions in the back end but the salty front seven is vintage big blue new york has a collection of pass rushers brian burns kayvon thibodeaux abdul carter chauncey golston and arvell reese who can jump into the old nascar packages that terrorized opponents in previous nyg title runs moreover free agent addition tremaine edmunds gives this team a reliable nerve center with the middle linebacker directing traffic to keep everyone on the same page the unit showed championship caliber communication and attention to detail last sunday night while playing with the physicality that s always been a hallmark of the franchise s great defenses offensively the giants have embraced a slow down style forcing opponents to adjust to a deliberate run oriented game plan that chews up the clock and reduces total possessions while qb jaxson dart will get chances to push the ball downfield to malik nabers and isaiah likely these giants want to control games with a lower risk approach that leans heavily on cam skattebo and the rushing attack to string together first downs the ground and pound strategy is part of the team s plan to set the tempo and push opponents out of their comfort zone particularly when going against high powered offenses that want to play shootouts against the cowboys the giants comfortably won time of possession 36 40 to 23 20 and went 9 for 11 on third down new york ran 16 more offensive plays than dallas 68 to 52 which helps explain why cowboys qb dak prescott lost his patience and threw an uncharacteristic interception setting up a giants score right before halftime admittedly it s only been one game maintaining perspective is key and the giants immediately face another stiff test in prime time visiting los angeles this week to play the rams on monday night football still i m confident that the culture and blueprint harbaugh is establishing will have big blue back in the championship hunt sooner than many anticipate lie the nfc west actually has four good teams the excitement following the cardinals week 1 upset of the chargers has led some observers to offer hot takes on the bird gang s immediate prospects in 2026 the optimism springing from the desert is a far cry from the doom and gloom that hovered over the franchise for most of the offseason while i hate to be the bearer of bad news to a fan base reveling in its week 1 win the cardinals are destined to finish as cellar dwellers and miss the playoffs for a fifth straight season the fanfare over mike lafleur s impressive debut is understandable but it will eventually subside as teams settle in and arizona s film circulates around the league astute observers will quickly scan last week s game and see the chargers beat themselves with a series of blunders and miscues typically seen at your local high school on a friday night the bolts lost the turnover battle minus two had a punt blocked and were stopped on downs three times the errors allowed the cardinals to dominate time of possession 37 31 to 22 29 and run 21 more plays although the cardinals deserve credit for finding a winning formula victories will be very hard to come by in a brutally tough schedule looking at the rosters and depth charts throughout the nfc west it is hard to find a position group where the cardinals have an edge in personnel yes arizona has a few blue chip players see te trey mcbride s budda baker and rookie rb jeremiyah love but the superior depth and talent on the seahawks rams and 49ers will require lafleur and co to out scheme everyone and in case you haven t noticed those three teams are pretty damn well coached in a league where jimmys and joes matter more than x s and o s the talent discrepancy between the cardinals and the nfc s true contenders ultimately will lead to a string of losses that leaves arizona behind the competition this sunday the cards host the reigning super bowl champions sam darnold remains sidelined for the seahawks but as we saw in seattle s 13 10 win over new england mike macdonald s team is plenty capable of winning games with defense though lafleur certainly can continue to build this team s competitive culture the first time head coach faces long odds when it comes to orchestrating a true rags to riches turnaround in 2026
