news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) inactive for Monday's game vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: The Rams will be without another star on "Monday Night Football." Puka Nacua is officially inactive for Los Angeles' prime-time game against the Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams will be without another star on monday night football puka nacua is officially inactive for los angeles prime time game against the giants the wide receiver popped up on the injury report with what was labeled as a hip issue friday missing that practice and the team s saturday session before receiving a questionable designation head coach sean mcvay described nacua s injury as groin soreness telling reporters it was not associated with the psoas issue that caused the 25 year old to miss some time during the preseason regardless of where exactly nacua is hurting he s unable to partake in an important game for the rams as they look to avoid an 0 2 hole to start a season they entered with realistic super bowl aspirations although nacua was not his typically explosive self in los angeles season opener against the 49ers collecting five catches for 74 yards he was the only rams pass catcher to get anything going in the 27 7 loss his yardage total was nearly half of matthew stafford s 155 through the air and a sizable chunk of it came on a 41 yard connection before the game got out of hand his absence is a massive blow for stafford as the reigning most valuable player looks to get back on track especially considering wideout jordan whittington will also miss the contest due to a quad injury davante adams is likely in line for a ton of targets and will be supplemented by other receivers such as konata mumpfield xavier smith and tutu atwell the rams also roster a diverse tight end corps led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson and running backs kyren williams and blake corum are capable of contributing in the passing game too just a couple weeks into the season the rams are already juggling a couple injuries to big names along with nacua being unable to go monday los angeles will be without myles garrett for at least four games after the star pass rusher underwent knee surgery and was placed on injured reserve there remains an impressive array of stars in l a but mcvay s crew is certainly dealing with some difficulties in the early going they ll look to overcome them to move to 1 1 when they kick off against the giants 1 0 on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) questionable to play Monday vs. Giants after missing second straight practice
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is considered questionable to play Monday against the Giants due to a hip injury, head coach Sean McVay said.
news_mentions.body_text: there are some injury concerns over another rams star wide receiver puka nacua is questionable to play monday against the giants although nacua is officially listed on the injury report with a hip ailment head coach sean mcvay told reporters nacua is dealing with some groin soreness that is separate from the psoas issue that caused him to miss time during training camp nacua who was a surprise non participant in friday s practice also sat out saturday s session if the two time pro bowler ends up missing the contest or seeing diminished playing time due to his injury los angeles will have to dig deep to find production elsewhere in the passing game nacua was the only rams pass catcher who got going in any way during the team s season opening bludgeoning by the 49ers and even still he was relatively quiet outside of a 41 yard catch nacua hauled in five receptions for 74 yards in week 1 while no one else on the team went over 30 yards davante adams would likely shoulder a large burden of work as matthew stafford s go to guy should nacua end up sitting jordan whittington quad is doubtful to play which leaves konata mumpfield xavier smith cj daniels and tutu atwell available as well as a deep tight end group led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson it s not an ideal situation for the rams to be dealing with an ailing nacua at the start of a season that began with great expectations l a s early injury hurdles also extend to the defensive side with star acquisition myles garrett on injured reserve following knee surgery still there s plenty of stars to get the job done including defensive lineman aaron donald who plans to make his season debut against new york after ending a two year retirement to rejoin the rams at the end of august it remains to be seen if nacua suits up along with donald for the momentous occasion the rams kick off against the giants on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) inactive for Monday's game vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: The Rams will be without another star on "Monday Night Football." Puka Nacua is officially inactive for Los Angeles' prime-time game against the Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams will be without another star on monday night football puka nacua is officially inactive for los angeles prime time game against the giants the wide receiver popped up on the injury report with what was labeled as a hip issue friday missing that practice and the team s saturday session before receiving a questionable designation head coach sean mcvay described nacua s injury as groin soreness telling reporters it was not associated with the psoas issue that caused the 25 year old to miss some time during the preseason regardless of where exactly nacua is hurting he s unable to partake in an important game for the rams as they look to avoid an 0 2 hole to start a season they entered with realistic super bowl aspirations although nacua was not his typically explosive self in los angeles season opener against the 49ers collecting five catches for 74 yards he was the only rams pass catcher to get anything going in the 27 7 loss his yardage total was nearly half of matthew stafford s 155 through the air and a sizable chunk of it came on a 41 yard connection before the game got out of hand his absence is a massive blow for stafford as the reigning most valuable player looks to get back on track especially considering wideout jordan whittington will also miss the contest due to a quad injury davante adams is likely in line for a ton of targets and will be supplemented by other receivers such as konata mumpfield xavier smith and tutu atwell the rams also roster a diverse tight end corps led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson and running backs kyren williams and blake corum are capable of contributing in the passing game too just a couple weeks into the season the rams are already juggling a couple injuries to big names along with nacua being unable to go monday los angeles will be without myles garrett for at least four games after the star pass rusher underwent knee surgery and was placed on injured reserve there remains an impressive array of stars in l a but mcvay s crew is certainly dealing with some difficulties in the early going they ll look to overcome them to move to 1 1 when they kick off against the giants 1 0 on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) questionable to play Monday vs. Giants after missing second straight practice
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is considered questionable to play Monday against the Giants due to a hip injury, head coach Sean McVay said.
news_mentions.body_text: there are some injury concerns over another rams star wide receiver puka nacua is questionable to play monday against the giants although nacua is officially listed on the injury report with a hip ailment head coach sean mcvay told reporters nacua is dealing with some groin soreness that is separate from the psoas issue that caused him to miss time during training camp nacua who was a surprise non participant in friday s practice also sat out saturday s session if the two time pro bowler ends up missing the contest or seeing diminished playing time due to his injury los angeles will have to dig deep to find production elsewhere in the passing game nacua was the only rams pass catcher who got going in any way during the team s season opening bludgeoning by the 49ers and even still he was relatively quiet outside of a 41 yard catch nacua hauled in five receptions for 74 yards in week 1 while no one else on the team went over 30 yards davante adams would likely shoulder a large burden of work as matthew stafford s go to guy should nacua end up sitting jordan whittington quad is doubtful to play which leaves konata mumpfield xavier smith cj daniels and tutu atwell available as well as a deep tight end group led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson it s not an ideal situation for the rams to be dealing with an ailing nacua at the start of a season that began with great expectations l a s early injury hurdles also extend to the defensive side with star acquisition myles garrett on injured reserve following knee surgery still there s plenty of stars to get the job done including defensive lineman aaron donald who plans to make his season debut against new york after ending a two year retirement to rejoin the rams at the end of august it remains to be seen if nacua suits up along with donald for the momentous occasion the rams kick off against the giants on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.description: Which players should you scoop up to give your fantasy team a boost heading into Week 3? Matt Okada spotlights the top waiver-wire targets at each position, including Broncos RB Jonah Coleman and Panthers QB Bryce Young.
news_mentions.body_text: two sundays of fantasy football in the books time for the week 3 waiver wire some of the names listed below might end up winning leagues at the very least several of them could be difference makers in the immediate future do not take the waiver wire for granted this is where the rubber meets the road in our imaginary game i ll be here every week from now until fantasy championships hope to have you along for the full ride let s win some hardware notes players must be rostered in less than 60 of espn leagues to be eligible for the column all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted top 15 overall waiver wire targets and here are my top waiver wire targets by position quarterbacks running backs washington commanders rb rachaad white is rostered in 65 percent of leagues above the 60 threshold of eligibility for this file but he was exceptional on sunday both on the ground and as a receiver and should be scooped up if available wide receivers san francisco 49ers wr deebo samuel is already rostered in 68 of leagues above the 60 threshold of eligibility for this file but he might be worth adding in the other 32 with de zhaun stribling out for multiple months tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Falcons name Michael Penix Jr. starting quarterback for Week 3 game vs. Packers
news_mentions.description: Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons in their Week 3 game against the Green Bay Packers, the team announced.
news_mentions.body_text: after 10 long months michael penix is ready for live nfl action penix will start at quarterback for the atlanta falcons in their week 3 game against the green bay packers on thursday night the team announced on monday penix will be making his first start since suffering a season ending knee injury last november he was officially a full participant in monday s estimated practice report cooper rush started atlanta s first two games of the 2026 season both losses in place of the sidelined penix and tua tagovailoa who has been dealing with an oblique injury falcons coach kevin stefanski said earlier monday that he had no update on who his week 3 starter would be but had an idea where atlanta was going in the end the falcons are going back to their 2024 first round pick penix s road back to the field lasted a little longer than expected after tearing knee ligaments in november and undergoing surgery penix was not cleared to fully participate in practice until aug 22 tagovailoa who was signed in the offseason for the veteran minimum was named the week 1 starter over the still ramping penix but was sidelined due to an oblique injury suffered during practice that week in came rush who through two weeks has struggled to put in mildly the 32 year old journeyman completed 56 4 of his passes for 229 yards and a league high four interceptions in atlanta s first two games which it lost by a combined score of 54 16 rush was benched in the second half of sunday s blowout loss to carolina in favor of undrafted rookie jack strand who fared no better in penix atlanta hopes to have its first glimpse of a legitimate starting qb leading stefanski s offense in 2026 before suffering his season ending injury the southpaw was having a solid campaign in his first full year as starter completing 60 1 of his passes for 1 982 yards nine touchdowns and three picks he finished the year with a league best 1 1 int percentage the falcons could surely use penix s sturdy production to get off the mat on a short week at 0 2 atlanta will be traveling to face the packers in their home opener at a hostile lambeau field atlanta is no stranger to a left handed quarterback stunning the green bay faithful in prime time see mike vick in the 2002 wild card round we ll see if penix can deliver a similar performance on thursday night football

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal effort it wasn t pretty but green bay is in the win column in 2026 jordan love threw for just 145 yards the packers offense converted one of nine third downs and picked up at least one first down on green bay was in position to tie the game with a field goal after another three down stop in overtime with two consecutive sacks shared by four packers defenders green bay rode backup backs kaleb johnson and chris brooks into gang green territory where after another awful jets penalty and matthew golden first down trey smack smacked home the game winning field goal sunday s turnaround came in stark contrast to how the packers finished their season opener against minnesota when they blew a two score lead and lost by three scores green bay fans will be happy to sheath their knives for meadowlands new york was in position to ride out an ugly win over the visiting packers through three quarters the jets had made fewer mistakes avoided nasty injuries and adjusted well to what green bay was throwing at them then fortunes turned up 14 7 new york benefitted from a marshawn lloyd fumble at the packers 18 yard line but the jets went three and out and neglected to go for it on fourth and 1 from the 9 setting up a field goal later tied 17 17 after two green bay scoring drives with the ball at the 50 yard line under two minutes to the jets decided to try a fourth and 1 dive the risk didn t pay off as braelon allen was stuffed at the line the packers didn t make anything of the turnover on downs but took their momentum into overtime where geno smith was sacked on back to back plays and new york punted the ball and game back to the pack for the second straight year the jets have outplayed their opponents in their home opener aaron rodgers steelers in 2025 only to fall just short in the end after such a positive start the loss felt like a familiar finish for aaron glenn s group and serves as a missed opportunity for new york to start 2 0 for the first time in 11 years sloppy outing for both sides matt lafleur and aaron glenn will use this game film as teaching tape teaching their players what not to do lest they play a more disciplined opponent in ensuing weeks the packers and jets combined for 27 accepted penalties for 289 yards an ugly affair all around green bay and new york kept each other in the game with ill timed fouls for the packers that s 26 penalties in two games only three teams have incurred more accepted fouls in the first two games of a campaign the weather might not have contributed to the poor discipline but it surely had an effect on the poor hands in this one the teams combined for eight fumbles five by green bay three by new york though only one was lost the jets special teams which had been key in their week 1 victory was super shaky with isaiah williams muffing two punts and new york surrendering a 63 yard skyy moore punt return leading to the packers game tying field goal drive next gen stats insight for jets packers via patriots they had won 14 straight games in which they held a double digit fourth quarter lead entering week 2 back to top nick shook s takeaways browns pull off the improbable cleveland began sunday s contest exhibiting many of the same discouraging signs that doomed them in week 1 operational errors and penalties general disorganization and an inability to convert in key offensive situations unlike last week the browns defense showed up and kept the game within reach opening the door for deshaun watson and the rest of cleveland s offense to find a rhythm in the second half watson leaned on the youngsters around him connecting with rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston to keep drives moving using harold fannin as a safety valve and even converting a couple of third downs with his legs it was far from pretty but cleveland s offense pieced together two touchdown drives in the second half including a 12 play 68 yard march that ate up 6 07 and ended with blake whiteheart sneaking across the field for a wide open connection with watson for a 17 yard go ahead touchdown the browns had plenty to overcome sunday including poor offensive line play early self inflicted errors and a two hour weather delay and managed to outlast the buccaneers with a defensive stand amid a driving rain it s only one win but it will be a joyous flight back home to cleveland mayfield looks very uncomfortable in this offense after eight quarters of evidence it s pretty clear that baker mayfield hasn t found a comfortable place in offensive coordinator zac robinson s scheme tampa bay s approach was peculiar at times sunday producing sequences that saw repeated screens and swing passes to running backs while avoiding attempting to stretch the field much until late in the contest mayfield looks skittish in the pocket regardless of situation hesitating to fire and often trying to buy more time to survey as initial concepts fail to produce clear passing opportunities or he fails to spot them when they do come open it s only two weeks but it s fair to say the buccaneers offense looks a lot like the 2025 falcons also directed by robinson lacking consistent identity and intent while being operated by a quarterback who doesn t appear to be relaxed or confident that s not a good sign for a team aiming to climb back to the top of the nfc south qb change delayed for a week entering sunday s game many browns fans were eager to watch primarily because they believed it would be the last time they d have to suffer through an ugly deshaun watson led performance before coach todd monken decided to bench watson for shedeur sanders well they ll have to enjoy cleveland s win with a bit of bitterness because watson performed well enough to justify starting again next week he was far from perfect his performance is best described as fine but watson played an integral role in cleveland managing to mount a comeback confidently firing toward kc concepcion denzel boston and even isaiah bond for one key completion along the sideline and on must have downs in the fourth quarter watson kept the chains moving there s certainly no guarantee his success was anything more than a one week aberration but he looked much more like a quarterback capable of playing in the nfl this week than he did in week 1 when monken breaks down watson s performance to reporters this week his positive remarks will be much more believable next gen stats insight for browns buccaneers via nfl pro deshaun watson completed 24 of 30 pass attempts for 238 yards and two touchdowns averaging 0 25 the office for jalen hurts but when met with a deadline needing to lead a game winning drive with 1 56 remaining the super bowl lix most valuable player delivered hurts who threw a bad interception in the end zone during his first possession and another pick during the drive immediately preceding his last led philly on a nine play 65 yard drive to take the lead and the win from the titans he did so by becoming laser focused on devonta smith throwing to the eagles no 1 wide receiver on four of eight passes including a pretty 19 yard gain on third and 6 to set up philadelphia at the goal line on the next play he hit darius cooper for the wideout s first career touchdown to propel the eagles to a surprisingly difficult win he wasn t nearly perfect sunday going 26 of 37 for 264 yards two touchdowns and the two picks but he was clutch as ever when called upon to leave titans fans with some achy breaky hearts titans defense finally runs out of gas tennessee couldn t end drives quickly in the first half against philly allowing the eagles to dominate the time of possession with three drives that all took 11 or more plays and over 6 minutes 30 seconds although the titans did allow life difficult for hurts racking up seven pressures jacob martin had six and jermaine johnson had four as hurts seemed to regularly be running for his life and forced into poor or difficult throws it was simmons wrapping his arms around hurts as the qb threw his second pick of the day which eventually set the titans up for a go ahead joey slye field goal with just under two minutes remaining unfortunately a gassed tennessee defense that was on the field for over 13 minutes more than its offense couldn t hold up against philly s last second heroics after that eagles winning by skin of their teeth philadelphia found itself shorthanded right off the bat against the titans saquon barkley suffered a stinger on his first carry of the game after being stuffed at the line of scrimmage and having multiple big bodies land on him tight end dallas goedert then injured his knee on the second play of the second quarter barkley came back for the second half but only handled three more carries as he was clearly affected perhaps those setbacks disrupted philly s game plan but the offense fell into a deep sleep in the second half before miraculously waking up for some last drive magic that left philly s defense to keep it close enough for a win and vic fangio s crew luckily abided the eagles will certainly want some plays back especially after a few woeful missed tackles while allowing he logged six more catches on the day with four gaining double digit yardage and almost all of them making a key difference in denver s offensive awakening for one afternoon the broncos were able to realize the dream they d carried with them for years spending their sunday watching a deep threat thrive with a quarterback capable of finding him it s crucial to denver s offensive arc in 2026 one that can t rely too heavily on nix s playmaking or its stable of running backs the broncos will be at their best when waddle is a central figure and they saw firsthand how he can change their outlook on sunday jacksonville finally falters it s been quite some time since the jaguars fell apart in a regular season game sunday s performance wasn t quite a disintegration but it was a disappointing finish for an offense that could do no wrong in week 1 and suddenly couldn t find a method of success to counter denver s comeback after a strong first half that saw trevor lawrence pepper denver s defense with pinpoint passes lawrence regressed to the quarterback who too frequently attempts highly questionable passes and pays the price for it his interception swung momentum in the broncos favor and gave denver permission to hunt him for the rest of the day and the jaguars failed to adjust it all starts up front for jacksonville which struggled with denver s increased defensive aggression in the second half and surrendered a qb pressure rate of 45 2 hampering a passing attack that has been among the best in the nfl since the midpoint of the 2025 season fortunately it happened in week 2 against a top tier defense providing the jaguars with tape to correct they just need to ensure it doesn t become a weekly occurrence broncos bounce back save for one drive the broncos looked horribly overmatched in week 1 their offensive operation wasn t great in the first half sunday either with cbs cameras repeatedly showing a demonstrably frustrated davis webb shouting angrily on the sideline after their latest failure all of that changed though when cornerback riley moss slid in front of a lawrence pass in the fourth quarter and intercepted it breathing new life into the broncos and their anxious fans nix and co capitalized covering 64 yards in 10 plays and finishing with a well designed play action pass to fullback nate adkins for a touchdown to tie it at 13 defensively the broncos regained their identity after the moss interception shutting down a jaguars offense that moved freely between the 20s earlier in the contest and nearly intercepting lawrence a second time the
