news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the tampa bay buccaneers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location adventhealth training center tampa florida fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs tennessee titans 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs buffalo bills 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the buccaneers who won six of their final seven regular season games in 2024 end the 2025 campaign with six consecutive games against teams that missed the playoffs nfl research what you need to know 1 a new challenge has reared its head just ahead of buccaneers training camp find an early season replacement for tristan wirfs the all pro left tackle underwent knee surgery on july 8 and is likely to begin the season on the physically unable to perform list which would sideline him at least four games there s no replacing the only player in nfl history who has earned all pro honors at both tackle positions but the silver lining is there s plenty of time to prepare currently on the left tackle depth chart are veteran charlie heck a newcomer and undrafted rookie benjamin chukwuma but perhaps a temporary reshuffling is in order will luke goedeke try his hand at a tackle switch or will left guard ben bredeson another newcomer man the position it s too early to tell now but figuring it out will be a camp priority tampa begins the 2025 season with two road games and hosts the defending super bowl champions in week 4 with wirfs likely out 2 the buccaneers surged toward their fourth consecutive nfc title last season thanks to balanced offense that consistently put up points the unit returns in 2025 largely unchanged barring the availability of wirfs but one other facet of the offense that could be interesting over the next few months is how the depth chart shakes out at wide receiver with mike evans leading the way chris godwin s health and potential return to form is the first item to monitor the bucs are hopeful the veteran wr will be ready for week 1 after a brutal ankle dislocation disrupted a fantastic season in 2024 but the club seems to be prepared either way that s where the head scratching begins tampa selected emeka egbuka with the 19th overall pick and the ohio state product seems poised for the slot role especially with godwin s guidance jalen mcmillan came on strong late last season and is in line for more playing time in year 2 add in veteran sterling shepard trey palmer and seventh rounder tez johnson to the mix and therein lies a good problem to have for the bucs 3 haason reddick was the biggest offseason addition for a buccaneers team that is in need of pressure off the edges defensive tackles vita vea and calijah kancey led the team in sacks in 2024 following a lengthy contract squabble that spilled into the regular season reddick s lone campaign with the jets was one to forget but a new beginning in tampa bay could be what the two time pro bowler needs reddick who previously had four consecutive 10 plus sack seasons before 2024 joins an aggressive todd bowles scheme that will lean on his pass rushing talents and bring him opportunity to cash in on his one year deal there s also a fourth round pick to watch david walker the highest nfl draftee ever from central arkansas had coaches buzzing after rookie minicamp

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the philadelphia eagles offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location novacare complex philadelphia fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cincinnati bengals 7 30 p m et on thursday aug 7 week 2 vs cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 at new york jets 7 30 p m et on friday aug 22 2025 schedule note the eagles are the only team currently scheduled to play on five or more days of the week during the 2025 regular season sunday monday thursday friday saturday the chargers are set to play on four different days with the possibility of a fifth if their week 17 game currently tbd takes place on saturday nfl research what you need to know 1 there aren t many holes on the eagles roster entering the 2025 season that s what you d expect from the reigning super bowl champions with one of the youngest nuclei in football but there are a number of questions to be answered on the defensive side of the ball after a slew of departures out are josh sweat oren burks darius slay and chauncey gardner johnson four super bowl starters plus milton williams and the retired brandon graham that s 4 070 combined defensive snaps regular season and postseason and a lot of experience for which to compensate even for roster building whiz howie roseman and defensive guru vic fangio philly has backfilled well with its own talent plus a few notable additions in first rounder jihaad campbell pass rushers josh uche and azeez ojulari and cornerback adoree 39 jackson but how and how quickly the new look unit gels will be the focus of camp 2 what does saquon barkley s sequel look like after his historic 2 000 yard debut season with the eagles the madden nfl 26 cover athlete has reached the pinnacle of his sport with not much left to conquer the super bowl champ s renegotiated 20 6m aav deal is now the most expensive ever for a running back philly returns the same offense this season priming barkley for another opportunity to gash defenses behind arguably the league s top offensive line the eagles will likely lighten the star rb s load in training camp and preseason potentially save for an aug 13 joint practice with cleveland but if he shows the same burst and ability after an offseason of celebration could we be looking at our first two time 2k rusher 3 the eagles boast great continuity on the offensive roster but they ll have a new play caller and coordinator in 2025 kevin patullo was promoted to offensive coordinator after kellen moore left to be the saints head coach essentially minutes after their super bowl victory patullo will be philly s fourth offensive coordinator in as many years under nick sirianni shane steichen left for indy after the 2022 campaign and brian johnson was bounced after 23 the annual turnover at oc is historic sirianni is the first head coach to have four different ocs excluding interims in a four season span for one team since the merger and yet the eagles offense remains remarkably proficient year to year will that change with patullo s elevation he s been around the team since 2021 through the highs and lows of two super bowl berths and one embarrassing collapse our first glimpse at philly s identity under patullo will come in camp this summer

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after news_mentions.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba continues to dominate, no matter who's at QB: 'This guy is a wizard'
news_mentions.body_text: glendale ariz jaxon smith njigba often found himself in 34 the zone 34 last season but it had been nearly five years since he ascended to the level he showcased sunday afternoon including playoffs the star wideout racked up ten 100 yard games in 2025 during the seattle seahawks 39 romp to their second super bowl title twice the reigning nfl offensive player of the year snagged a pair of touchdown passes in a game but never thrice like he did when breaking into the national spotlight as a sophomore at ohio state in the thrilling 2022 rose bowl smith njigba set an fbs bowl record with 347 receiving yards and three touchdown receptions he didn 39 t quite match that distance with his 155 receiving yards on sunday but he scored three touchdowns for the first time since his college days as the seahawks improved to 2 0 with a 31 7 win against the arizona cardinals 34 it 39 s been a minute 34 said a reflective smith njigba 34 it 39 s awesome being in that zone putting points up for our team whatever it takes to win i 39 m willing to do whatever it takes any time you get opportunities you got to execute and put points on the board 34 not only did smith njigba become the first seahawks player since dk metcalf with three receiving touchdowns in a game he also made life significantly easier for backup quarterback drew lock who started in place of sam darnold seattle 39 s starting quarterback is out with a glute injury though coach mike macdonald said postgame that darnold 39 s timetable for returning has shifted quite drastically for the better darnold could start as soon as sept 27 against the washington commanders it was lock 39 s show on sunday however with smith njigba in a leading role on seattle 39 s second offensive play of the game lock dropped back and heaved a deep pass down the right sideline for smith njigba who was five yards behind the last line of arizona 39 s defense when he caught the ball smith njigba deked cardinals cornerback will johnson with a devastating head fake then slipped behind safety budda baker for a career long 82 yard touchdown reception 34 that 39 s my hooping skills right there 34 smith njigba said of his head fake lock wasn 39 t expecting smith njigba to be so open nor for him to run his route in such a manner 34 but that 39 s the beauty of playing with him 34 lock said 34 he 39 s going to find ways to get open it might not be the most conventional but that 39 s what makes him a ballplayer and that 39 s what makes him one of the best receivers the offensive player of the year last year 34 smith njigba 39 s next two touchdowns overshadowed a somewhat sloppy first half for the seahawks in which seattle and arizona each scored seven points he put seattle up for good on the opening drive of the second half when he ran a slant to perfection sneaking behind cardinals cornerback max melton to corral a seed from lock for a seven yard touchdown the 24 year old put the game out of reach early in the fourth quarter when lock threaded a pass through three cardinals defenders on third and 6 from arizona 39 s 12 yard line it wasn 39 t until aj barner plunged into the end zone from one yard out with 1 11 remaining in the game that a seahawks player not named smith njigba found the end zone for seattle this season smith njigba had the seahawks 39 lone touchdown in their season opening 13 10 win against the new england patriots as much as the seahawks long for the return of darnold who has missed all but five offensive snaps this season smith njigba is well on his way to another banner year regardless his 277 receiving yards lead the league while his four receiving touchdowns are tied with detroit lions standout amon ra st brown smith njigba has proven that seattle 39 s offense isn 39 t about who is throwing the passes or what scheme first year offensive coordinator brian fleury runs the game plan is quite simple get the ball to smith njigba and let the all pro figure out the rest 34 when he catches the ball we 39 re just like 39 man this guy is a wizard 39 34 defensive lineman leonard williams said 34 it 39 s nice to have big playmakers on offense 34 it doesn 39 t hurt to have a stingy defense either seattle allowed a game tying touchdown pass from jacoby brissett to trey mcbride to start the second quarter but otherwise stifled the cardinals arizona finished the game with only 151 yards of total offense including just 44 yards after halftime including last year 39 s playoff run the seahawks have won a franchise record 12 consecutive games thanks in large part to their defensive dominance the members of the unit that refers to itself as the dark side didn 39 t give that accomplishment much thought in the immediate aftermath of sunday 39 s shellacking 34 i think that 39 s what 39 s so beautiful about this team 34 williams said 34 i don 39 t think anyone 39 s thinking about that i think we 39 re so honed in on just being who we are 34 two games into their title defense the seahawks have demonstrated they are a well oiled machine capable of running it back and contending for what would be the franchise 39 s third super bowl title certainly seattle would benefit from darnold running the offense again but lock was more than adequate in his absence completing 19 of 26 attempts for 235 yards and those three touchdown passes to smith njigba 34 we 39 re on record about how we feel about him 34 macdonald said of lock 34 so he just backed that up today but it 39 s a 12 as 1 thing everybody having each other 39 s back 34 perhaps smith njigba though is a bit more irreplaceable than the rest of the seahawks the franchise made it abundantly clear how it feels about smith njigba when it made him the highest paid wide receiver in the nfl on an annual basis with a four year 168 8 million deal in march the seahawks dished the dough out for smith njigba because few nfl wide receivers if any can carry an offense quite like he can sunday 39 s performance was the latest in a line of many dominant ones for smith njigba who hauled in touchdown receptions from lock with ease just like that new year 39 s day in 2022 when he burst onto the scene 34 drew he is a special talent and sees the field very well and can make any throw 34 smith njigba said 34 i know he 39 s looking for me and i just want to be there for him 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 Sunday aftermath: Surprising Raiders, soaring Chiefs and sinking Chargers in spotlight
news_mentions.description: How surprising is the Raiders' 2-0 start? Are Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs truly BACK? Can anyone handle Brian Flores' blitz-happy defense? Kevin Patra digs into the top storylines coming out of Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the league wide average of 40 9 points per tilt in week 2 is down significantly from week 1 s mark of 49 4 ppg with monday night football remaining five defenses held their opponents without a touchdown on sunday carolina chicago cincinnati minnesota and new england it s notable that two of those teams the bears and panthers were involved in a 96 point week 1 bout the week to week flip underscores that clubs are still figuring themselves out early in the 2026 campaign two high profile quarterback injuries jayden daniels dislocated left elbow and caleb williams hamstring will hover over the early portion of the week as we wait to better understand the extent of those players potential absences let s look at the rest of the aftermath of sunday s showdowns including chiefs prove they re back with ot victory vikings d dominates in gritty win at chicago cowboys get back on track as dak passes romo concern brewing for these four offenses one defender who stuffed the stat sheet in week 2 but first a look at some unexpected developments in the young season raiders lead surprising 2 0 teams if we were ranking the most stunning teams to begin this season at 2 0 we d start with the las vegas raiders then there would be a wide football field long gap before the next squad klint kubiak and co took care of business in the opener against a miami team they were supposed to beat they were expected to be a doormat in l a in week 2 nope instead the raiders sent the chargers spiraling with a 26 14 win outplaying their opponents in all three facets that isn t something we ve been able to say about the silver and black in a long long time it s not just that vegas won its first two games it s that the raiders are winning by being the more professional team in years past the raiders have bungled themselves into the turf they were the ones turning the ball over in key spots making mental mistakes and taking brutal drive killing penalties sunday they were the even keeled squad letting the chargers dunk on themselves vegas capitalized at every turn kirk cousins is far from perfect but the 38 year old can still sling it on throws of 10 plus air yards against the bolts cousins was 8 of 12 for 181 yards three touchdowns and one interception per nfl research the 40 yard touchdown pass to tre tucker was just the third completed pass of 40 plus air yards by a raiders qb over the past three seasons kubiak has modernized the offense while rob leonard s defense has swarmed forcing five turnovers over two games the raiders had 16 takeaways all of last year soberly i anticipate the positive vibes from the raiders first 2 0 start since 2021 to be curtailed particularly as the schedule picks up in october however the building blocks of the future are more visible than at any time in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through two weeks with the big boys creating havoc and taking up blockers demetrius knight and barrett carter have played more fluidly sure the young lbs still have some coverage issues but their performance has improved significantly on sunday the bengals did not allow a single touchdown their first game allowing zero tds since a 27 12 road win over the jets back in week 3 of 2022 per nfl research of course there was still the joe burrow ja 39 marr chase magic to put cincy over the top but this was a game the bengals lose with last year s defense while we re here this is how i d rank the eight 2 0 teams with the giants looking to join the list by beating the rams on monday night starting with the most impressive through two weeks buffalo bills san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks kansas city chiefs minnesota vikings cincinnati bengals las vegas raiders philadelphia eagles chiefs mahomes prove they are back trailing the colts in the third quarter and facing a third and 11 patrick mahomes uncorked a 45 yard bomb to tyquan thornton to put the chiefs on the doorstep of a go ahead touchdown the heave underscored that a mahomes is fully back and b the chiefs offense can finally return to being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the fourth quarter that blitz rate would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 per ngs flores ability to create havoc without confusing his own players or giving up a trove of big plays on the back end is impressive other teams could try it and get repeatedly burned for flores it s a style it s doubly remarkable given the questions minnesota entered the season with on the back end isaiah rodgers has been studly so far and the return of veteran safety harrison smith has been a godsend dallas turner has come on strong in year 3 the former first round pick generated 10 pressures including two sacks on 36 pass rushes against the bears marking his second straight week with double digit pressures per ngs five of the pressures on sunday were unblocked a credit to flores discombobulating the offense as minnesota s offense continues to figure things out flores defense has the muscle and guts to keep the vikes on the winning track boys back on track after dak s record day after the prime time week 1 dud in new york dallas showed its high octane potential in an easy home win over the commanders with dak prescott tossing four touchdown strikes to break tony romo s all time franchise record of 248 passing tds it s quite impressive for a former fourth rounder to put himself in a spot not only to break records but to sprint past them sometimes it s great being naive and i was a little naive just growing up thinking that i could do this and i could do that but yet i think it put such insurmountable belief in my head that i can accomplish whatever i want to accomplish prescott said after the game and any thought that i said or anything that i wanted to do and i mentioned it and i said it out loud i had a mom and i had brothers who poured gas on those thoughts who told me i could and as i said you can call it arrogance you can call it confidence belief whatever you need to i wouldn t be here if i didn t have those thoughts if i didn t believe in myself like that and i just encourage the next little kid out there who comes from the trailer park in louisiana or wherever he may come from and doesn t know if he can do it or have the resources or have the family that you re right believe in what you want to believe in and find the people that support that and you can do it the cowboys continue to have issues with their revamped defense under christian parker the injuries aren t helping but dallas had far too many breakdowns against washington especially early some of the issues are of the mental variety and can be cleaned up sunday was reminiscent of 2025 when the cowboys needed big offensive performances to earn ws fortunately for brian schottenheimer when dak spins it like he did against the commanders few defenses can keep him quiet the hope is that eventually the defense catches up are these four offenses in trouble week 2 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams considered 'week to week' after suffering hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Caleb Williams is viewed as "week to week" after injurying his hamstring during Sunday's loss to the Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears expect caleb williams to miss time but the quarterback avoided a major hamstring injury head coach ben johnson said monday on espn 1000 that the team believes williams will be week to week following an mri exam it sounds like it s gonna be a week to week deal for him johnson said i gotta still talk with our trainer here we ll do that here shortly and i ll have the lowdown from him but it sounds like it s week to week but will likely miss some time johnson later told reporters the bears received a somewhat encouraging report about williams injury adding that the qb may not practice this week williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after coming up lame on a scramble in the fourth quarter the qb was emotional while being carted off the field but was reportedly seen in the locker room later walking without aid and only a slight limp yeah potentially dodged a bullet johnson added on monday we ll see he s tough and he comes back from these types of things better than the average human so we ll see while potentially missing the qb for next monday night s week 3 game against the philadelphia eagles is a negative overall it could be much worse for williams tyson bagent will get the start if williams is unable to go given the fragility of hamstring injuries the bears could play it cautiously with williams an injury that returns with a tweak if not properly healed could linger all season with a soft tissue injury it will be interesting to see how willing williams is to scamper when he returns he has used his legs with aplomb to open the 2026 season

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffers hamstring injury in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's loss to the Minnesota Vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter.
news_mentions.body_text: chicago bears quarterback caleb williams exited sunday s 9 3 loss to the minnesota vikings after suffering a hamstring injury in the fourth quarter williams went down while scrambling on first and goal with chicago trailing 6 3 the qb appeared to be in pain on the field grabbing at his right leg williams had to be helped off the field and was carted from the sideline to the locker room bears head coach ben johnson told reporters after the game that he did not have a sense on the severity of the injury we ll know more tomorrow johnson said johnson added he had spoken with williams prior to his postgame news conference and the third year pro was in good spirits i m actually happy it s nothing with the knee johnson told reporters that was my first inclination but the hamstring could be pretty damaging as well we ll see how bad it is tomorrow and we ll go from there chgo sports adam jahns reported that williams was seen in the locker room walking under his own power without the use of crutches one week after exploding for 59 points in a win over the panthers williams and the bears offense struggled against a stout vikings defense williams was 15 of 26 for 138 yards with an interception on a rainy day at soldier field at the time of the injury and chicago proceeded to have a potential game tying field goal blocked after the drive stalled with williams out of the game tyson bagent replaced williams under center for chicago and nearly led the bears to a comeback but bagent was sacked by dallas turner on fourth down in the red zone to end the game bagent would be in line to start if williams missed extended time bagent started four games during the 2023 season compiling a 2 2 record

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys' Jerry Jones: Giants were 'better than we thought they were' in season opener
news_mentions.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones gave the Giants credit on Friday for playing better than he thought they could in the season opener, but he's confident Dallas will recover and improve moving forward.
news_mentions.body_text: dennis green delivered the famous they are who we thought they were line following his cardinals 2006 monday night loss to the bears twenty years later jerry jones came to the opposite realization while assessing his cowboys week 1 defeat to the giants they just did a good job all over jones said of the giants in a friday interview on 105 3 the fan i will tell you they were better than we thought they were i m anxious to see how new york continues to play but really a combination of things we didn t play as well as we should play and can play but they played better than i thought they could jones wasn t the only one surprised by the giants who spectacularly thwarted expectations while never trailing dallas on the way to a season opening victory jaxson dart threw for 230 yards and three touchdowns on 23 of 29 passing and joined battering ram cam skattebo in dolling out damage on the ground the duo combined for 135 rushing yards with skattebo punching one in for six big blue sidelined the cowboys vaunted offense for large swaths of the contest exposing a dallas defense that was expected to be much improved under new defensive coordinator christian parker following a transformative offseason the cowboys instead allowed the giants to win the possession battle by over 13 minutes and blew several coverages both on vital downs and to allow open pass catchers running free in the end zone though jones graciously gave new york its share of credit he also noted the learning process the cowboys have undergone thanks to considerable scheme and personnel changes it s a process dallas must accelerate ahead of sunday s matchup against the commanders of course jones said when asked if he also felt the cowboys opened the season worse than he thought they d be to say it that way i d rather say it more positively that we re not at the level we re not at the level that we thought we would be i can give you a lot of reasons logical reasons you re dealing with conceptually a new coaching staff dealing with a new to a lot of people out there defensive scheme and then you re dealing with people who are fresh in to that scheme it s a challenge to put it together and ready to go we didn t play well last week what i meant to say was new york had really more to do with it than i thought they would so that s a factor but washington could have a lot to do with it here sunday too so we ve got to be ready to step up the level of play there s no question the upcoming matchup with washington gives both teams two divisional games right out of the gate whichever team loses sunday will fall to both 0 2 overall and in the nfc east for all that went wrong to kick off the season jones believes his squad will show up vastly improved for a vital showdown at home the improvement certainly from where we played sunday that improvement is to be expected and will be there jones said i m just gonna say it it will be there i know how hard these guys are working i know their physical capabilities and i also know their motivation so you ll see improvement i ll go on the record as saying that

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) questionable to play Monday vs. Giants after missing second straight practice
news_mentions.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is considered questionable to play Monday against the Giants due to a hip injury, head coach Sean McVay said.
news_mentions.body_text: there are some injury concerns over another rams star wide receiver puka nacua is questionable to play monday against the giants although nacua is officially listed on the injury report with a hip ailment head coach sean mcvay told reporters nacua is dealing with some groin soreness that is separate from the psoas issue that caused him to miss time during training camp nacua who was a surprise non participant in friday s practice also sat out saturday s session if the two time pro bowler ends up missing the contest or seeing diminished playing time due to his injury los angeles will have to dig deep to find production elsewhere in the passing game nacua was the only rams pass catcher who got going in any way during the team s season opening bludgeoning by the 49ers and even still he was relatively quiet outside of a 41 yard catch nacua hauled in five receptions for 74 yards in week 1 while no one else on the team went over 30 yards davante adams would likely shoulder a large burden of work as matthew stafford s go to guy should nacua end up sitting jordan whittington quad is doubtful to play which leaves konata mumpfield xavier smith cj daniels and tutu atwell available as well as a deep tight end group led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson it s not an ideal situation for the rams to be dealing with an ailing nacua at the start of a season that began with great expectations l a s early injury hurdles also extend to the defensive side with star acquisition myles garrett on injured reserve following knee surgery still there s plenty of stars to get the job done including defensive lineman aaron donald who plans to make his season debut against new york after ending a two year retirement to rejoin the rams at the end of august it remains to be seen if nacua suits up along with donald for the momentous occasion the rams kick off against the giants on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive
