news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Seattle Seahawks' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the seattle seahawks offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location virginia mason athletic center renton wash fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs las vegas raiders 10 p m et on thursday aug 7 nfl network week 2 vs kansas city chiefs 10 p m et on friday aug 15 nfl network week 3 at green bay packers 4 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note seattle begins its season with three of four games against teams that didn t make the 2024 postseason and ends it with four of five versus non playoff squads nfl research what you need to know 1 under center for a new look seahawks offense sam darnold will command a whole lot of attention throughout training camp after three seasons as the seattle starter with a pair of pro bowl campaigns included geno smith was traded to the las vegas raiders in lieu of the seahawks extending him enter darnold who inked a three year 100 5 million deal however darnold has no guaranteed salary after this season and the team can save 27 5 million with a post june 1 2026 cut so with darnold coming off an excellent overall 2024 with the minnesota vikings and two disastrous games to end his campaign the spotlight of scrutiny will be bright even in cloudy washington skies seattle also brought back veteran no 2 drew lock and drafted jalen milroe who possesses eye popping athleticism and the unknown potential of a rookie qb whom fans always clamor to see even in camp darnold s mistakes will be dissected so every snap is important even the ones that don t count toward a final score 2 much of the seahawks offseason was about the notable names they lost geno smith dk metcalf and tyler lockett however seattle made a couple of splashes with the veteran signings of ex dallas cowboys pro bowler demarcus lawrence and former los angeles rams triple crown winner cooper kupp established veteran talent doesn t usually need to show out in training camp but just how realistic it is to hope for career renaissances from kupp and lawrence will be glimpsed in the summer lawrence missed 13 games last season due to a foot injury while kupp s injury woes resulted in 18 games missed over the past three years combined kupp has two games against his former squad to look forward to and lawrence didn t hesitate to offer some shade to his ex club but just how much they have left is likely to be a major factor in the seahawks 2025 fortunes 3 over the 2024 regular season sam darnold threw for career highs of 4 319 yards and 35 touchdowns with the minnesota vikings he averaged 3 08 seconds to throw third longest time in the nfl as he attempted 73 2 of his passes after 2 5 seconds the highest rate in the league according to nfl pro in the vikings playoff loss to the los angeles rams darnold was sacked nine times resulting in his lowest total epa generated last year 27 4 translation for darnold to work within the seahawks offense he needs to be protected well left tackle charles cross is a stalwart and how 2025 first rounder grey zabel comes along at left guard will be crucial at right tackle the biggest question for abraham lucas is staying healthy he s played in just 13 of a potential 34 games over the past two seasons perhaps the largest quandary and camp battle will come at center and right guard olu oluwatimi and jalen sundell will likely duke it out for the starting center spot while christian haynes anthony bradford and possibly sixth rounder bryce cabeldue will decide the right guard slot giving darnold time to work is paramount working out who will be tasked with doing that will be decided in camp

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the new orleans saints offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location ochsner sports performance center metairie louisiana fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at los angeles chargers 4 05 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 10 week 2 vs jacksonville jaguars 1 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 17 week 3 vs denver broncos 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the saints are one of just three teams browns titans that do not have a prime time game on their schedule nfl research what you need to know 1 kellen moore s undertaking as head coach highlights the immense change happening in new orleans and how the saints adapt to a long overdue overhaul is at the forefront of everyone s mind entering 2025 coming off a super bowl winning season as the eagles offensive coordinator moore brings expertise on offense and a philosophy switch that has been yearned for in the big easy after former defensive coordinator dennis allen followed the sean payton era moore s lone season as oc in philadelphia offers some proof he can successfully acclimate his system to a new team but the disparity in talent won t make it such a seamless transition especially after derek carr s abrupt retirement in may moore s arrival is certainly a breath of fresh air on the surface but how the 36 year old rookie head coach the youngest in the nfl successfully acclimates to the role remains to be seen training camp will provide a first glimpse at moore s initial impact 2 moore s major project during training camp will be figuring out who will lead his offense under center jake haener spencer rattler and second round pick tyler shough enter a three way quarterback competition while undrafted rookie hunter dekkers also looks to get noticed the trial offers great challenges considering the young qbs and the entire offense will be learning a new system rattler enters with the most experience after notching six starts during his rookie season last year his struggles eventually had the saints turn to haener for a start but neither notched a win in carr s absence perhaps that s why shough enters his first training camp with the greatest anticipation in new orleans the 25 year old louisville product comes in with seven years of college experience sports a strong arm that sets him apart from his competition and has a good chance at becoming the first saints rookie to start week 1 since archie manning did it in 1971 having such a rare occurrence coincide with moore s undertaking makes for a stimulating storyline that s appropriate for this new era of saints football but the rookie must win the job first 3 the saints defense could provide some upside in moore s first season several familiar veterans remain at every level including cameron jordan demario davis and tyrann mathieu but the defense will need to adjust to new defensive coordinator brandon staley s 3 4 scheme after a decade under dennis allen the unit s roster makeup isn t short of talent or depth chase young carl granderson bryan bresee and khalen saunders return with jordan on a defensive line that welcomes newcomer davon godchaux davis and pete werner return as the team s leading tacklers last season and will help guide a tackling machine in rookie danny stutsman isaac yiadomwas signed to man the outside corner with kool aid mckinstry returning on the other side and alontae taylor manning the nickel justin reid is the biggest new addition to the defense bringing championship mettle after three seasons with the chiefs and completing a louisiana born backend alongside the honey badger the pieces are seemingly all there but how they fall into place is the big question

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the new york giants offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location quest diagnostics training facility east rutherford new jersey fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at buffalo bills 1 p m et on saturday aug 9 nfl network week 2 vs new york jets 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs new england patriots 8 p m et on thursday aug 21 prime video 2025 schedule note despite finishing the 2024 season tied for the worst overall record the giants enter the 2025 campaign with the hardest strength of schedule in the league for context the two other three win teams from last season the browns and titans rank 13th and 29th in sos respectively nfl research what you need to know 1 not quite the four headed monster in cleveland the giants quarterback quartet will still be an oddity to watch this summer tommy devito is the lone returning signal caller from 2024 but is slated to be qb4 if that by season s beginning new york imported two charismatic leaders in russell wilson and jameis winston with the former expected to take starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on offense unable to move the ball things collapsed in the second half as the game unraveled arizona was outscored 24 0 in the final two quarters jacoby brissett was as ineffective as we ve seen him in an arizona jersey dealing with an injury brissett was inaccurate and couldn t generate chunk gains arizona didn t have a play longer than 9 yards until the final garbage time drive trey mcbride earned 41 yards and a td no other cards player earned more than 18 receiving yards brissett finished 17 of 28 for 95 yards with a td and an int outside the one td drive arizona generated just five first downs on nine drives next gen stats insight for seahawks cardinals via nfl pro drew lock completed seven of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns lock completed all eight of his play action attempts for 71 yards his most play action completions as a seahawk nfl research the seahawks set a franchise record with their 12th straight win including playoffs dating back to week 12 2025 seattle also extended its win streak against the cardinals to 10 games the longest active win streak by any nfl team vs one opponent back to top dan parr s takeaways cowboys offense bounces back after a week 1 performance against the giants that left plenty to be desired dallas dropped 37 points on washington and scored on seven of eight possessions to secure its first victory of the season it was the form many folks were expecting to see from the jump for a unit that ranked second in total yards last season dak prescott went 26 of 31 84 with 279 yards and four tds he set the franchise record for career td passes 249 with his final scoring toss of the day a 24 yard bomb to ceedee lamb who finished with eight catches for 153 yards and two tds the cowboys still need to get the ground game going ranking near the bottom of the league with 135 rushing yards in their first two games but sunday s showing gives them something to build with a trip to brazil to face the ravens up next daniels woes won t go away we re once again being robbed of witnessing one of the most electric playmakers in the game after an injury plagued 2025 season jayden daniels left sunday s game with a dislocated left elbow he suffered on the last play of the first half he dislocated the same elbow last season and missed three games before returning only to aggravate the injury in his first game back last season washington went 3 7 without daniels in 2025 averaging 23 points per game in those contests the commanders still had life once backup marcus mariota entered the game at qb on sunday but they managed to score just 10 points with him at the helm which weren t nearly enough against dak and co it s not going to get any easier next week with the reigning champion seahawks and their suffocating defense visiting washington cowboys defense still has work to do while holding a team to 20 points is respectable washington posted 203 yards in the second quarter alone prior to jayden daniels injury on the final play of the half the commanders clearly had figured out how to attack dallas with daniels ability to create with his legs playing a leading role the new look secondary took a hit too with cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot leaving the game due to injury first year defensive coordinator christian parker now has a week to come up with a better plan for keeping a dual threat quarterback in check two time mvp lamar jackson awaits dallas in week 3 next gen stats insight for commanders cowboys via nfl pro all four of dak prescott s touchdown passes traveled at least 10 yards downfield in the air tying a career high nfl research with sunday s victory at at t stadium dak prescott has won 20 consecutive home games against nfc east opponents he s now tied with tom brady 2007 2014 for the longest home winning streak in division games since the afl nfl merger in 1970 back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways efficiency name of 49ers game five drives five touchdowns san francisco s offense was something to behold sunday against a young dolphins defense finding the paint on five consecutive drives to build a 35 6 lead after three quarters brock purdy never seemed stressed channeling his best oprah winfrey impression you get a touchdown you get a touchdown christian mccaffrey and purdy got the party started with a pair of td runs in the first half before the scoreboard blew wide open in the third quarter with george kittle kyle juszczyk and mccaffrey finding the end zone purdy who was replaced by mac jones midway through the fourth quarter finished his banner day 20 of 22 passing for 287 yards two touchdowns with no interceptions while leading the team in rushing with 30 yards and another score on three carries milestone day for mccaffrey kittle on a day that was all about kyle shanahan s offense it was no shock that the heartbeat of the supporting cast shined brightest christian mccaffrey had just 67 scrimmage yards but made the most of his touches near the goal line his pair of rushing scores put him in elite company as he became the third player in nfl history to record 50 plus scrimmage tds with multiple teams joining hall of famers marshall faulk rams 85 colts 51 and randy moss vikings 92 patriots 50 but perhaps the most exciting aspect of san francisco s offensive frenzy was george kittle s return to prominence after missing six games in 2025 with an achilles injury and a modest week 1 outing in australia the seven time pro bowler led the team with 80 receiving yards and his first touchdown a 12 yard reception on a busted coverage since the injury kittle s third catch of the day also marked his 600th career reception the 11th tight end in league history to accomplish that feat fins find offensive improvement the miami offense took unquestioned steps forward from last week s opener at least early in the contest the unit s three first half drives all resulted in field goal tries with riley patterson converting twice the dolphins outgained the 49ers in the first half 165 yards to 125 and held the ball for nearly nine more minutes than the home team for as well as malik willis and de 39 von achane played the difference going into the locker room came in the red zone where miami struggled to convert with a pair of drives stalling at the san francisco 10 and 5 yard lines unfortunately the story changed in the second half miami failed to amass more than 15 yards on four straight possessions before a garbage time 77 yard touchdown connection between willis and ryan miller there s still a lot to clean up that ll likely be a common theme for this young team throughout the season but there were definite positives early in this contest that willis and co can build on in addition miami s improvement on third down its 47 conversion rate up from 20 in week 1 was another step in the right direction next gen stats insight for dolphins 49ers via nfl pro brock purdy completed all 10 of his downfield pass attempts 10 air yards against the dolphins for 211 yards and a touchdown it was the most completions without an incompletion by a qb on downfield passes since week 5 2021 carson wentz vs baltimore nfl research brock purdy recorded a 149 1 passer rating 287 passing yards two passing touchdowns in the 49ers week 2 win over miami this was his eighth career start with a 140 passer rating tying joe montana for second in 49ers history including playoffs behind only steve young 13 only lamar jackson has more such games 12 than purdy since the latter entered the league in 2022 back to top grant gordon s takeaways visions of chiefs of old shine with a prime time audience looking on for the second week in a row kicker harrison butker booted a 40 yard game winner in overtime to send the chiefs to a 2 0 start it s quite the difference from the 0 2 genesis of last year s disastrous 6 11 showing it wasn t the prettiest win but it was a glimpse of what used to be with patrick mahomes producing a glistening line of 32 of 47 passing for 382 yards three touchdowns and a 114 0 rating the first of those three touchdowns went to travis kelce who turned in nine receptions for 101 yards it was the first time mahomes topped 300 passing yards and kelce had 100 plus receiving in the same game since week 7 2023 fresh face kenneth walker added 117 yards on the ground though he didn t run as wild as he did in his debut against the broncos for that matter neither did the chiefs instead they eked this one out which might be the best of signs for k c to come having gone 11 0 in one score games in 2024 the chiefs were an nfl worst 1 9 in such games last season now mahomes and co are 1 0 in nail biters and perfect through two weeks it s a long road but this is a good beginning banged up colts lose ot heartbreaker there s been no team in the nfl that s waited longer for a win than the colts unfortunately for indianapolis it waited excruciatingly longer for its ninth straight loss with an injury to alec pierce exposing the colts offensive depth even more sauce gardner and charvarius ward also dealt with injuries that hamstrung the defense it made the colts ability to hang around sunday all the more impressive but the struggles and losses are piling up jonathan taylor was a stud at times 24 carries for 92 yards two touchdowns but corralled for large swaths in others josh downs came up pretty big seven receptions for 72 yards tyler warren was relatively quiet aside from the first td of the game and daniel jones simply couldn t rely on laquon treadwell or keenan allen in more than four quarters of football indy totaled 329 yards of offense while its defense gave up north of 520 fortune isn t smiling on shane steichen s team right now it will need to in a hurry treadwell s topsy turvy play emblematic with ample time left in the fourth quarter nbc s cris collinsworth proclaimed a pivotal upcoming down as the play of the game it wasn t there were about 17 more plays of the game thereafter perhaps the most symbolic of the craziness of the evening was 2016 first round pick turned journeyman laquon treadwell s 48 yard reception in overtime with the colts trailing 30 27 daniel jones and co took over and the qb heaved a long ball to treadwell treadwell bobbled the ball before collecting it fell to the ground sprang up and had possession punched out by nohl williams and recovered by the chiefs game over nope replay showed that l 39 jarius sneed s hand had glanced treadwell s side after the receiver had established final control so there was no fumble now it was the chiefs with their backs against the wall they held though and after indy tied it up on a spencer shrader field goal k c marched down for the game winner the colts held the lead three times in the first half but trailed throughout the second after patrick mahomes navigated an 80 yard go ahead drive to begin the third quarter it looked like the chiefs would pull away at 27 20 but it wasn t to be despite mahomes and co outgaining jones squad 523 329 this one went down to the final play the chiefs emerging as 2 0 looking like their old selves meanwhile the colts will keep scratching their helmets wondering what else can go wrong before they get back in the win column next gen stats insight for colts chiefs via nfl pro creed humphrey did not allow a pressure across 51 pass blocking snaps against the colts his second consecutive game without a pressure allowed nfl research the colts extended their nfl long losing streak to nine games the streak began in week 12 2025 when indianapolis lost to kansas city in overtime back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the San Francisco 49ers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the san francisco 49ers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location sap performance facility santa clara california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs denver broncos 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at las vegas raiders 4 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs los angeles chargers 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note san francisco doesn t face a team that made the 2024 playoffs in the final eight weeks of the upcoming season nfl research what you need to know 1 after a four year sojourn in jersey as the new york jets head coach robert saleh has returned to the bay as defensive coordinator but his house isn t as he left it the 49ers were fifth in yards allowed and 17th in points in 2020 saleh s last with the squad in 2024 they were still eighth in yards but an awful 29th in points given up san francisco underwent myriad roster changes with plenty of departures on the defensive side dre greenlaw talanoa hufanga and charvarius ward among them the cupboard is hardly bare though as saleh can rely on dominant mainstays nick bosa and fred warner among the big questions to be answered this summer is how his ex jets pass rusher bryce huff acclimates out west after a trying 2024 with the philadelphia eagles and how fast no 11 overall pick mykel williams gets going there are plenty more quandaries for saleh to address though williams is likely to be among three rookie starters along with defensive tackle alfred collins and linebacker nick martin and the 49ers produced just 37 sacks a season ago tied for 23rd in the nfl saleh s got plenty of reconstruction at hand amid his return 2 unlike last summer christian mccaffrey is set for training camp and set to be all systems go originally thought to be precautionary mccaffrey missed camp last year with an achilles and calf injury that extended to him missing the first eight games of the season after finally getting back on the field mccaffrey s campaign concluded with a pcl injury in total he played only four games during a disastrous 2024 season cmc has proclaimed himself healthy from his pcl and had no restrictions during offseason workouts his health will remain a concern though it s a given following the third season in his eight year career in which he played seven games or less due to injury the coming weeks will also be worth seeing if mccaffrey 29 resembles his 2023 rushing champion self since he was traded from the panthers whom he s slated to face for the first time in week 12 to the 49ers mccaffrey has propelled san francisco to a 23 8 record when he s on the field the niners are 8 12 without him plain and simple mccaffrey is one of the nfl s elite when he s healthful and so are the 49ers 3 finally the 49ers were in line for a drama less training camp then reports surfaced that wide receiver jauan jennings was disenchanted with his contract a two year 15 39 million pact signed in the spring of 2024 brock purdy george kittle and fred warner each worked out lengthy and lucrative new deals already in a stark contrast from past offseasons when brandon aiyuk and trent williams 2024 nick bosa 2023 and deebo samuel 2022 had dilemmas dominate summer headlines just how large jennings contract dismay looms over camp remains to be seen regardless it illuminates an already existing concern for the 49ers their wide receiver corps samuel was one of plenty notable departures for the team the wideback s trade to washington coupled with aiyuk s recovery from a 2024 knee injury put the position in question jennings stepped up and into the wr1 role last season and will likely get tabbed as such again but there s now a wrinkle to those best laid plans 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall has a big camp ahead and a larger role to take after that ex los angeles ram demarcus robinson second year wideout jacob cowing and rookies jordan watkins and junior bergen will be vying to make contributions

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the carolina panthers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location bank of america stadium charlotte north carolina fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cleveland browns 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 8 week 2 at houston texans 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et nfl network on thursday aug 21 2025 schedule note the panthers are one of just seven teams that do not have a thursday game on their schedule their monday night matchup with san francisco in week 12 is currently slated to be their only prime time game of the 2025 regular season nfl research what you need to know 1 bryce young s growth in the last half of 2024 was the silver lining of yet another lost season in carolina and furthering his development will be a primary focus over training camp the panthers helped that cause in april with the first round selection of tetairoa mcmillan who possesses the typical traits of a true no 1 wide receiver and offers young a rangy target as the quarterback enters year 3 establishing chemistry with mcmillan is crucial for an immediate impact and having veteran adam thielen around figures to aid that process xavier legette s development entering his second season is also essential to forming a dynamic group weapons for young to utilize hunter renfrow s comeback attempt in carolina is another subplot to keep an eye on over the summer as the panthers aim to build around their franchise quarterback 2 derrick brown s return in 2025 won t be only thing to anticipate for the panthers defense defensive linemen tershawn wharton and bobby brown are key free agent additions joining carolina s star defender and the initial gelling of this reimagined defensive front is worth monitoring the panthers lacked any push without brown who suffered a season ending knee injury in week 1 and their run stopping troubles spiraled into last season s 32nd ranked defense a turnaround up front could do wonders for a unit with a talented secondary headed by jaycee horn and mike jackson the panthers also added pass rusher patrick jones and safety tre 39 von moehrig via free agency rookies nic scourton and lathan ransom are also in the mix for playing time 3 kickoff and punt returns might bring some added excitement along carolina s preseason both primary roles are up for grabs this summer and a pair of rookies wr jimmy horn and running back trevor etienne are expected to compete for both jobs the pairing is small in size but brings plenty of speed and shiftiness to a club that has produced just one touchdown return since 2018 the panthers oncoming work on special teams doesn t stop with figuring out the returners either with new kickers matthew wright and ryan fitzgerald battling for the starting role and new punter sam martin holding for longtime long snapper j j jansen

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 2: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 2 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window carolina panthers 34 atlanta falcons 3 new orleans saints 24 baltimore ravens 17 minnesota vikings 9 chicago bears 3 cincinnati bengals 20 houston texans 6 new england patriots 20 pittsburgh steelers 3 green bay packers 20 new york jets 17 ot cleveland browns 23 tampa bay buccaneers 19 philadelphia eagles 24 tennessee titans 20 late window denver broncos 20 jacksonville jaguars 13 las vegas raiders 26 los angeles chargers 14 seattle seahawks 31 arizona cardinals 7 dallas cowboys 37 washington commanders 20 san francisco 49ers 35 miami dolphins 13 sunday night kansas city chiefs 33 indianapolis colts 30 ot bobby kownack s takeaways lloyd leads panthers defensive resurgence thoroughly embarrassed by the bears after allowing 59 points to chicago in week 1 carolina s defense said no more and nobody took on the burden of correcting the season opening dud more than devin lloyd who delivered the performance of a lifetime the pro bowl linebacker lit up the stat sheet with a team high nine tackles a sack three passes defensed two tackles for loss and two interceptions on his first deflection lloyd read cooper rush like a book on a throw to bijan robinson getting there just in time to deflect the ball into bobby okereke s hands he blew up a drake london end around on fourth and 1 two drives later and in the third quarter caught the interception that got rush benched jack strand promptly entered the game and threw an interception to guess who lloyd who took that one back for a touchdown it was an otherworldly outing as he contributed to four changes of possession but the entire panthers defense can be proud of sunday s result it was a much different challenge than ben johnson s bears but carolina completely shut down its nfc south rival falcons qb situation is dire kevin stefanski dealt with many a quarterback carousel in cleveland to varying degrees of success two games into his gig with atlanta he s stuck dealing with another one and it s not going well cooper rush making two starts by default as michael penix continues to get back to 100 from his knee injury and tua tagovailoa deals with an oblique issue has stopped the falcons offense in its tracks rush turned the ball over twice in his first five snaps fumbling on a scramble as he dove forward and then tossing a third down pick to end atlanta s second possession those mistakes set the tone for the game and set the falcons back his need to keep most throws short attempting only two passes over 9 air yards hung a low ceiling on atlanta s explosiveness and he wasn t safe with the ball even while playing conservatively he was 10 of 17 for 86 yards and two picks when he was benched midway through the third quarter undrafted rookie jack strand entered the game and didn t fare much better throwing a pick six on his first career throw he finished out the loss with 59 yards on 8 of 15 passing nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter did however report sunday morning that penix could potentially return for the team s upcoming thursday night game against the packers the falcons will be hoping so because the output under center has been bleak young continues stellar start to 2026 is this the season of bryce young he was in complete control against atlanta throwing for 287 yards three touchdowns and a 116 3 passer rating he torched the falcons by spreading the ball around hitting tetairoa mcmillan five times for a game high 101 yards jalen coker for 66 yards on eight receptions and darren waller for two tds young even got xavier legette involved hitting him deep for a 55 yard field flipper with under a minute before halftime to key another a scoring drive beyond the stats young evaded pressure well and dropped more than a few dimes to a pass catching corps that looks to be the best he s had young now has 648 passing yards six touchdowns and one interception through his first two games joining jake delhomme 2007 as the only other panthers quarterback to throw a trio of touchdowns in back to back games to start a season per nfl research that s how you go about earning your first extension which will come sooner rather than later if he continues to play this way next gen stats insight for panthers falcons via nfl pro tetairoa mcmillan had three receptions for 81 yards on deep and vertical routes with each of his five catches coming while aligned outside nfl research devin lloyd joined charles woodson 2009 and zach brown 2012 as the only players in the last 20 seasons with a sack multiple interceptions and a pick six in a single game back to top nick shook s takeaways saints battle back again for a second straight week the saints found their offensive mojo in the second half of a road contest unlike week 1 they finished the job and can thank their ascending quarterback for leading them to victory tyler shough s final stat line included just one touchdown pass and wasn t nearly as prolific as his 410 yard output against detroit but the second year passer consistently made clutch plays to keep the saints moving he spread the ball well all afternoon connecting with devaughn vele seven times and once again leaning on juwan johnson in crunch time most importantly and most impressively shough put his own body on the line late in the fourth sneaking it twice and getting bent back awkwardly on his fourth down rushing score holding onto the ball just long enough to break the plane despite being contorted by a crowd of ravens defenders if we ve learned anything about these saints in two weeks it s that they re scrappy remarkably tough and refuse to give up their quarterback is the embodiment of it and the reason they won sunday ravens let one slip away all of the buzz regarding declan doyle s offense was justified after a week 1 explosion and for a half of football sunday it remained true derrick henry and lamar jackson keyed an impressive balanced touchdown drive that ended with a henry rushing score out of the wildcat formation and jackson s composure in an end of half touchdown drive which he capped with a pretty scoring toss to rashod bateman had the ravens in the driver s seat entering the intermission the second half didn t follow the same script though and baltimore can question its offensive approach when reviewing what went wrong the ravens handed the ball to henry just five more times in the second half for 17 yards and seemed to lose their offensive identity leaving jackson as their best remaining hope to keep the offense moving forward new orleans sensed the opportunity generating pressure on jackson and undercutting baltimore s offensive momentum opening the door for their second half comeback that theoretically could have been slowed by a couple of long possessions the ending a jackson interception on a pass to an area bateman never reached only capped a frustrating and disappointing finish for a team that will need to learn from this defeat shough olave have something special chris olave was the star of new orleans week 1 comeback and proved to be tyler shough s favorite target in week 2 making timely catches throughout sunday s contest on his way to an eight catch 86 yard finish in just two weeks it seems as though shough knows where to turn when he needs a completion most and olave is consistently making difficult catches all over the field while earning extra yards with his footwork and willingness to fight through contact olave s emergence was much needed in kellen moore s offense and has fostered one of the most entertaining and productive qb wr connections in the nfl through two weeks naturally when shough dropped to pass with the saints needing a touchdown in the fourth it was olave who sifted through the defense found open space and caught a perfectly placed rope from shough for the score jordyn tyson s injury dampened the spirits of the saints passing potential entering 2026 but olave has unquestionably made up for it through two weeks next gen stats insight for saints ravens via nfl pro tyler shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers nfl research the ravens led the nfl with 14 losses when leading by 10 plus points at any point in a game under john harbaugh from 2020 25 and now pick up their first such loss under head coach jesse minter back to top dan parr s takeaways vikings defense delivers again the steady rain undoubtedly played a large role in the sloppiness of the game but so did the minnesota defense the vikings have allowed just six points in the team s last six quarters after shutting down the packers in the second half of the opener before quieting the bears on sunday a week after scoring 59 points the bears were held to three a lone field goal by brian flores relentless attack the vikings took the ball away twice including jalen redmond s forced fumble to stop a chicago drive on the goal line they were credited with four sacks none more crucial than dallas turner s takedown of tyson bagent on the game s final play 10 qb hits and seven pass breakups there was a lot of intrigue about the defensive genius flores renewing acquaintances with the offensive mastermind ben johnson leading up to sunday and the matchup had a clear victor the bears three points on sunday were the second fewest scored by an offense coordinated or coached by johnson dating back to 2022 williams injury casts pall over bears a horrible day for the chicago offense took a nightmarish turn midway through the fourth quarter when caleb williams exited the game with a right hamstring injury he was running to his left on the rain soaked soldier field turf when he pulled up and fell to his knees before sliding to a stop he was helped to the sideline by bears staff after the play and was later carted to the locker room after the game head coach ben johnson said the team would know more about the severity of the hamstring ailment on monday williams was seen walking under his own power in the locker room after the game per chgo sports adam jahns obviously losing williams for any time is a blow to the bears and a lengthy absence would be a massive setback his departure was a gut punch to a squad with such high hopes after last season s division title and a 59 point outburst in week 1 the team has a lot of confidence in backup qb tyson bagent who signed a contract extension a little over a year ago bagent led the offense down the field before coming up short on the final drive of the game there s no easy way to replace williams one of the best young talents in the league and a player who seemed to be coming into his own in his second season working with johnson wentz plays clean game on ugly day it wasn t pretty but carson wentz did enough to put the vikings alone at the top of the nfc north in his first start of the season with kyler murray sidelined by a concussion wentz completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards six of minnesota s nine drives went for five plays or fewer but the team s final drive was its longest 11 plays for 62 yards and set up a game clinching field goal in rough weather conditions wentz didn t turn the ball over the vikings nine points are tied for their fifth fewest in a win in franchise history and the second fewest in the kevin o connell era since 2022 per nfl research after all the hand wringing over the team s qb situation leading up to the season the vikings are 2 0 with manageable games against the buccaneers dolphins and saints up next before a week 6 bye next gen stats insight for vikings bears via nfl pro the vikings blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks before he exited the game late in the fourth quarter 81 8 resulting in a blitz rate that would have ranked as the third highest mark in a game by a defense since at least 2018 nfl research after scoring 59 points in week 1 the bears posted just three points in the loss to the vikings the 56 point drop off is the second largest by any team from week 1 to week 2 in nfl history the only team with a larger drop off is the 1973 falcons who were shut out in week 2 following a 62 7 win in week 1 back to top kevin patra s takeaways bengals d continues its ascent week 1 wasn t a mirage for cincinnati s revamped defense after forcing a host of fumbles a week ago al golden s crew again produced difference making plays holding houston out of the end zone led by a revamped front the bengals controlled the line of scrimmage completely shutting down the texans rushing attack david montgomery and woody marks generated 18 rushing yards on 14 rushes 1 3 ypc with no ground game the bengals could tee off on c j stroud gobbling up four sacks cincy allowed the texans to move the ball between the 20s but bowed up on key plays holding houston to 5 of 17 on third downs and 0 of 4 on fourth downs including a botched field goal snap the interior duo of dexter lawrence and jonathan allen were dominant combining for six tackles four tfls a sack and two qb hits the two imports have completely changed how cincy can play d texans can t get out of their own way demeco ryans defense got back on track making life difficult for joe burrow sacking the qb five times holding the bengals to 267 yards and 12 first downs it took a miraculous catch from ja 39 marr chase and an excellent escape from burrow for cincy to find pay dirt unfortunately for houston this game felt a lot like 2025 with the offense unable to get the job done stroud played solidly avoiding big mistakes and peppered the middle of the field however the lack of a rushing attack put the offense in bad spots the retooled offensive line looked a lot like last year opening few holes on the ground and not giving stroud much time the texans offense missed nico collins badly with none of the young wide receivers stepping up tight end dalton schultz 12 receptions for 140 yards generated 103 yards more than any other texans pass catcher on sunday houston missed several opportunities to make it a game with an early flubbed field goal attempt a stuffed fourth down and a missed 58 yard field goal all coming in the first three quarters the texans got into the red zone four times however they scored zero tds and accounted for just three points on those drives that won t get it done burrow hooks up with chase for two tds in road win there weren t gaudy numbers but joe burrow and ja marr chase showed why they are a premier duo burrow came out insistent on getting chase involved early the wr paid him off with a ridiculous twisting toe tap 32 yard td in the second quarter the duo hooked up again on a scramble drill to put up cincy by two scores in the third quarter the offensive line was an issue on sunday burrow was sacked five times and the texans generated 10 qb hits orlando brown five qb pressures two sacks dalton risner six qb pressures sack and dylan fairchild five qb pressures sack all struggled the good news is that when the bengals put up fewer than 300 yards in years past they usually took an l in 2026 they re 2 0 while the offense irons things out next gen stats insight for bengals texans via nfl pro the bengals generated 27 pressures on 62 dropbacks 43 5 the most pressures generated in a single game by the bengals since al golden took over as the bengals defensive coordinator last season five bengals recorded four or more pressures in week 2 including jonathan allen seven boye mafe seven cedric johnson six cashius howell five and dexter lawrence four allen recorded his most pressures in a game in the last four seasons while mafe tied his most pressures generated in a game in his career nfl research the bengals did not allow a single touchdown in week 2 at the texans their first game allowing no touchdowns since week 3 2022 at the jets cincinnati broke a franchise long and nfl long streak of 65 consecutive games allowing at least one touchdown the bills now own the longest active streak in the nfl having allowed at least one touchdown in 47 consecutive games back to top kevin patra s takeaways patriots splash big plays to run away from pittsburgh drake maye didn t author a particularly pretty game but the quarterback threw a trove of big plays to move the ball against an experienced steelers defense maye connected on passes of 29 29 30 and 63 yards the pats also generated big runs starting with treveyon henderson s 39 yard td sprint and rhamondre stevenson added a 24 yarder early in the second half the pats had several miscues that kept the game closer than it could have been stevenson fumbled in plus territory on the opening drive and maye later threw an interception in scoring range coming off a disappointing week 1 maye didn t fully bounce back missing several plays he made a year ago and he wasn t comfortable in the pocket behind an offensive line that struggled especially as injuries struck however the splash plays highlighted by a 63 yarder to romeo doubs after maye escaped the pocket were a welcomed sight after last week in week 1 the qb didn t have a pass play of 20 plus yards on sunday he generated four the offense still has strides to make but it s much easier after a win that avoids an 0 2 start pats d gets in on the big plays it wasn t just the offense that sprayed big plays on the foxborough turf the new england defensive line dominated steelers blockers blasting aaron rodgers repeatedly the pats biggest plays came when they destroyed the 42 year old qb with the steelers in field goal range on third and 7 christian elliss walloped rodgers for a sack and forced fumble the ball bounced around for an eventual loss of 36 yards forcing a punt then early in the fourth quarter christian barmore hit rodgers forcing another fumble that elijah ponder scooped up for a touchdown effectively putting the game away for good measure rookie gabe jacas grabbed a flubbed catch for an interception that ensured the steelers wouldn t find pay dirt on sunday the pats allowed just 235 yards and 2 of 12 on third downs ugly day for steelers offense every aspect was bad for pittsburgh s offense the o line got walloped troy fautanu had a forgettable afternoon and guard spencer anderson was destroyed allowing seven qb pressures and a sack per next gen stats aaron rodgers was never comfortable struggled to maneuver muddy pockets and looked every bit of 42 on sunday before sitting for the final drive he completed 23 of 39 attempts for 187 yards threw an int and took four sacks the passing attack couldn t get out of its own way with drops and off the mark passes being the most memorable plays dk metcalf continued his atrocious start to the season catching four passes on nine targets for 27 yards with several miscues christian gonzalez usually locks up wr1s but right now metcalf is barely playing like a wr3 the run game was absent from start to finish putting the offense in bad down and distance situations mike mccarthy has a lot to figure out after two uninspiring offensive performances to open the season next gen stats insight for patriots steelers via nfl pro the patriots defense blitzed the steelers on 18 total dropbacks their most in a game since week 10 of 2024 when sending extra pass rushers they held the steelers to 43 passing yards 2 7 yards per attempt and a 22 2 success rate while also recording eight pressures two sacks and one interception nfl research the steelers scored just three points against the patriots tied for the second fewest by any team in which aaron rodgers was the starting quarterback rodgers finished with 187 passing yards no touchdowns and one interception his fifth straight start with one passing touchdown or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways packers avoid first 0 2 start in 20 years with gutty effort it wasn t pretty but green bay is in the win column in 2026 jordan love threw for just 145 yards the packers offense converted one of nine third downs and picked up at least one first down on only four of 12 drives and green bay committed 14 accepted penalties but a win is a win down 17 7 in the fourth quarter love and co strung together one of their better drives of the afternoon picking up four first downs with help from a field flipping azareye 39 h thomas defensive pass interference call and finding the end zone to pull within three a quick stop and skyy moore punt return later and green bay was in position to tie the game with a field goal after another three down stop in overtime with two consecutive sacks shared by four packers defenders green bay rode backup backs kaleb johnson and chris brooks into gang green territory where after another awful jets penalty and matthew golden first down trey smack smacked home the game winning field goal sunday s turnaround came in stark contrast to how the packers finished their season opener against minnesota when they blew a two score lead and lost by three scores green bay fans will be happy to sheath their knives for lafleur ahead of the home opener on thursday night as the pack have avoided starting 0 2 for the first time since 2006 jets collapse down stretch blow chance to start 2 0 on a gray afternoon in the meadowlands new york was in position to ride out an ugly win over the visiting packers through three quarters the jets had made fewer mistakes avoided nasty injuries and adjusted well to what green bay was throwing at them then fortunes turned up 14 7 new york benefitted from a marshawn lloyd fumble at the packers 18 yard line but the jets went three and out and neglected to go for it on fourth and 1 from the 9 setting up a field goal later tied 17 17 after two green bay scoring drives with the ball at the 50 yard line under two minutes to the jets decided to try a fourth and 1 dive the risk didn t pay off as braelon allen was stuffed at the line the packers didn t make anything of the turnover on downs but took their momentum into overtime where geno smith was sacked on back to back plays and new york punted the ball and game back to the pack for the second straight year the jets have outplayed their opponents in their home opener aaron rodgers steelers in 2025 only to fall just short in the end after such a positive start the loss felt like a familiar finish for aaron glenn s group and serves as a missed opportunity for new york to start 2 0 for the first time in 11 years sloppy outing for both sides matt lafleur and aaron glenn will use this game film as teaching tape teaching their players what not to do lest they play a more disciplined opponent in ensuing weeks the packers and jets combined for 27 accepted penalties for 289 yards an ugly affair all around green bay and new york kept each other in the game with ill timed fouls for the packers that s 26 penalties in two games only three teams have incurred more accepted fouls in the first two games of a campaign the weather might not have contributed to the poor discipline but it surely had an effect on the poor hands in this one the teams combined for eight fumbles five by green bay three by new york though only one was lost the jets special teams which had been key in their week 1 victory was super shaky with isaiah williams muffing two punts and new york surrendering a 63 yard skyy moore punt return leading to the packers game tying field goal drive next gen stats insight for jets packers via nfl pro packers pass rusher lukas van ness generated a career high nine pressures against the jets recording five of them in under 2 5 seconds tied for the third most by a packers defender since 2020 nfl research the jets blew a 17 7 fourth quarter lead in their week 2 overtime loss to the packers it was their first time blowing a double digit fourth quarter lead since week 9 of 2020 vs the patriots they had won 14 straight games in which they held a double digit fourth quarter lead entering week 2 back to top nick shook s takeaways browns pull off the improbable cleveland began sunday s on the youngsters around him connecting with rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston to keep drives moving using harold fannin as a safety valve and even converting a couple of third downs with his legs it was far from pretty but cleveland s offense pieced together two touchdown drives in the second half including a 12 play 68 yard march that ate up 6 07 and ended with blake whiteheart sneaking across the field for a wide open connection with watson for a 17 yard go ahead touchdown the browns had plenty to overcome sunday including poor offensive line play early self inflicted errors and a two hour weather delay and managed to outlast the buccaneers with a defensive stand amid a driving rain it s only one win but it will be a joyous flight back home to cleveland mayfield looks very uncomfortable in this offense after eight quarters of evidence it s pretty clear that baker mayfield hasn t found a comfortable place in offensive coordinator zac robinson s scheme tampa bay s approach was peculiar at times sunday producing sequences that saw repeated screens and swing passes to running backs while avoiding attempting to stretch the field much until late in the contest mayfield looks skittish in the pocket regardless of situation hesitating to fire and often trying to buy more time to survey as initial concepts fail to produce clear passing opportunities or he fails to spot them when they do come open it s only two weeks but it s fair to say the buccaneers offense looks a lot like the 2025 falcons also directed by robinson lacking consistent identity and intent while being operated by a quarterback who doesn t appear to be relaxed or confident that s not a good sign for a team aiming to climb back to the top of the nfc south qb change delayed for a week was far from perfect his performance is best described as fine but watson played an integral role in cleveland managing to mount a comeback confidently firing toward kc concepcion denzel boston and even isaiah bond for one key completion along the sideline and on must have downs in the fourth quarter watson kept the chains moving there s certainly no guarantee his success was anything more than
